Response:
  # Phase I — Impression
  
  Status: approved design; execute as small separately reviewed implementation
  slices after frozen Phase B and before Phase C.
  
  This document is the canonical, self-contained Phase I contract. A Phase I worker must not need the ignored `docs/Streak/` notebook.
  
  Completed Mind implementation tickets and their VFR notes are preserved in [Mind implementation history](../dev_history/mind/README.md). That archive explains how existing seams landed; this document and the remaining tickets define current work.
  
  ## Purpose
  
  Impression keeps TD Edit Board in ordinary continuous Stream while Beetle retains part of a recently accepted live scene for slower cognition.
  
  ```text
                   FOF
                  /   \
                 /     \
       live foreground   retained Food
             ^                ^
             |                |
          Stream             BCP
               \            /
                \          /
                     BSR
               attention router
  ```
  
  No Snap candidate finder/decoder participates. Impression is not a feed mode and does not implement explicit Phase S Streak.
  
  ## Definitions
  
  - **Slit / Stream ROI** — the thin live camera region used by ordinary Stream recognition.
  - **Live evidence / `LIVE`** — evidence decoded from a currently admitted CameraX Stream frame.
  - **SAA** — Snap Area Above: retained luma above the slit, horizontally limited to frame `20%..80%`.
  - **SAB** — Snap Area Below: retained luma below the slit, horizontally limited to frame `20%..80%`.
  - **Impression** — the BeetleMind-owned retained-data aggregate: immutable
    SAA/SAB pixels and geometry; an Impression-scoped ActiveBoardView; selected
    Food; source provenance; Impression/Food generations; active dream/bite
    progress; and persistent reducer-outcome Snippets.
  - **ActiveBoardView / cognitive copy** — a small immutable view of the board
    number, Impression target seat, and all four hands. Main creates the
    authoritative initial view from the post-`ADDED` reducer state; BeetleMind
    owns an evolving copy only for the lifetime of that Impression.
  - **Food** — an immutable grayscale corridor selected from SAA or SAB for background cognition. It has approximately the same centered horizontal bounds as the Stream ROI, not the full 60%-wide SAA/SAB reservoir.
  - **FOF** — Foreground Feeding recognition: the ordinary Stream recognition/cognition seam reused for both live evidence and Food bites.
  - **BSR** — Beetle Self-Reflection: attention policy on the BeetleMind lane. BSR decides whether foreground or BCP receives the next cognition opportunity; it does not decode or mutate the board.
  - **BCP** — Beetle Chewing Process: incremental traversal of Food through bounded FOF attempts.
  - **Dream** — one BSR-granted bounded series of BCP/FOF attempts.
  - **Bite** — one Food subregion supplied to one FOF attempt. It is the normal preemption/cancellation boundary.
  - **Snippet** — a short horizontal outcome mark crossing one barcode occurrence in retained scene coordinates.
  
  ## Geometry
  
  All retained geometry uses the unrotated source-luma coordinate system.
  
  ```text
  frame x: 0%       20%        40%  60%        80%      100%
                   |<--------- SAA/SAB --------->|
                                |<- Food ->|
                                |<- slit ->|
  ```
  
  - SAA vertical bounds run from the frame top to the slit top.
  - SAB vertical bounds run from the slit bottom to the frame bottom.
  - Reservoir horizontal bounds use deterministic integer/clamped equivalents of `20%..80%`.
  - Food uses the centered Stream-ROI-width Streak corridor inside the selected reservoir.
  - `BFM -> SAB`; `BRM -> SAA`.
  - `AUTO` does not guess a Food side. Phase I Food requires explicit BFM or BRM.
  - Pixel storage is packed 8-bit grayscale/luma. Do not store color and do not threshold it to binary black/white.
  - Display transforms never change retained source coordinates.
  
  ## Trigger and next-frame capture
  
  Only Main knows whether a recognized card actually changed the board. It arms capture only after:
  
  ```text
  EditBoardReducer disposition == ADDED
  AND accepted evidence source == LIVE
  AND the target hand remains incomplete after the reducer update
  ```
  
  The thirteenth live `ADDED` does not qualify. Completing a hand hard-clears the
  current Impression because retained cognition can no longer produce a valid
  card for that target. Food-origin `ADDED` never captures a new Impression.
  
  Capture deliberately uses the next CameraX frame, approximately one camera cadence after the reducer result; about 100 ms is acceptable.
  
  ```text
  live accepted evidence
  -> Main reducer returns ADDED
  -> snapshot the authoritative post-ADDED ActiveBoardView
  -> reserve a new Impression generation with that view and arm one-shot capture
  -> next live CameraX frame copies SAA + SAB
  -> that same frame still follows ordinary Stream/FOF
  -> install the new Impression and cognitive copy on the BeetleMind lane
  ```
  
  Capture is a tap, never Snap's exclusive `Capture/Paused` route. If two qualifying live `ADDED` triggers occur before the next frame, the newest request wins. Only one Impression is installed, correlated to the newest seed/generation.
  
  A new trigger invalidates old dream work. Installing its captured SAA/SAB replaces the previous SAA, SAB, Food, Snippets, and bite progress atomically.
  
  ### Impression-scoped cognitive copy
  
  The cognitive copy is deliberately not a continuously synchronized replica of
  `BoardEditState`. It excludes edit history, duplicate-repair state, DDS/TNT,
  dialogs, and other Main-owned concerns. All four hands are included because BSR
  and later dream cognition must distinguish:
  
  ```text
  card already in target hand -> familiar / neglectable
  card in another hand        -> known conflict / interesting
  card absent from the board  -> plausible addition
  ```
  
  In conventional engineering terms this is a bounded optimistic replica with a
  write-behind path. Its deliberately tiny consistency domain is one Impression,
  one target seat, one serial BeetleMind owner, and at most twelve predicted
  additions. Its familiar failure modes are stale-generation work, reordered
  delivery, prediction/reducer divergence, and ghost proposals after invalidation;
  the generation seal, FIFO publication, disagreement fuse, and hard-clear policy
  exist specifically for those cases.
  
  While one Impression survives, the mutation world is closed:
  
  - a qualifying live `ADDED` reserves a replacement Impression and a fresh
    authoritative post-reducer view;
  - a user, navigation, repair, configuration, or lifecycle mutation unimpresses
    Beetle and discards the cognitive copy;
  - only generation-correlated Food cognition may optimistically extend the
    surviving copy.
  
  Starting from the live seed already present in the target hand, at most twelve
  Food-origin additions can complete that hand. BeetleMind predicts each result
  from its complete copy: a card already in the target is familiar; a card in
  another hand is a conflict; only a board-absent card with target capacity is
  sent to Main and added to the cognitive copy. The copy updates immediately and
  does not wait for an ordinary success receipt.
  
  Main remains the authoritative basket (`🧺`) and still applies every Food
  proposal through the ordinary reducer. Each proposal carries its Impression
  generation and ordered Food identity. Main applies matching proposals in Beetle
  publication order and silently discards stale-generation proposals. If a
  current proposal produces a reducer result different from BeetleMind's
  prediction, Main invalidates that Impression and unimpresses Beetle; later
  queued proposals from it then reject themselves. This exceptional disagreement
  signal is a safety fuse, not per-card synchronization.
  
  Predicted `ADDED` and `ALREADY_IN_TARGET` also supply green/yellow Snippet truth
  without a success round trip. A current-generation reducer mismatch clears the
  whole Impression, including optimistic marks. Main may later return outcomes
  for diagnostics, but cognition and Snippet state do not wait for them.
  
  When the twelfth possible Food addition completes the target hand, BeetleMind
  discards the Impression and its copy. Main may auto-advance the seat or auto-fill
  the fourth hand; Beetle need not reproduce that subsequent reducer behavior
  because the cognitive context has already ended. The final sealed proposal must
  be applied by Main before that Impression generation is invalidated; later work
  from the generation is rejected.
  
  ## Evidence provenance and board consequences
  
  Every accepted cognition result must carry typed source provenance:
  
  ```text
  LIVE
  FOOD(impressionGeneration, foodGeneration, dreamId, biteId)
  ```
  
  Provenance is correctness state, not telemetry. It remains attached through Beetle publication and Main reducer application so capture eligibility and Snippet outcomes cannot be inferred from thread or timing.
  
  Food cognition reuses normal typed reducer behavior. It does not gain a second mutation path.
  
  Food-origin consensus is not itself board acceptance. BeetleMind may update its
  cognitive copy only after its board view predicts the ordinary reducer's
  `ADDED` path. Main independently validates and applies the generation-sealed
  proposal through `EditBoardReducer`.
  
  Snippet color records BeetleMind's cognitive-copy prediction for the barcode
  occurrence. Main applies green proposals through the reducer and treats any
  disagreement as an Impression-invalidating invariant failure:
  
  - **green** — this occurrence resolved to a board-absent card predicted `ADDED`;
  - **yellow** — this occurrence resolved to a card already present in the target
    hand, predicted `ALREADY_IN_TARGET`;
  - other outcomes (`IN_OTHER_SEAT`, `TARGET_HAND_COMPLETE`, unknown, ambiguous, or no card) create no Phase I Snippet unless a later ticket adds a distinct visual language.
  
  Repeated recognition of the same occurrence/outcome is idempotent. A later green outcome for an occurrence supersedes its earlier yellow mark.
  
  ## Impression ownership and four-lane execution
  
  ```text
  Analyzer -> BeetleMind -> meaningful immutable publication -> Main/UI
          \-> Telemetry  -> low-rate snapshot               -> Main/UI
  ```
  
  - **Main/UI** owns Compose state, the authoritative board and reducer, capture
    triggering, the active Impression-generation seal used by the basket, and
    immutable presentation snapshots.
  - **Analyzer** owns CameraX frame admission, ordinary Stream decoding, and the one-frame stride-safe SAA/SAB luma copy. It submits captured outcomes directly through `ImpressionRetinalBridge`, never through Main scheduling.
  - **BeetleMind lane** is the sole mutable owner of Impression, its cognitive
    ActiveBoardView copy, BSR, BCP, Food selection, Snippets, and dream/bite
    progress.
  - **Telemetry** owns no Impression state and cannot influence its correctness.
  
  Retained pixel payloads are immutable and defensively owned. Main may retain immutable display references/snapshots; it must not become the cognition owner or copy large pixel arrays on each recomposition.
  
  `ImpressionRetinalBridge` preserves the capture protocol across threads: it
  enqueues the exact Beetle reservation before exposing a request to Analyzer,
  then carries the correlated capture outcome directly back to the Beetle lane.
  `unimpress()` clears the pending request and makes a later outcome fail Beetle
  correlation; disposal rejects pending and late retinal traffic at the bridge.
  
  `BeetleMindSnapshot.isImpressed` is derived from BeetleMind's retained
  Impression; it is not a second mutable flag. Main renders one `🐞` after the
  current thought while that snapshot says the Beetle is impressed. Impression
  installation does not force a separate thought publication; the marker follows
  the next ordinary BeetleMind snapshot and may harmlessly lag. Telemetry may
  mirror this state in a future visible diagnostic, but it does not own or infer
  it.
  
  All cross-lane messages carry the relevant configuration and Impression generation. Disposal, replacement, or explicit unimpress makes old queued capture/dream/publication work reject itself.
  
  ## First BSR policy
  
  The first implementation uses one deterministic policy:
  
  1. BSR may deliberate only after an `isNeglectableView` live result when the
     BeetleMind live-evidence mailbox is empty after the current command.
  2. A granted dream snapshots the current `requiredConsensusFrames` value as its maximum number of BCP/FOF opportunities.
  3. Newly queued live evidence preempts the dream at the next completed bite/FOF boundary.
  4. Foreground evidence is processed before another bite is granted.
  5. Impression/Food replacement, reset, or disposal cancels the remaining dream budget.
  
  Archy's design note: while Beetle is impressed, a live view is
  `isNeglectableView` when recognition is `NotFound`, or when its resolved
  `CardId` already belongs to the target hand in the cognitive ActiveBoardView.
  Recency is irrelevant. A card in another hand, a board-absent known card,
  unknown, ambiguous, and conversion-failure evidence remains potentially
  interesting. After Food exists, a neglectable view completed with no later live
  evidence waiting offers BSR a deliberation opportunity. Eligibility does not
  itself grant. Installing Food does not automatically grant a first dream, and
  exhausting one dream does not automatically grant another. BSR chooses which
  dream to show; after completion, it analyzes the dream result and adapts before
  any later deliberate grant.
  
  No worker should invent timers, parallel Beetle mutation, mid-FOF interruption, or a second BCP-only consensus machine.
  
  `Live-evidence mailbox` means a Phase I protocol-owned count/signal of submitted but unfinished live evidence. It does not mean inspecting `ExecutorService` internals or Android's Main `MessageQueue`.
  
  ## Food lifecycle
  
  - Initial Food is selected from the orientation-selected reservoir after Impression installation.
  - Food retains its pixels, scene bounds, accepted live seed context, Impression generation, and its own Food generation.
  - Food is stable while BCP chews it; Food-origin recognition never recaptures SAA/SAB.
  - Exhaustion is explicit BCP state, not a deadline.
  - After exhaustion, another Food may be selected from the same retained SAA/SAB without CameraX capture.
  - Snippets belong to Impression, so they survive Food exhaustion/reselection and project into any later Food containing their occurrences.
  - The next qualifying live `ADDED` replaces the current Impression; every other whole-Impression removal follows the approved hard-clear list below.
  - ActiveBoardView exists only with its Impression. Food additions may evolve
    the copy, but Food replacement within the same scene retains it.
  
  The first traversal is deterministic. Suspicion wobble is later work, not part of I-01..I-07.
  
  ## Approved clearing policy
  
  Phase I begins with the following approved three-level lifecycle policy.
  
  ### Replace the whole Impression
  
  - next qualifying live `ADDED` (latest pending trigger wins);
  - Edit Board/controller/scanner disposal or navigation to another board/session;
  - hiding or replacing the live CentralArea, including camera-permission loss,
    modal presentation, completed-board presentation, Scissors, or Swap;
  - explicit mind reset;
  - Deck Profile replacement;
  - manual target-seat change;
  - target hand completion, including the thirteenth live `ADDED` and its
    automatic seat advancement;
  - board repair/mutation outside the current Impression flow: Clear, Undo, Scissors, Swap, `I'm sure`, import/session replacement, or equivalent future action.
  
  An Impression snapshots the target seat at its live seed. Food-origin reducer
  work uses that correlated seat; it never follows a later UI selection silently.
  A manual target-seat switch clears the whole Impression. Completing the target
  hand likewise clears it before the automatic seat advancement becomes the new
  working context.
  
  ### Keep SAA/SAB; replace derived cognition
  
  - BFM/BRM orientation change keeps the captured scene pixels and historical Snippets, but cancels the dream and replaces Food and bite progress under a new Food generation.
  
  The pixels remain truthful, but their interpretation and selected edible side changed.
  
  ### Keep Impression; restart only the dream
  
  - consensus-frame setting change cancels the current dream budget; the next grant snapshots the new value.
  - temporary camera idleness keeps the Impression while the same Edit Board owner remains alive.
  
  An ordinary `NotFound` or conversion-failure frame blanks transient barcode
  attention without unimpressing the Beetle. Retained SAA/SAB therefore remain
  owned until a semantic hard-clear event. Open Mind visibility is independent:
  its open or closed posture changes presentation without clearing the retained
  Impression. The current operator chooses that posture before the first accepted
  card; returning to TD ends the Edit Board visit and permits a new choice.
  
  Any future lifecycle event must be classified explicitly. Do not silently retain mutable cognition across a semantic owner change, and do not discard retained evidence merely because no live frame arrived recently.
  
  ## Visible overlays
  
  CentralArea eventually presents seven overlay types:
  
  1. live slit;
  2. SAA at top-left, stretched or shrunk to occupy around `20% x 20%` of CentralArea;
  3. SAB at bottom-left, stretched or shrunk to occupy around `20% x 20%`;
  4. subtle outline on the SAA or SAB area from which Food was taken;
  5. Food at the right, around `20% x 100%`;
  6. subtle outline on Food for the bite currently supplied to FOF;
  7. horizontal green/yellow Snippets crossing reducer-resolved barcode occurrences in Food and their SAA/SAB source views.
  
  SAA and SAB are small maps of the retained scene. Each source region scales independently in both axes to fill its complete destination box; this presentation-only transform does not change retained pixels or source geometry. Food is intentionally stretched vertically for presentation. While Open Mind is enabled, SAA, SAB, Food, outlines, and Snippets remain visible as live Stream continues. `RoiPreviewStrip()` shows the actual live or dreamed pixels supplied to FOF. A closed Open Mind posture hides all of these demo/debug layers without unimpressing the Beetle; the slit remains visible above them and the thought display may continue to show `🐞`.
  
  Snippet geometry is stored once in Impression source coordinates and projected into each containing overlay. It persists through Food replacement and disappears with Impression replacement or another approved hard clear.

  package org.itroboc.core
  
  data class BoardState(
      private val hands: Map<Seat, HandState> = Seat.entries.associateWith { HandState() },
  ) {
      init {
          require(hands.keys == Seat.entries.toSet()) {
              "Board state must contain all four seats"
          }
      }
  
      fun handOf(seat: Seat): HandState = hands.getValue(seat)
  
      fun addCard(seat: Seat, card: CardId): BoardState {
          require(allCards().none { it == card }) { "Card already present on board: $card" }
          return copy(hands = hands + (seat to hands.getValue(seat).addCard(card)))
      }
  
      fun removeCard(seat: Seat, card: CardId): BoardState {
          return copy(hands = hands + (seat to hands.getValue(seat).removeCard(card)))
      }
  
      fun swapHands(a: Seat, b: Seat): BoardState {
          val handA = hands.getValue(a)
          val handB = hands.getValue(b)
          return copy(hands = hands + (a to handB) + (b to handA))
      }
  
      fun totalCardCount(): Int = allCards().size
  
      fun seatContaining(card: CardId): Seat? =
          Seat.entries.firstOrNull { seat -> handOf(seat).contains(card) }
  
      fun validateComplete() {
          Seat.entries.forEach { seat ->
              handOf(seat).validateComplete()
          }
          require(allCards().size == FULL_BOARD_SIZE) {
              "A complete board must contain $FULL_BOARD_SIZE unique cards"
          }
      }
  
      internal fun handsInPbnOrder(startSeat: Seat = Seat.NORTH): List<HandState> {
          val orderedSeats = generateSequence(startSeat) { seat -> seat.next() }
              .take(Seat.entries.size)
              .toList()
          return orderedSeats.map(::handOf)
      }
  
      fun allCards(): Set<CardId> = hands.values.flatMap { it.cards() }.toSet()
  
      companion object {
          const val FULL_BOARD_SIZE: Int = 52
      }
  }

          duplicateOverrideCandidate?.targetSeat == seat

I’ve analyzed the core models. To satisfy the **I-04f** ticket, I’ll define `ActiveBoardView` as a lean, immutable projection of the current board state. It will live in the `:core` module to keep the domain logic pure and testable.

**Bob's Design Proposal:** 🛠️⚙️🍺

```kotlin
package org.itroboc.core

/**
 * A tiny immutable view of the board for BeetleMind background cognition.
 * Impression-scoped; excludes all Main-owned edit/telemetry/DDS state.
 */
data class ActiveBoardView(
    val boardNumber: Int,
    val targetSeat: Seat,
    val hands: Map<Seat, Set<CardId>>
) {
    fun contains(card: CardId): Boolean = hands.values.any { it.contains(card) }

    fun isInTargetHand(card: CardId): Boolean = hands[targetSeat]?.contains(card) ?: false

    fun isInAnotherHand(card: CardId): Boolean =
        hands.filterKeys { it != targetSeat }.values.any { it.contains(card) }

    fun isTargetHandComplete(): Boolean = (hands[targetSeat]?.size ?: 0) >= 13
}
```

This view allows `BeetleMind` to distinguish between "familiar" cards (already in the target hand), "conflicts" (in another hand), and "plausible additions" without knowing anything about the UI or history.

  package org.itroboc.core
  
  data class HandState(private val cards: Set<CardId> = emptySet()) {
      fun addCard(card: CardId): HandState {
          require(card !in cards) { "Card already present in hand: $card" }
          require(cards.size < FULL_HAND_SIZE) { "A bridge hand cannot exceed $FULL_HAND_SIZE cards" }
          return HandState(cards + card)
      }
  
      fun removeCard(card: CardId): HandState {
          return HandState(cards - card)
      }
  
      fun contains(card: CardId): Boolean = card in cards
  
      fun count(): Int = cards.size
  
      fun isComplete(): Boolean = cards.size == FULL_HAND_SIZE
  
      fun cards(): Set<CardId> = cards
  
      fun validateComplete() {
          require(isComplete()) {
              "A bridge hand must contain $FULL_HAND_SIZE cards, found ${cards.size}"
          }
      }
  
      internal fun toPbnHand(): String =
          Suit.entries.joinToString(".") { suit ->
              cards
                  .asSequence()
                  .filter { it.suit == suit }
                  .sortedBy { it.rank.pbnOrder }
                  .joinToString(separator = "") { it.rank.symbol.toString() }
          }
  
      fun cardsBySuitInBridgeOrder(): List<SuitCards> =
          Suit.entries.map { suit ->
              SuitCards(
                  suit = suit,
                  cards = cards
                      .asSequence()
                      .filter { it.suit == suit }
                      .sortedBy { it.rank.pbnOrder }
                      .toList(),
              )
          }
  
      companion object {
          const val FULL_HAND_SIZE: Int = 13
      }
  }
  
  data class SuitCards(
      val suit: Suit,
      val cards: List<CardId>,
  )

      var impressionPresentation by mutableStateOf<ImpressionDisplaySnapshot?>(null)
          private set
      var foodPresentation by mutableStateOf<FoodDisplaySnapshot?>(null)
          private set
  
      fun update(
          state: BoardEditState,
          profile: DeckProfile,
          mode: BarcodeOrientationMode,
          requiredConsensusFrames: Int,
          snapFinderSettings: HorizontalSnapCandidateFinderSettings = this.snapFinderSettings,
          snapProcessingDeadlineMillis: Long = this.snapProcessingDeadlineMillis,
          hasCameraPermission: Boolean,
          onBoardEditStateChange: (BoardEditState) -> Unit,
      ) {
          require(snapProcessingDeadlineMillis % 1_000L == 0L)
          require(
              snapProcessingDeadlineMillis / 1_000L in
                  SnapTuningSettings.DEADLINE_SECONDS_VALUES.map(Int::toLong),
          ) { "Snap processing deadline is outside the exposed range" }
          val activeCorrelation = snapScanState.correlationOrNull()
          if (activeCorrelation != null && state.boardNumber != activeCorrelation.boardNumber) {
              cancelSnapLifecycle()
          }
          if (
              state.boardNumber != boardEditState.boardNumber ||
              state.boardState != boardEditState.boardState ||
              state.selectedSeat != boardEditState.selectedSeat ||
              profile != deckProfile
          ) {
              unimpress()
          }
          boardEditState = state
          deckProfile = profile
          orientationMode = mode
          this.requiredConsensusFrames = requiredConsensusFrames
          val streamConfiguration = streamConfigurationStore.update(
              deckProfile = profile,
              orientationMode = mode,
              requiredConsensusFrames = requiredConsensusFrames,
          )
          if (streamConfiguration.generation != lastSubmittedFoodConfiguration) {
              if (
                  streamBeetleLane.submitControl(
                      StreamBeetleCommand.ObserveFoodConfiguration(
                          orientationMode = streamConfiguration.orientationMode,
                          generation = streamConfiguration.generation,
                      ),
                  )
              ) {
                  lastSubmittedFoodConfiguration = streamConfiguration.generation
              }
          }
          this.snapFinderSettings = snapFinderSettings
          this.snapProcessingDeadlineMillis = snapProcessingDeadlineMillis
          this.hasCameraPermission = hasCameraPermission
          this.onBoardEditStateChange = onBoardEditStateChange
          streamTelemetryLane.setBoardScanned(
              BoardProgressSummary.from(state.boardState).boardScanned,
          )
          updateMindStatus()
      }
  
      private fun updateMindStatus() {
          val status = BeetleOperationalStatus(
              hasCameraPermission = hasCameraPermission,
              isScissorsOpen = showScissorsScreen,
              isSwapOpen = showSwapScreen,
              isBoardScanned = BoardProgressSummary.from(boardEditState.boardState).boardScanned
          )
          if (status == lastSubmittedMindStatus) return
          lastSubmittedMindStatus = status
          streamBeetleLane.submitControl(StreamBeetleCommand.ObserveStatus(status))
      }
  
      fun dream(topic: BeetleDream) {
          streamBeetleLane.submitControl(StreamBeetleCommand.Dream(topic))
      }
  
      fun canAcceptStreamFrame(): Boolean = streamBeetleLane.hasFrameCapacity()
  
      fun handleCameraScan(streamOutcome: StreamCameraScanOutcome) {
          if (!snapCaptureGate.accepts(streamOutcome.epoch)) return
          handleAdmittedCameraScan(streamOutcome)
      }
  
      internal fun handleCameraScan(scanOutcome: CameraScanOutcome) {
          handleCameraScan(
              StreamCameraScanOutcome(
                  epoch = snapCaptureGate.currentEpoch(),
                  outcome = scanOutcome,
              ),
          )
      }
  
      private fun handleAdmittedCameraScan(streamOutcome: StreamCameraScanOutcome) {
          val envelope = StreamFrameEnvelope(
              streamOutcome = streamOutcome,
              configuration = streamConfigurationStore.snapshot(),
              observedAtMillis = nowMillis(),
          )
          streamTelemetryLane.recordScan(envelope.observedAtMillis)
          streamBeetleLane.submitFrame(envelope)
      }
  
      private fun publishBeetlePublication(publication: StreamBeetlePublication) {
          diagnostics.observeRoiPreview(publication.roiPreview)
          publication.mindOutput?.let { output ->
              thoughts = output.snapshot.presentation
              output.acceptedCardScan?.let(::applyAcceptedCardScan)
          }
          val updatesRetainedScene =
              publication.impressionUpdate != null || publication.foodUpdate != null
          publication.impressionUpdate?.let(::applyImpressionPresentationUpdate)
          if (updatesRetainedScene) {
              foodPresentation = foodDisplayState.apply(
                  sceneSnapshot = impressionPresentation,
                  update = publication.foodUpdate,
              )
          }
      }
  
      private fun applyImpressionPresentationUpdate(update: ImpressionPresentationUpdate) {
          impressionPresentation = impressionDisplayState.apply(update)
      }
  
      private fun applyAcceptedCardScan(scan: AcceptedCardScan) {
          val isBoardScanned = BoardProgressSummary.from(boardEditState.boardState).boardScanned
          if (isBoardScanned) return
  
          val targetSeat = boardEditState.selectedSeat
  
          val update = EditBoardReducer.applyScannedCard(
              editState = boardEditState,
              card = scan.cardId,
              signature = scan.rawSignature,
          )
  
          emitBoardEditState(update.state)
          lastResultMessage = update.message
          if (update.lastScannedCard != null) {
              lastScannedCard = update.lastScannedCard
          }
  
          val targetHandComplete = update.state.boardState.handOf(targetSeat).isComplete()
  
          // A complete target hand makes every retained follow-up inference stale.
          if (targetHandComplete) {
              unimpress()
          } else if (
              qualifiesForImpressionCapture(
                  disposition = update.disposition,
                  provenance = scan.provenance,
                  targetHandComplete = targetHandComplete,
              )
          ) {
              armImpressionCapture(scan, targetSeat)
          }
  
          if (
              (feedMode == TdFeedMode.SNAP || diagnosticSnapCaptureModeActive) &&
              update.disposition == ScannedCardDisposition.ADDED &&
              !targetHandComplete
          ) {
              val isDiagnosticCapture = diagnosticSnapCaptureModeActive
              armSnapCapture(
                  scan = scan,
                  targetSeat = targetSeat,
                  correlation = if (isDiagnosticCapture) null else SnapBoardCorrelation(
                      boardNumber = update.state.boardNumber,
                      boardStateAfterSeed = update.state.boardState,
                      targetSeat = targetSeat,
                  ),
              )
          }
      }
  
      private fun setDiagnosticSnapCaptureModeActive(active: Boolean) {
          val wasActive = diagnosticSnapCaptureModeActive
          diagnosticSnapCaptureModeActive = active
          if (wasActive && !active) {
              resumeStreamWithoutResult()
          }
      }
  
      fun selectFeedMode(mode: TdFeedMode) {
          feedMode = mode
          if (mode == TdFeedMode.STREAM) {
              cancelSnapLifecycle()
          }
      }
  
      internal fun armDiagnosticSnapFixtureExport(): Boolean {
          val armed = diagnostics.armSnapFixtureExport(
              hasExplicitOrientation = orientationMode != BarcodeOrientationMode.AUTO,
          )
          if (armed) {
              setDiagnosticSnapCaptureModeActive(true)
          }
          return armed
      }
  
      internal fun cancelDiagnosticSnapFixtureExport() {
          setDiagnosticSnapCaptureModeActive(false)
          diagnostics.cancelSnapFixtureExport()
      }
  
      internal fun handleDiagnosticSnapCapture(outcome: SnapFrameCaptureOutcome): String? {
          if (diagnostics.snapFixtureExportState !is SnapFixtureExportState.Armed) {
              return null
          }
          setDiagnosticSnapCaptureModeActive(false)
          return diagnostics.acceptSnapCapture(outcome)
      }
  
      internal fun handleSnapCapture(outcome: SnapFrameCaptureOutcome) {
          val armed = snapScanState as? SnapScanState.Armed ?: return
          if (outcome.request.correlationId != armed.request.correlationId) return
  
          when (outcome) {
              is SnapFrameCaptureOutcome.Failed -> {
                  lastResultMessage = "Snap capture failed: ${outcome.reason}"
                  resumeStreamWithoutResult()
              }
              is SnapFrameCaptureOutcome.Captured -> beginSnapProcessing(outcome.frame, armed.correlation)
          }
      }
  
      private fun armImpressionCapture(
          scan: AcceptedCardScan,
          targetSeat: Seat,
      ) {
          val request = ImpressionCaptureRequest(
              generation = ImpressionGeneration(nextImpressionGeneration.getAndIncrement()),
              correlationId = ImpressionCorrelationId(nextImpressionCorrelationId.getAndIncrement()),
              seedCardId = scan.cardId,
              seedSignature = scan.rawSignature,
              targetSeat = targetSeat,
              boardNumber = boardEditState.boardNumber,
              orientationMode = orientationMode,
              configurationGeneration = streamConfigurationStore.snapshot().generation,
              sourceFrameSize = scan.sourceFrameSize,
              streamRoi = SnapFrameRegion(
                  x = scan.streamRoi.x,
                  y = scan.streamRoi.y,
                  width = scan.streamRoi.width,
                  height = scan.streamRoi.height,
              ),
          )
          impressionRetinalBridge.arm(request)
      }
  
      private fun armSnapCapture(
          scan: AcceptedCardScan,
          targetSeat: Seat,
          correlation: SnapBoardCorrelation?,
      ) {
          val searchDirection = orientationMode.snapSearchDirection() ?: return
          val candidateRegion = selectSnapSearchRegion(
              frameSize = scan.sourceFrameSize,
              streamRoi = scan.streamRoi,
              direction = searchDirection,
          )
          val request = SnapCaptureRequest(
                  correlationId = SnapCaptureCorrelationId(nextSnapCorrelationId.getAndIncrement()),
                  sourceFrameSize = scan.sourceFrameSize,
                  streamRoi = SnapFrameRegion(
                      x = scan.streamRoi.x,
                      y = scan.streamRoi.y,
                      width = scan.streamRoi.width,
                      height = scan.streamRoi.height,
                  ),
                  candidateRegion = candidateRegion,
                  searchDirection = searchDirection,
                  seed = SnapCaptureSeed(
                      rawSignature = scan.rawSignature,
                      cardId = scan.cardId,
                      confidence = scan.confidence,
                      widthEvidence = scan.seedWidthEvidence,
                      detectionBounds = scan.detectionBounds,
                  ),
                  targetSeat = targetSeat,
              )
          if (snapCaptureGate.arm(request) && correlation != null) {
              snapScanState = SnapScanState.Armed(request, correlation)
          }
      }
  
      private fun beginSnapProcessing(
          frame: SnapFrameCaptured,
          correlation: SnapBoardCorrelation,
      ) {
          val capturedAtMillis = nowMillis()
          val profileSnapshot = deckProfile
          val orientationSnapshot = orientationMode
          val finderSettingsSnapshot = snapFinderSettings
          val processingDeadlineSnapshotMillis = snapProcessingDeadlineMillis
          val runSettingsSnapshot = SnapRunSettingsSnapshot(
              requiredConsensusFrames = requiredConsensusFrames,
              orientationMode = orientationSnapshot,
              finderSettings = finderSettingsSnapshot,
              processingDeadlineMillis = processingDeadlineSnapshotMillis,
          )
          val deadlineAtMillis = capturedAtMillis + processingDeadlineSnapshotMillis
          snapScanState = SnapScanState.Processing(
              frame = frame,
              correlation = correlation,
              capturedAtMillis = capturedAtMillis,
              deadlineAtMillis = deadlineAtMillis,
          )
          snapLifecycleJob?.cancel()
          snapLifecycleJob = snapScope.launch {
              try {
                  val processingContext = currentCoroutineContext()
                  val analysis = withContext(snapProcessingDispatcher) {
                      snapFrameProcessor.process(
                          frame = frame,
                          deckProfile = profileSnapshot,
                          orientationMode = orientationSnapshot,
                          finderSettings = finderSettingsSnapshot,
                          workSignal = SnapCandidateWorkSignal {
                              processingContext.isActive && nowMillis() < deadlineAtMillis
                          },
                      )
                  }
                  ensureActive()
                  completeSnapProcessing(
                      frame = frame,
                      correlation = correlation,
                      capturedAtMillis = capturedAtMillis,
                      settingsSnapshot = runSettingsSnapshot,
                      analysis = analysis,
                  )
              } catch (cancellation: CancellationException) {
                  throw cancellation
              } catch (failure: Throwable) {
                  if (snapScanState.matches(frame.request.correlationId)) {
                      lastResultMessage = "Snap analysis failed: ${failure.message ?: "unknown error"}"
                      resumeStreamWithoutResult()
                  }
              }
          }
      }
  
      private suspend fun completeSnapProcessing(
          frame: SnapFrameCaptured,
          correlation: SnapBoardCorrelation,
          capturedAtMillis: Long,
          settingsSnapshot: SnapRunSettingsSnapshot,
          analysis: SnapFrameAnalysis,
      ) {
          if (!snapScanState.matches(frame.request.correlationId)) return
          if (!boardCorrelationMatches(correlation)) {
              lastResultMessage = "Snap result discarded: board changed during processing."
              resumeStreamWithoutResult()
              return
          }
  
          val knownCandidates = analysis.resolved.candidates
              .filterIsInstance<ResolvedSnapCandidate.Known>()
          val batchUpdate = EditBoardReducer.applySnapCardBatch(
              editState = boardEditState,
              targetSeat = correlation.targetSeat,
              cards = knownCandidates.map { it.cardId },
          )
          if (batchUpdate.state != boardEditState) {
              emitBoardEditState(batchUpdate.state)
          }
  
          val outcomesByCard = batchUpdate.outcomes.associateBy(SnapCardApplyOutcome::card)
          val marks = knownCandidates.mapNotNull { candidate ->
              val outcome = outcomesByCard[candidate.cardId] ?: return@mapNotNull null
              when (outcome) {
                  is SnapCardApplyOutcome.Added,
                  is SnapCardApplyOutcome.AlreadyInTarget,
                  is SnapCardApplyOutcome.InOtherSeat,
                  -> SnapPresentationMark(
                      card = candidate.cardId,
                      bounds = candidate.fullFrameBounds,
                      outcome = outcome,
                  )
                  is SnapCardApplyOutcome.CapacityBlocked -> null
              }
          }
          val presentation = SnapResultPresentation(
              frame = frame,
              marks = marks,
              summary = SnapResultSummary(
                  addedCount = batchUpdate.outcomes.count { it is SnapCardApplyOutcome.Added },
                  alreadyInTargetCount = batchUpdate.outcomes.count {
                      it is SnapCardApplyOutcome.AlreadyInTarget
                  },
                  inOtherSeatCount = batchUpdate.outcomes.count { it is SnapCardApplyOutcome.InOtherSeat },
                  capacityBlockedCount = batchUpdate.outcomes.count {
                      it is SnapCardApplyOutcome.CapacityBlocked
                  },
                  unknownCount = analysis.resolved.candidates.count {
                      it is ResolvedSnapCandidate.Unknown
                  },
                  ambiguousCount = analysis.resolved.candidates.count {
                      it is ResolvedSnapCandidate.Ambiguous
                  },
                  completed = analysis.resolved.completed,
              ),
          )
          val completedAtMillis = nowMillis()
          diagnostics.recordProcessedSnap(
              SnapRunEvidence(
                  boardNumber = correlation.boardNumber,
                  frame = frame,
                  settings = settingsSnapshot,
                  timings = analysis.timings,
                  presentation = presentation,
              ),
          )
          val resumeAtMillis = maxOf(
              capturedAtMillis + SNAP_MIN_FREEZE_MILLIS,
              completedAtMillis + SNAP_RESULT_DWELL_MILLIS,
          )
          snapScanState = SnapScanState.ShowingResult(
              presentation = presentation,
              correlation = correlation,
              resumeAtMillis = resumeAtMillis,
          )
          lastResultMessage = presentation.summary.toStatusMessage()
  
          val remainingMillis = (resumeAtMillis - nowMillis()).coerceAtLeast(0L)
          snapDelay(remainingMillis)
          currentCoroutineContext().ensureActive()
          if (snapScanState.matches(frame.request.correlationId)) {
              resumeStreamWithoutResult()
          }
      }
  
      private fun boardCorrelationMatches(correlation: SnapBoardCorrelation): Boolean =
          boardEditState.boardNumber == correlation.boardNumber &&
              boardEditState.boardState == correlation.boardStateAfterSeed
  
      internal fun cancelSnapLifecycle() {
          snapLifecycleJob?.cancel()
          snapLifecycleJob = null
          if (snapScanState !is SnapScanState.Streaming || !snapCaptureGate.isStreaming()) {
              resumeStreamWithoutResult()
          }
      }
  
      private fun resumeStreamWithoutResult() {
          snapLifecycleJob?.cancel()
          snapLifecycleJob = null
          snapScanState = SnapScanState.Streaming(snapCaptureGate.resumeStream())
      }
  
      private fun emitBoardEditState(state: BoardEditState) {
          boardEditState = state
          streamTelemetryLane.setBoardScanned(
              BoardProgressSummary.from(state.boardState).boardScanned,
          )
          onBoardEditStateChange(state)
      }
  
      fun onSeatClick(seat: Seat) {
          if (seat != boardEditState.selectedSeat) {
              unimpress()
          }
          val nextBoardEditState = boardEditState.copy(selectedSeat = seat)
          val update = EditBoardReducer.tryAutoFillFourthHand(nextBoardEditState)
          emitBoardEditState(update.state)
          if (update.message != null) {
              lastResultMessage = update.message
          }
          updateMindStatus()
      }
  
      fun onClearHand() {
          val selectedHand = boardEditState.boardState.handOf(boardEditState.selectedSeat)
          if (selectedHand.count() > 0) {
              unimpress()
              val update = EditBoardReducer.clearSelectedHand(boardEditState)
              emitBoardEditState(update.state)
              lastResultMessage = update.message
              lastScannedCard = null
          }
      }
  
      fun onClearBoard() {
          unimpress()
          val update = EditBoardReducer.clearBoard(boardEditState)
          emitBoardEditState(update.state)
          lastResultMessage = update.message
          lastScannedCard = null
      }
  
      fun onUndo() {
          unimpress()
          val update = EditBoardReducer.undoAddForSelectedHand(boardEditState)
          emitBoardEditState(update.state)
          lastResultMessage = update.message
      }
  
      fun onRemoveCard(card: CardId) {
          unimpress()
          val update = EditBoardReducer.removeCardFromSelectedHand(boardEditState, card)
          emitBoardEditState(update.state)
          lastResultMessage = update.message
      }
  
      fun onManualAddCard(card: CardId) {
          unimpress()
          val update = EditBoardReducer.addManualCardToSelectedHand(boardEditState, card)
          emitBoardEditState(update.state)
          lastResultMessage = update.message
          if (update.lastScannedCard != null) {
              lastScannedCard = update.lastScannedCard
          }
      }
  
      fun onSwapHands(targetSeat: Seat) {
          unimpress()
          val update = EditBoardReducer.swapSelectedHandWith(boardEditState, targetSeat)
          emitBoardEditState(update.state)
          lastResultMessage = update.message
      }
  
      fun onConfirmDuplicate() {
          unimpress()
          val update = EditBoardReducer.confirmDuplicateOverride(boardEditState)
          emitBoardEditState(update.state)
          lastResultMessage = update.message
      }
  
      fun closeStreamLanes() {
          impressionRetinalBridge.close()
          streamTelemetryLane.close()
          streamBeetleLane.close()
      }
  
      private fun unimpress() {
          impressionRetinalBridge.unimpress()
      }
  }
  
  private fun SnapScanState.correlationOrNull(): SnapBoardCorrelation? = when (this) {
      is SnapScanState.Streaming -> null
      is SnapScanState.Armed -> correlation
      is SnapScanState.Processing -> correlation
      is SnapScanState.ShowingResult -> correlation
  }
  
  private fun SnapScanState.matches(correlationId: SnapCaptureCorrelationId): Boolean = when (this) {
      is SnapScanState.Streaming -> false
      is SnapScanState.Armed -> request.correlationId == correlationId
      is SnapScanState.Processing -> frame.request.correlationId == correlationId
      is SnapScanState.ShowingResult -> presentation.frame.request.correlationId == correlationId
  }
  
  private fun SnapResultSummary.toStatusMessage(): String = buildString {
      append(if (completed) "Snap complete" else "Snap partial")
      append(": $addedCount added, $alreadyInTargetCount already present")
      if (inOtherSeatCount > 0) append(", $inOtherSeatCount in another hand")
      if (capacityBlockedCount > 0) append(", $capacityBlockedCount capacity-blocked")
      if (unknownCount > 0) append(", $unknownCount unknown")
      if (ambiguousCount > 0) append(", $ambiguousCount ambiguous")
      append('.')
  }
  
  internal fun CameraScanOutcome.toBeetleEvidence(
      profile: DeckProfile,
      orientationMode: BarcodeOrientationMode,
      provenance: BeetleEvidenceProvenance,
  ): BeetleEvidence? = when (this) {
      is CameraScanOutcome.Decoded -> when (val result = decodeResult) {
          is BarcodeDecodeResult.Found -> {
              val detectionBounds = result.signature.bounds?.let(SnapDetectionBounds::RoiLocal)
              val seedWidthEvidence = snapSeedWidthEvidence(
                  detectionBounds = detectionBounds,
                  frameSize = SnapFrameSize(
                      width = frameDebugInfo.width,
                      height = frameDebugInfo.height,
                  ),
                  streamRoi = roi,
              )
              val signature = result.signature.viewedAs(orientationMode) ?: return null
              val cardId = profile.lookup(signature)
              if (cardId == null) {
                  BeetleEvidence.Unknown(
                      rawSignature = signature,
                      confidence = result.signature.confidence,
                      provenance = provenance,
                  )
              } else {
                  BeetleEvidence.Known(
                      rawSignature = signature,
                      cardId = cardId,
                      confidence = result.signature.confidence,
                      seedWidthEvidence = seedWidthEvidence,
                      detectionBounds = detectionBounds,
                      sourceFrameSize = SnapFrameSize(
                          width = frameDebugInfo.width,
                          height = frameDebugInfo.height,
                      ),
                      streamRoi = roi,
                      provenance = provenance,
                  )
              }
          }
          is BarcodeDecodeResult.Ambiguous -> BeetleEvidence.Ambiguous(
              candidates = result.candidates.mapNotNull { candidate ->
                  candidate.viewedAs(orientationMode)?.let { signature ->
                      BeetleSignatureCandidate(
                          rawSignature = signature,
                          confidence = candidate.confidence,
                      )
                  }
              },
              provenance = provenance,
          )
          is BarcodeDecodeResult.NotFound -> BeetleEvidence.NotFound(result.reason, provenance = provenance)
      }
      is CameraScanOutcome.ConversionFailed -> BeetleEvidence.ConversionFailure(reason, provenance = provenance)
  }
  
  @Composable
  internal fun rememberEditBoardController(
      boardEditState: BoardEditState,
      deckProfile: DeckProfile,
      orientationMode: BarcodeOrientationMode,
      feedMode: TdFeedMode,
      requiredConsensusFrames: Int,
      snapFinderSettings: HorizontalSnapCandidateFinderSettings,
      snapProcessingDeadlineMillis: Long,
      hasCameraPermission: Boolean,
      mainExecutor: Executor,
      onBoardEditStateChange: (BoardEditState) -> Unit
  ): EditBoardController {
      val snapScope = rememberCoroutineScope()
      val controller = remember {
          EditBoardController(
              onBoardEditStateChange = onBoardEditStateChange,
              snapScope = snapScope,
              mainExecutor = mainExecutor,
              telemetryLaneFactory = ScheduledStreamTelemetryLane.FACTORY,
              beetleLaneFactory = ExecutorStreamBeetleLane.FACTORY,
          )
      }
      controller.selectFeedMode(feedMode)
      controller.update(
          state = boardEditState,
          profile = deckProfile,
          mode = orientationMode,
          requiredConsensusFrames = requiredConsensusFrames,
          snapFinderSettings = snapFinderSettings,
          snapProcessingDeadlineMillis = snapProcessingDeadlineMillis,
          hasCameraPermission = hasCameraPermission,
          onBoardEditStateChange = onBoardEditStateChange,
      )
  
      return controller
  }

/**
 * A tiny immutable view of the board for BeetleMind background cognition.
 * Impression-scoped; excludes all Main-owned edit/telemetry/DDS state.
 */
data class ActiveBoardView(
    val boardNumber: Int,
    val targetSeat: Seat,
    val hands: Map<Seat, Set<CardId>>
) {
    fun contains(card: CardId): Boolean = hands.values.any { it.contains(card) }

    fun isInTargetHand(card: CardId): Boolean = hands[targetSeat]?.contains(card) ?: false

    fun isInAnotherHand(card: CardId): Boolean =
        hands.filterKeys { it != targetSeat }.values.any { it.contains(card) }

    fun isTargetHandComplete(): Boolean = (hands[targetSeat]?.size ?: 0) >= 13

    companion object {
        fun from(state: BoardEditState): ActiveBoardView =
            ActiveBoardView(
                boardNumber = state.boardNumber,
                targetSeat = state.selectedSeat,
                hands = Seat.entries.associateWith { state.boardState.handOf(it).cards() }
            )
    }
}

Response:
  package org.itroboc.app
  
  import org.itroboc.core.CardId
  import org.itroboc.core.Seat
  import org.itroboc.vision.GrayImage
  import org.itroboc.vision.SnapFrameRegion
  import org.itroboc.vision.SnapFrameSize
  
  @JvmInline
  internal value class ImpressionGeneration(val value: Long) {
      init {
          require(value > 0L) { "Impression generation must be positive" }
      }
  
      fun next(): ImpressionGeneration = ImpressionGeneration(value + 1L)
  }
  
  /** Unique identity for a specific capture attempt; increments on every arm. */
  @JvmInline
  internal value class ImpressionCorrelationId(val value: Long) {
      init {
          require(value > 0L) { "Impression correlation ID must be positive" }
      }
  }
  
  internal data class ImpressionCaptureRequest(
      val generation: ImpressionGeneration,
      val correlationId: ImpressionCorrelationId,
      val seedCardId: CardId,
      val seedSignature: String,
      val targetSeat: Seat,
      val boardNumber: Int,
      val orientationMode: BarcodeOrientationMode,
      val configurationGeneration: StreamConfigurationGeneration,
      val sourceFrameSize: SnapFrameSize,
      val streamRoi: SnapFrameRegion,
  ) {
      init {
          require(seedSignature.isNotBlank()) { "Impression seed signature must not be blank" }
          require(boardNumber > 0) { "Impression board number must be positive" }
          require(orientationMode != BarcodeOrientationMode.AUTO) {
              "Impression capture requires an explicit orientation mode"
          }
          require(streamRoi.fitsWithin(sourceFrameSize)) {
              "Stream ROI must fit within the source frame"
          }
      }
  }
  
  /** Defensively owned retained luma for one source-frame region. */
  internal class ImpressionLumaReservoir internal constructor(
      val sourceRegion: SnapFrameRegion,
      packedLumaPixels: ByteArray,
  ) {
      private val packedLumaPixels = packedLumaPixels.copyOf()
  
      init {
          require(packedLumaPixels.size.toLong() == sourceRegion.width.toLong() * sourceRegion.height) {
              "Impression reservoir pixels must match its source region"
          }
      }
  
      fun copyPixels(): ByteArray = packedLumaPixels.copyOf()
  
      internal fun copyRegion(region: SnapFrameRegion): ByteArray {
          require(
              region.x >= sourceRegion.x &&
                  region.y >= sourceRegion.y &&
                  region.rightExclusive <= sourceRegion.rightExclusive &&
                  region.bottomExclusive <= sourceRegion.bottomExclusive
          ) { "Selected region must fit within its Impression reservoir" }
  
          val localX = region.x - sourceRegion.x
          val localY = region.y - sourceRegion.y
          val selected = ByteArray(region.width * region.height)
          repeat(region.height) { row ->
              val sourceStart = (localY + row) * sourceRegion.width + localX
              packedLumaPixels.copyInto(
                  destination = selected,
                  destinationOffset = row * region.width,
                  startIndex = sourceStart,
                  endIndex = sourceStart + region.width,
              )
          }
          return selected
      }
  
      fun toGrayImage(): GrayImage = GrayImage(
          width = sourceRegion.width,
          height = sourceRegion.height,
          pixels = copyPixels(),
      )
  }
  
  /** Immutable presentation snapshot for Main. */
  internal data class ImpressionPresentation(
      val generation: ImpressionGeneration,
      val correlationId: ImpressionCorrelationId,
      val geometry: ImpressionSceneGeometry,
      val saa: ImpressionLumaReservoir,
      val sab: ImpressionLumaReservoir,
      val rotationDegrees: Int,
  )
  
  internal sealed interface ImpressionPresentationUpdate {
      data class Present(val snapshot: ImpressionPresentation) : ImpressionPresentationUpdate
      data object Cleared : ImpressionPresentationUpdate
  }
  
  /** Captured scene data in unrotated luma coordinates. */
  internal class ImpressionCaptured internal constructor(
      val request: ImpressionCaptureRequest,
      val geometry: ImpressionSceneGeometry,
      val saa: ImpressionLumaReservoir,
      val sab: ImpressionLumaReservoir,
      val rotationDegrees: Int,
      val timestampNanos: Long,
  ) {
      init {
          require(saa.sourceRegion == geometry.saa) { "SAA pixels must match SAA geometry" }
          require(sab.sourceRegion == geometry.sab) { "SAB pixels must match SAB geometry" }
          require(rotationDegrees in VALID_ROTATION_DEGREES) {
              "Rotation degrees must be one of $VALID_ROTATION_DEGREES"
          }
      }
  
      private companion object {
          val VALID_ROTATION_DEGREES = setOf(0, 90, 180, 270)
      }
  }
  
  internal fun ImpressionCaptured.toPresentation(): ImpressionPresentation =
      ImpressionPresentation(
          generation = request.generation,
          correlationId = request.correlationId,
          geometry = geometry,
          saa = saa,
          sab = sab,
          rotationDegrees = rotationDegrees,
      )
  
  internal sealed interface ImpressionCaptureOutcome {
      val request: ImpressionCaptureRequest
  
      data class Captured(val impression: ImpressionCaptured) : ImpressionCaptureOutcome {
          override val request: ImpressionCaptureRequest = impression.request
      }
  
      data class Failed(
          override val request: ImpressionCaptureRequest,
          val reason: String,
      ) : ImpressionCaptureOutcome {
          init {
              require(reason.isNotBlank()) { "Impression capture failure reason must not be blank" }
          }
      }
  }
  
  /** Retained scene geometry in unrotated luma coordinates. */
  internal data class ImpressionSceneGeometry(
      val saa: SnapFrameRegion,
      val sab: SnapFrameRegion,
  )
  
  internal fun computeImpressionSceneGeometry(
      frameSize: SnapFrameSize,
      streamRoi: SnapFrameRegion,
  ): ImpressionSceneGeometry {
      require(streamRoi.fitsWithin(frameSize)) {
          "Stream ROI must fit within the source frame"
      }
  
      // Reservoir horizontal bounds: deterministic clamped integer equivalents of frame 20%..80%
      val x = (frameSize.width.toLong() * 20L / 100L).toInt()
      val right = (frameSize.width.toLong() * 80L / 100L).toInt()
      val width = right - x
  
      require(width > 0) { "Frame width $width is too small for 20%..80% reservoir" }
  
      // SAA extends from frame top to slit top
      require(streamRoi.y > 0) { "Slit is at y=${streamRoi.y}; SAA would be empty" }
      val saa = SnapFrameRegion(
          x = x,
          y = 0,
          width = width,
          height = streamRoi.y
      )
  
      // SAB extends from slit bottom to frame bottom
      val sabStart = streamRoi.y + streamRoi.height
      require(sabStart < frameSize.height) {
          "Slit bottom is at $sabStart; SAB would be empty in ${frameSize.height} frame"
      }
      val sab = SnapFrameRegion(
          x = x,
          y = sabStart,
          width = width,
          height = frameSize.height - sabStart
      )
  
      return ImpressionSceneGeometry(saa = saa, sab = sab)
  }

  package org.itroboc.app
  
  import org.itroboc.vision.BarcodeRoi
  import org.itroboc.vision.SnapFrameRegion
  import org.itroboc.vision.SnapFrameSize
  import java.nio.ByteBuffer
  
  internal fun captureImpressionOutcomeFromLumaPlaneBuffer(
      imageWidth: Int,
      imageHeight: Int,
      lumaBuffer: ByteBuffer,
      rowStride: Int,
      pixelStride: Int,
      rotationDegrees: Int,
      timestampNanos: Long,
      streamRoi: SnapFrameRegion,
      request: ImpressionCaptureRequest,
  ): ImpressionCaptureOutcome = try {
      ImpressionCaptureOutcome.Captured(
          captureImpressionFromLumaPlaneBuffer(
              imageWidth = imageWidth,
              imageHeight = imageHeight,
              lumaBuffer = lumaBuffer,
              rowStride = rowStride,
              pixelStride = pixelStride,
              rotationDegrees = rotationDegrees,
              timestampNanos = timestampNanos,
              streamRoi = streamRoi,
              request = request,
          ),
      )
  } catch (error: Exception) {
      ImpressionCaptureOutcome.Failed(
          request = request,
          reason = error.message ?: "Impression extraction failed",
      )
  }
  
  internal fun captureImpressionFromLumaPlaneBuffer(
      imageWidth: Int,
      imageHeight: Int,
      lumaBuffer: ByteBuffer,
      rowStride: Int,
      pixelStride: Int,
      rotationDegrees: Int,
      timestampNanos: Long,
      streamRoi: SnapFrameRegion,
      request: ImpressionCaptureRequest,
  ): ImpressionCaptured {
      val frameSize = SnapFrameSize(imageWidth, imageHeight)
      require(frameSize == request.sourceFrameSize) {
          "Impression frame dimensions changed after arming"
      }
      require(streamRoi == request.streamRoi) {
          "Impression Stream ROI changed after arming"
      }
      val geometry = computeImpressionSceneGeometry(frameSize, streamRoi)
      val saaImage = extractGrayImageFromLumaPlaneBuffer(
          imageWidth = imageWidth,
          imageHeight = imageHeight,
          lumaBuffer = lumaBuffer,
          rowStride = rowStride,
          pixelStride = pixelStride,
          roi = geometry.saa.toBarcodeRoi(),
      )
      val sabImage = extractGrayImageFromLumaPlaneBuffer(
          imageWidth = imageWidth,
          imageHeight = imageHeight,
          lumaBuffer = lumaBuffer,
          rowStride = rowStride,
          pixelStride = pixelStride,
          roi = geometry.sab.toBarcodeRoi(),
      )
      return ImpressionCaptured(
          request = request,
          geometry = geometry,
          saa = ImpressionLumaReservoir(geometry.saa, saaImage.pixels),
          sab = ImpressionLumaReservoir(geometry.sab, sabImage.pixels),
          rotationDegrees = rotationDegrees,
          timestampNanos = timestampNanos,
      )
  }
  
  internal fun processAdmittedStreamFrame(
      streamOutcome: StreamCameraScanOutcome,
      impressionRequest: ImpressionCaptureRequest?,
      publishStream: (StreamCameraScanOutcome) -> Unit,
      captureImpression: (ImpressionCaptureRequest) -> ImpressionCaptureOutcome,
      publishImpression: (ImpressionCaptureOutcome) -> Unit,
  ) {
      publishStream(streamOutcome)
      impressionRequest?.let { publishImpression(captureImpression(it)) }
  }
  
  private fun SnapFrameRegion.toBarcodeRoi(): BarcodeRoi =
      BarcodeRoi(x = x, y = y, width = width, height = height)

Response:
  # P2 — Impression pulse profiling and resource preparation
  
  Status: active design; execute P2-01a, P2-01b, P2-01c, then P2-02
  
  Phase: P2 — Profiling & Design
  
  ## Field question
  
  The four serial Stream lanes and visible Impression shell are field-tested. On
  the SM-T350, keeping Open Mind visible has no noticeable continuing cost, but
  the moment of becoming impressed causes a visible pulse:
  
  ```text
  qualifying live ADDED
  -> next-frame Impression capture
  -> SPS drops
  -> preview appears to lose focus
  -> SPS recovers gradually over about two seconds
  ```
  
  The pulse also occurs while Open Mind is closed and becomes especially severe
  when Beetle is reimpressed several times within one second.
  
  These observations do not establish that application work changes camera
  focus. They establish an Impression-correlated processing shock; apparent
  unfocus may be optical/framework behavior, preview irregularity, resource
  pressure, or a mixture.
  
  ## Current source-grounded path
  
  `ImpressionRetinalBridge` owns no thread. Its synchronized methods execute on
  the caller's lane:
  
  - Main arms or unimpresses through the bridge;
  - Analyzer consumes the one-shot request and submits the captured outcome;
  - the bridge enqueues that outcome to the BeetleMind lane.
  
  The current publication path is:
  
  ```text
  Analyzer
    captures SAA/SAB
          |
          v
  ImpressionRetinalBridge
    submits InstallImpression
          |
          v
  BeetleMind lane
    retains ImpressionCaptured as currentImpression
    selects and retains Food
    emits ImpressionPresentationUpdate.Present
          |
          v
  Main
    converts retained gray luma into display-owned ARGB arrays
    publishes Compose display snapshots
  ```
  
  BeetleMind already owns and retains the cognitive Impression. Main does not
  own that cognition, but the current presentation publication temporarily
  exposes the retained read-only luma reservoirs so Main can prepare display
  pixels.
  
  Current code performs several large operations around each reimpression:
  
  1. Analyzer allocates and fills SAA and SAB luma arrays.
  2. `ImpressionLumaReservoir` defensively copies both arrays again.
  3. BeetleMind selects Food into another retained luma array.
  4. Main copies/converts SAA, SAB, and Food into 4-byte ARGB arrays even when
     Open Mind is closed.
  5. When Open Mind is visible, Compose later creates display bitmaps.
  
  This makes a distributed allocation/copy pulse plausible. Measurement must
  separate Analyzer, BeetleMind, Main, and display costs rather than naming one
  culprit from SPS alone.
  
  ## Resource-preparation principle
  
  ITROBOC is not flight-control software and does not claim zero allocation.
  However, the live TD camera experience should follow the same useful instinct:
  
  > Prepare, size, and stabilize large resources while the application is
  > grounded; do not ask for another wing during a difficult frame.
  
  For P2, any application-owned hot-path allocation larger than **10 KiB** is a
  large allocation. It must be identified by the pulse audit and should be
  preallocated/reused when its maximum shape and lifetime can be made explicit.
  Exceptions require measured or simplicity/safety justification.
  
  The desired preparation point is as early as MainMenu when practical. Camera
  frame dimensions are currently learned only after CameraX begins producing
  frames, so early preparation requires one of these explicit contracts:
  
  - a bounded maximum supported frame shape and capacity-based storage; or
  - a one-time prepare/resize step when actual camera geometry first becomes
    known, before repeated Impression traffic begins.
  
  Do not hide resizing inside the Impression capture pulse.
  
  Reusable memory crosses lanes by exclusive ownership transfer, never as
  uncoordinated shared mutable arrays. Disposal may release application-owned
  resources; "never release" means stable for the owning live-session or
  process lifetime, not leakage beyond lifecycle ownership.
  
  ## Execution gait
  
  ```text
  P2-01a  generation-correlated pulse recorder
     ->
  P2-01b  compact cockpit IMP line
     ->
  P2-01c  SM-T350 open/closed and repeated-reimpression baseline
     ->
  P2-02   remove redundant luma copies
     ->
  repeat the same measurement
  ```
  
  After P2-02 evidence, choose rather than assume:
  
  ```text
  retinal allocation/copy still dominates
  -> design persistent retinal scene-slot exchange
  
  Main/display preparation dominates
  -> design a serial presentation-preparation owner
  
  post-pulse recovery remains poor
  -> test bounded Love Blinds admission
  
  pulse becomes acceptable
  -> stop optimizing and resume Phase I
  ```
  
  Analyzer, BeetleMind, and Telemetry are not default homes for presentation
  conversion. Analyzer owns perception and is already under investigation;
  BeetleMind must remain available for cognition; Telemetry is deliberately
  lossy and cannot own required presentation. A fifth serial presentation lane
  is therefore a coherent candidate, but P2 does not add it without evidence.
  
  ## Tickets
  
  - [`P2-01a`](P2-01a-impression-pulse-recorder.md) — record primitive spans and
    queue waits for one Impression generation.
  - [`P2-01b`](P2-01b-compact-impression-pulse-line.md) — expose the latest record
    as one temporary cockpit line.
  - [`P2-01c`](P2-01c-sm-t350-impression-pulse-baseline.md) — establish the
    physical open/closed and repeated-reimpression baseline.
  - [`P2-02`](P2-02-single-copy-impression-capture.md) — remove known redundant
    luma copies, then repeat the baseline.
  
  ## Non-goals for the first gait
  
  - no BSR, BCP, cognitive-board, or Snippet implementation;
  - no repair of Snap recognition;
  - no autofocus policy change;
  - no permanent fifth lane before measurement;
  - no Love Blinds implementation before the first post-P2-02 comparison;
  - no claim that framework, Compose, or CameraX performs zero allocations.

**Current status on `dev/calibrate`:**
It looks like we were in the middle of **P2-01a** or **P2-01b**. We need to measure *exactly* where the lag is coming from before we try to fix it. 

**Here is the plan for our "Calibration" flight:**

  # P2-01a — Generation-correlated Impression pulse recorder
  
  Status: open
  
  Phase: P2 — Profiling & Design
  
  Depends on: completed I-04e
  
  ## Goal
  
  Record one allocation-light, generation-correlated timeline that distinguishes
  queue/scheduling wait from execution work across the Impression acquisition
  and presentation path.
  
  ## Required behavior
  
  - Use monotonic primitive timestamps and bounded storage.
  - Correlate every record with Impression generation/correlation.
  - Record enough internal seams to derive at least:
    - Analyzer total tapped-frame time;
    - ordinary Stream decode time;
    - SAA/SAB capture time;
    - frame-release time;
    - retinal submission to Beetle start wait;
    - Beetle installation/Food work;
    - Beetle publication to Main receive wait;
    - Main scene and Food display preparation time;
    - first bitmap preparation time when Open Mind is visible, if that seam can
      be observed without coupling correctness to Compose.
  - Record the pre-Impression stable SPS sample and enough post-event samples to
    describe approximately three seconds of recovery.
  - Keep the recorder observational. Failure, overload, or disabled recording
    cannot delay or alter Stream, Impression correctness, or lifecycle.
  - Do not perform per-frame strings, logs, lists, or UI publication from the hot
    path. Formatting belongs to P2-01b.
  
  For each serial boundary:
  
  ```text
  submit -> start   = queue/scheduling wait
  start  -> finish  = owner execution time
  ```
  
  ## Acceptance
  
  - [ ] Deterministic tests prove generation correlation and derived durations.
  - [ ] Ordinary frames pay only the explicitly bounded recording cost.
  - [ ] Reimpression replaces/finishes records without mixing generations.
  - [ ] Reset, disposal, and rejected late work cannot publish a mixed record.
  - [ ] Recorder disable/overflow is harmless and does not backpressure any lane.
  - [ ] No performance cause is claimed from SPS alone.
  
  ## Boundary
  
  Land the measurement seam, not an optimization and not its cockpit rendering.
  P2-01b owns the compact visible line.

/**
 * allocation-light timestamps for one Impression generation.
 * All times are monotonic nanos unless specified.
 */
internal data class ImpressionPulseRecord(
    val generation: ImpressionGeneration,
    val correlationId: ImpressionCorrelationId,

    // Analyzer Lane
    var analyzerTappedFrameNanos: Long = 0L,
    var analyzerStreamDecodeDoneNanos: Long = 0L,
    var analyzerCaptureDoneNanos: Long = 0L,
    var analyzerFrameReleasedNanos: Long = 0L,
    
    // Retinal Bridge / Handoff
    var bridgeSubmitToBeetleNanos: Long = 0L,
    
    // BeetleMind Lane
    var beetleReceiveStartNanos: Long = 0L,
    var beetleInstallDoneNanos: Long = 0L,
    
    // Main Lane
    var mainReceiveNanos: Long = 0L,
    var mainDisplayPrepDoneNanos: Long = 0L,

    // Recovery
    var baselineSps: Double = 0.0,
    val recoverySpsSamples: MutableList<Double> = mutableListOf()
) {
    fun analyzerWorkNanos(): Long = analyzerCaptureDoneNanos - analyzerTappedFrameNanos
    fun bridgeWaitNanos(): Long = beetleReceiveStartNanos - bridgeSubmitToBeetleNanos
    fun beetleWorkNanos(): Long = beetleInstallDoneNanos - beetleReceiveStartNanos
    fun mainWaitNanos(): Long = mainReceiveNanos - beetleInstallDoneNanos
    fun mainWorkNanos(): Long = mainDisplayPrepDoneNanos - mainReceiveNanos
}
)

import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference

/**
 * Thread-safe flight recorder for Impression pulses.
 * Correlates by ImpressionGeneration; only the latest generation is tracked.
 */
internal class ImpressionPulseRecorder {
    private val currentRecord = AtomicReference<ImpressionPulseRecord?>(null)

    fun start(generation: ImpressionGeneration, correlationId: ImpressionCorrelationId, baselineSps: Double) {
        currentRecord.set(
            ImpressionPulseRecord(
                generation = generation,
                correlationId = correlationId,
                baselineSps = baselineSps
            )
        )
    }

    fun update(generation: ImpressionGeneration, block: (ImpressionPulseRecord) -> Unit) {
        val record = currentRecord.get()
        if (record?.generation == generation) {
            block(record)
        }
    }

    fun recordRecoverySample(generation: ImpressionGeneration, sps: Double) {
        update(generation) { it.recoverySpsSamples.add(sps) }
    }

    fun getLatest(): ImpressionPulseRecord? = currentRecord.get()

    fun clear() {
        currentRecord.set(null)
    }
}
)

  package org.itroboc.app
  
  /**
   * Thread-safe retinal handoff between Main's Impression trigger and the Analyzer/Beetle lanes.
   *
   * A reservation command is enqueued on the Beetle lane before its request becomes visible to
   * Analyzer. Captured outcomes then travel directly from Analyzer to that same lane without a
   * Main-executor hop.
   */
  internal class ImpressionRetinalBridge(
      private val submitToBeetle: (StreamBeetleCommand) -> Boolean,
  ) {
      private val captureGate = ImpressionCaptureGate()
      private val lifecycleLock = Any()
      private var closed = false
  
      fun arm(request: ImpressionCaptureRequest): Boolean = synchronized(lifecycleLock) {
          if (closed) return false
          if (!submitToBeetle(StreamBeetleCommand.ReserveImpression(request))) return false
  
          // The gate is private and close() shares this lock, so a successfully enqueued
          // reservation can be exposed without a reserve/install race or compensating cancellation.
          check(captureGate.arm(request)) {
              "Open Impression retinal bridge rejected an armed capture request"
          }
          true
      }
  
      /** Analyzer consumes at most one latest-wins request for the current frame. */
      fun consumeRequest(): ImpressionCaptureRequest? = captureGate.consume()
  
      /** Analyzer submits correctness traffic directly to the Beetle lane. */
      fun submitOutcome(outcome: ImpressionCaptureOutcome): Boolean =
          synchronized(lifecycleLock) {
              if (closed) return false
              submitToBeetle(StreamBeetleCommand.InstallImpression(outcome))
          }
  
      /** Clears pending retinal work and orders Beetle unimpress before any later outcome. */
      fun unimpress(): Boolean = synchronized(lifecycleLock) {
          if (closed) return false
          captureGate.clear()
          submitToBeetle(StreamBeetleCommand.Unimpress)
      }
  
      /** Permanently rejects new requests and late outcomes after owner disposal. */
      fun close() {
          synchronized(lifecycleLock) {
              if (closed) return
              closed = true
              captureGate.close()
          }
      }
  }
