  package org.itroboc.app
  
  import android.util.Log
  import androidx.camera.core.CameraSelector
  import androidx.camera.core.ImageAnalysis
  import androidx.camera.core.Preview
  import androidx.camera.lifecycle.ProcessCameraProvider
  import androidx.camera.view.PreviewView
  import androidx.compose.foundation.background
  import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Box
  import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.fillMaxSize
  import androidx.compose.material3.MaterialTheme
  import androidx.compose.material3.Text
  import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
  import androidx.compose.runtime.DisposableEffect
  import androidx.compose.runtime.getValue
  import androidx.compose.runtime.remember
  import androidx.compose.runtime.rememberUpdatedState
  import androidx.compose.ui.Alignment
  import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
  import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color
  import androidx.compose.ui.platform.LocalContext
  import androidx.compose.ui.platform.LocalInspectionMode
  import androidx.compose.ui.viewinterop.AndroidView
  import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat
  import androidx.lifecycle.compose.LocalLifecycleOwner
  import org.itroboc.vision.BarcodeRoi
  import org.itroboc.vision.SnapFrameRegion
  import java.util.concurrent.Executors
  
  @Composable
  internal fun BarcodeCameraScanner(
      consumeScanRequest: () -> Boolean,
      frameDecoder: CameraFrameDecoder,
      onScanProcessed: (StreamCameraScanOutcome) -> Unit,
      canAcceptStreamFrame: () -> Boolean = { true },
      streamResultDelivery: StreamResultDelivery = StreamResultDelivery.MAIN,
      captureRoiPreview: Boolean = false,
      snapCaptureGate: SnapCaptureGate? = null,
      onSnapCaptureOutcome: (SnapFrameCaptureOutcome) -> Unit = {},
      impressionRetinalBridge: ImpressionRetinalBridge? = null,
      modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
      guideSpec: CameraScanGuideSpec = barcodeScanGuideSpec,
  ) {
      if (LocalInspectionMode.current) {
          InStudioPreview(modifier)
          return
      }
  
      val lifecycleOwner = LocalLifecycleOwner.current
      val context = LocalContext.current
      val cameraProviderFuture = remember { ProcessCameraProvider.getInstance(context) }
      val previewView = remember {
          PreviewView(context).apply {
              scaleType = PreviewView.ScaleType.FILL_CENTER
          }
      }
      val mainExecutor = remember(context) { ContextCompat.getMainExecutor(context) }
      val analysisExecutor = remember {
          Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor { runnable ->
              Thread(runnable, "ITROBOC-Analyzer").apply { isDaemon = true }
          }
      }
      val currentConsumeScanRequest by rememberUpdatedState(consumeScanRequest)
      val currentCanAcceptStreamFrame by rememberUpdatedState(canAcceptStreamFrame)
      val currentOnScanProcessed by rememberUpdatedState(onScanProcessed)
      val currentOnSnapCaptureOutcome by rememberUpdatedState(onSnapCaptureOutcome)
      val currentCaptureRoiPreview by rememberUpdatedState(captureRoiPreview)
      val currentGuideSpec by rememberUpdatedState(guideSpec)
  
      DisposableEffect(
          lifecycleOwner,
          cameraProviderFuture,
          analysisExecutor,
          frameDecoder,
          snapCaptureGate,
          impressionRetinalBridge,
          streamResultDelivery,
      ) {
          var reusableRoiPixels = ByteArray(0)
  
          cameraProviderFuture.addListener({
              val cameraProvider = cameraProviderFuture.get()
              val preview = Preview.Builder().build().also {
                  it.setSurfaceProvider(previewView.surfaceProvider)
              }
              val imageAnalysis = ImageAnalysis.Builder()
                  .setBackpressureStrategy(ImageAnalysis.STRATEGY_KEEP_ONLY_LATEST)
                  .build()
  
              imageAnalysis.setAnalyzer(analysisExecutor) { imageProxy ->
                  imageProxy.use {
                      when (
                          val route = snapCaptureGate?.routeNextFrame()
                              ?: CameraFrameRoute.Stream(StreamEvidenceEpoch(1L))
                      ) {
                          is CameraFrameRoute.Stream -> {
                              if (
                                  currentCanAcceptStreamFrame() &&
                                  currentConsumeScanRequest()
                              ) {
                                  val roi = centeredBarcodeRoi(
                                      imageWidth = imageProxy.width,
                                      imageHeight = imageProxy.height,
                                      guideSpec = currentGuideSpec,
                                  )
                                  val requiredSize = roi.width * roi.height
                                  if (reusableRoiPixels.size != requiredSize) {
                                      reusableRoiPixels = ByteArray(requiredSize)
                                  }
  
                                  val scanOutcome = frameDecoder.decode(
                                      imageProxy = imageProxy,
                                      roi = roi,
                                      reusablePixels = reusableRoiPixels,
                                      captureRoiPreview = currentCaptureRoiPreview,
                                  )
                                  val result = StreamCameraScanOutcome(route.epoch, scanOutcome)
                                  processAdmittedStreamFrame(
                                      streamOutcome = result,
                                      impressionRequest = impressionRetinalBridge?.consumeRequest(),
                                      publishStream = { outcome ->
                                          when (streamResultDelivery) {
                                              StreamResultDelivery.ANALYZER -> currentOnScanProcessed(outcome)
                                              StreamResultDelivery.MAIN -> {
                                                  mainExecutor.execute {
                                                      currentOnScanProcessed(outcome)
                                                  }
                                              }
                                          }
                                      },
                                      captureImpression = { impressionRequest ->
                                          val lumaPlane = imageProxy.planes.firstOrNull()
                                          if (lumaPlane == null) {
                                              ImpressionCaptureOutcome.Failed(
                                                  request = impressionRequest,
                                                  reason = "Camera frame does not expose a luma plane",
                                              )
                                          } else {
                                              captureImpressionOutcomeFromLumaPlaneBuffer(
                                                  imageWidth = imageProxy.width,
                                                  imageHeight = imageProxy.height,
                                                  lumaBuffer = lumaPlane.buffer,
                                                  rowStride = lumaPlane.rowStride,
                                                  pixelStride = lumaPlane.pixelStride,
                                                  rotationDegrees = imageProxy.imageInfo.rotationDegrees,
                                                  timestampNanos = imageProxy.imageInfo.timestamp,
                                                  streamRoi = roi.toSnapFrameRegion(),
                                                  request = impressionRequest,
                                              )
                                          }
                                      },
                                      publishImpression = { outcome ->
                                          impressionRetinalBridge?.submitOutcome(outcome)
                                      },
                                  )
                              }
                          }
                          is CameraFrameRoute.Capture -> {
                              val captureOutcome = captureSnapFrame(imageProxy, route.request)
                              mainExecutor.execute {
                                  currentOnSnapCaptureOutcome(captureOutcome)
                              }
                          }
                          CameraFrameRoute.Paused -> Unit
                      }
                  }
              }
  
              try {
                  cameraProvider.unbindAll()
                  cameraProvider.bindToLifecycle(
                      lifecycleOwner,
                      CameraSelector.DEFAULT_BACK_CAMERA,
                      preview,
                      imageAnalysis,
                  )
              } catch (error: Exception) {
                  Log.e(CAMERA_PREVIEW_LOG_TAG, "Use case binding failed", error)
              }
          }, mainExecutor)
  
          onDispose {
              runCatching {
                  cameraProviderFuture.get().unbindAll()
              }.onFailure { error ->
                  Log.w(CAMERA_PREVIEW_LOG_TAG, "Failed to unbind camera on dispose", error)
              }
              analysisExecutor.shutdown()
          }
      }
  
      AndroidView(
          factory = { previewView },
          modifier = modifier,
      )
  }
  
  internal enum class StreamResultDelivery {
      MAIN,
      ANALYZER,
  }
  
  @Composable
  private fun InStudioPreview(
      modifier: Modifier,
  ) {
      Box(
          modifier = modifier
              .fillMaxSize()
              .background(Color.DarkGray),
          contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
      ) {
          Text("\n\nCamera Scanner Preview", color = Color.White)
      }
  }
  
  private fun BarcodeRoi.toSnapFrameRegion(): SnapFrameRegion =
      SnapFrameRegion(x, y, width, height)
  
  private const val CAMERA_PREVIEW_LOG_TAG = "CameraPreview"
  
  @androidx.compose.ui.tooling.preview.Preview(showBackground = true)
  @Composable
  private fun BarcodeCameraScannerPreview() {
      MaterialTheme {
          BarcodeCameraScanner(
              consumeScanRequest = { true },
              frameDecoder = remember { CameraFrameDecoder() },
              onScanProcessed = {},
              modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()
          )
      }
  }

  package org.itroboc.app
  
  import androidx.compose.runtime.*
  import org.itroboc.core.*
  import org.itroboc.vision.*
  import kotlinx.coroutines.*
  import java.util.concurrent.Executor
  import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong
  
  internal class EditBoardController(
      private var onBoardEditStateChange: (BoardEditState) -> Unit,
      private val nowMillis: () -> Long = System::currentTimeMillis,
      private val snapScope: CoroutineScope = CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Dispatchers.Default),
      private val snapProcessingDispatcher: CoroutineDispatcher = Dispatchers.Default,
      private val snapDelay: suspend (Long) -> Unit = { delay(it) },
      private val snapFrameProcessor: SnapFrameAnalyzer = SnapFrameProcessor(),
      private val mainExecutor: Executor = Executor(Runnable::run),
      telemetryLaneFactory: StreamTelemetryLaneFactory = InlineStreamTelemetryLane.FACTORY,
      beetleLaneFactory: StreamBeetleLaneFactory = InlineStreamBeetleLane.FACTORY,
  ) {
      val diagnostics = EditBoardDiagnosticState()
      val snapCaptureGate = SnapCaptureGate()
  
      private val nextSnapCorrelationId = AtomicLong(1L)
      private val nextImpressionGeneration = AtomicLong(1L)
      private val nextImpressionCorrelationId = AtomicLong(1L)
  
      private var diagnosticSnapCaptureModeActive = false
      private var snapLifecycleJob: Job? = null
  
      private val streamConfigurationStore = StreamBeetleConfigurationStore()
  
      val streamMainHandoffGate = StreamMainHandoffGate()
  
      var streamTelemetrySnapshot by mutableStateOf(
          StreamTelemetrySnapshot(scansPerSecond = 0.0, outstandingMainCallbacks = 0),
      )
          private set
  
      private val streamTelemetryLane = telemetryLaneFactory.create(
          initialTimestampMillis = nowMillis(),
          outstandingMainCallbacks = streamMainHandoffGate::outstandingCallbacks,
          mainExecutor = mainExecutor,
          onSnapshot = { streamTelemetrySnapshot = it },
      )
  
      private val streamBeetleLane = beetleLaneFactory.create(
          nowMillis = nowMillis,
          mainExecutor = mainExecutor,
          mainHandoffGate = streamMainHandoffGate,
          isFrameCurrent = snapCaptureGate::accepts,
          onPublication = ::publishBeetlePublication,
      )
  
      val impressionRetinalBridge = ImpressionRetinalBridge(streamBeetleLane::submitControl)
  
      private var lastSubmittedMindStatus: BeetleOperationalStatus? = null
      private var lastSubmittedFoodConfiguration: StreamConfigurationGeneration? = null
  
      // --- Inputs updated every recomposition ---
      var boardEditState by mutableStateOf(BoardEditState(0))
      var deckProfile by mutableStateOf(BuiltInDeckProfiles.defaultProfile())
      var orientationMode by mutableStateOf(BarcodeOrientationMode.BRM)
      var requiredConsensusFrames by mutableIntStateOf(TdSessionState.DEFAULT_CONSENSUS_FRAMES)
      var feedMode by mutableStateOf(TdFeedMode.STREAM)
          private set
      var snapFinderSettings by mutableStateOf(HorizontalSnapCandidateFinderSettings())
          private set
      var snapProcessingDeadlineMillis by mutableLongStateOf(
          DEFAULT_SNAP_PROCESSING_DEADLINE_MILLIS,
      )
          private set
      var snapScanState by mutableStateOf<SnapScanState>(
          SnapScanState.Streaming(snapCaptureGate.currentEpoch()),
      )
          private set
  
      // --- UI Visibility / Operational Status ---
      var hasCameraPermission by mutableStateOf(true)
          private set
      var showScissorsScreen by mutableStateOf(false)
          private set
      var showSwapScreen by mutableStateOf(false)
          private set
      private var liveCentralAreaVisible = true
  
      fun updateScissorsVisible(show: Boolean) {
          showScissorsScreen = show
          updateMindStatus()
      }
  
      fun updateSwapVisible(show: Boolean) {
          showSwapScreen = show
          updateMindStatus()
      }
  
      /** A hidden live CentralArea cannot retain cognition from its former scene. */
      fun updateLiveCentralAreaVisibility(visible: Boolean) {
          if (liveCentralAreaVisible && !visible) unimpress()
          liveCentralAreaVisible = visible
      }
  
      // --- Performance State ---
  
      // --- Scan State ---
      var lastResultMessage by mutableStateOf<String?>(null)
      var lastScannedCard by mutableStateOf<CardId?>(null)
      var thoughts by mutableStateOf(BeetleThought.Blank.presentation)
      private val impressionDisplayState = ImpressionDisplayState()
      private val foodDisplayState = FoodDisplayState()
      var impressionPresentation by mutableStateOf<ImpressionDisplaySnapshot?>(null)
          private set
      var foodPresentation by mutableStateOf<FoodDisplaySnapshot?>(null)
          private set
  
      fun update(
          state: BoardEditState,
          profile: DeckProfile,
          mode: BarcodeOrientationMode,
          requiredConsensusFrames: Int,
          snapFinderSettings: HorizontalSnapCandidateFinderSettings = this.snapFinderSettings,
          snapProcessingDeadlineMillis: Long = this.snapProcessingDeadlineMillis,
          hasCameraPermission: Boolean,
          onBoardEditStateChange: (BoardEditState) -> Unit,
      ) {
          require(snapProcessingDeadlineMillis % 1_000L == 0L)
          require(
              snapProcessingDeadlineMillis / 1_000L in
                  SnapTuningSettings.DEADLINE_SECONDS_VALUES.map(Int::toLong),
          ) { "Snap processing deadline is outside the exposed range" }
          val activeCorrelation = snapScanState.correlationOrNull()
          if (activeCorrelation != null && state.boardNumber != activeCorrelation.boardNumber) {
              cancelSnapLifecycle()
          }
          if (
              state.boardNumber != boardEditState.boardNumber ||
              state.boardState != boardEditState.boardState ||
              state.selectedSeat != boardEditState.selectedSeat ||
              profile != deckProfile
          ) {
              unimpress()
          }
          boardEditState = state
          deckProfile = profile
          orientationMode = mode
          this.requiredConsensusFrames = requiredConsensusFrames
          val streamConfiguration = streamConfigurationStore.update(
              deckProfile = profile,
              orientationMode = mode,
              requiredConsensusFrames = requiredConsensusFrames,
          )
          if (streamConfiguration.generation != lastSubmittedFoodConfiguration) {
              if (
                  streamBeetleLane.submitControl(
                      StreamBeetleCommand.ObserveFoodConfiguration(
                          orientationMode = streamConfiguration.orientationMode,
                          generation = streamConfiguration.generation,
                      ),
                  )
              ) {
                  lastSubmittedFoodConfiguration = streamConfiguration.generation
              }
          }
          this.snapFinderSettings = snapFinderSettings
          this.snapProcessingDeadlineMillis = snapProcessingDeadlineMillis
          this.hasCameraPermission = hasCameraPermission
          this.onBoardEditStateChange = onBoardEditStateChange
          streamTelemetryLane.setBoardScanned(
              BoardProgressSummary.from(state.boardState).boardScanned,
          )
          updateMindStatus()
      }
  
      private fun updateMindStatus() {
          val status = BeetleOperationalStatus(
              hasCameraPermission = hasCameraPermission,
              isScissorsOpen = showScissorsScreen,
              isSwapOpen = showSwapScreen,
              isBoardScanned = BoardProgressSummary.from(boardEditState.boardState).boardScanned
          )
          if (status == lastSubmittedMindStatus) return
          lastSubmittedMindStatus = status
          streamBeetleLane.submitControl(StreamBeetleCommand.ObserveStatus(status))
      }
  
      fun dream(topic: BeetleDream) {
          streamBeetleLane.submitControl(StreamBeetleCommand.Dream(topic))
      }
  
      fun canAcceptStreamFrame(): Boolean = streamBeetleLane.hasFrameCapacity()
  
      fun handleCameraScan(streamOutcome: StreamCameraScanOutcome) {
          if (!snapCaptureGate.accepts(streamOutcome.epoch)) return
          handleAdmittedCameraScan(streamOutcome)
      }
  
      internal fun handleCameraScan(scanOutcome: CameraScanOutcome) {
          handleCameraScan(
              StreamCameraScanOutcome(
                  epoch = snapCaptureGate.currentEpoch(),
                  outcome = scanOutcome,
              ),
          )
      }
  
      private fun handleAdmittedCameraScan(streamOutcome: StreamCameraScanOutcome) {
          val envelope = StreamFrameEnvelope(
              streamOutcome = streamOutcome,
              configuration = streamConfigurationStore.snapshot(),
              observedAtMillis = nowMillis(),
          )
          streamTelemetryLane.recordScan(envelope.observedAtMillis)
          streamBeetleLane.submitFrame(envelope)
      }
  
      private fun publishBeetlePublication(publication: StreamBeetlePublication) {
          diagnostics.observeRoiPreview(publication.roiPreview)
          publication.mindOutput?.let { output ->
              thoughts = output.snapshot.presentation
              output.acceptedCardScan?.let(::applyAcceptedCardScan)
          }
          val updatesRetainedScene =
              publication.impressionUpdate != null || publication.foodUpdate != null
          publication.impressionUpdate?.let(::applyImpressionPresentationUpdate)
          if (updatesRetainedScene) {
              foodPresentation = foodDisplayState.apply(
                  sceneSnapshot = impressionPresentation,
                  update = publication.foodUpdate,
              )
          }
      }
  
      private fun applyImpressionPresentationUpdate(update: ImpressionPresentationUpdate) {
          impressionPresentation = impressionDisplayState.apply(update)
      }
  
      private fun applyAcceptedCardScan(scan: AcceptedCardScan) {
          val isBoardScanned = BoardProgressSummary.from(boardEditState.boardState).boardScanned
          if (isBoardScanned) return
  
          val targetSeat = boardEditState.selectedSeat
  
          val update = EditBoardReducer.applyScannedCard(
              editState = boardEditState,
              card = scan.cardId,
              signature = scan.rawSignature,
          )
  
          emitBoardEditState(update.state)
          lastResultMessage = update.message
          if (update.lastScannedCard != null) {
              lastScannedCard = update.lastScannedCard
          }
  
          val targetHandComplete = update.state.boardState.handOf(targetSeat).isComplete()
  
          // A complete target hand makes every retained follow-up inference stale.
          if (targetHandComplete) {
              unimpress()
          } else if (
              qualifiesForImpressionCapture(
                  disposition = update.disposition,
                  provenance = scan.provenance,
                  targetHandComplete = targetHandComplete,
              )
          ) {
              armImpressionCapture(scan, targetSeat)
          }
  
          if (
              (feedMode == TdFeedMode.SNAP || diagnosticSnapCaptureModeActive) &&
              update.disposition == ScannedCardDisposition.ADDED &&
              !targetHandComplete
          ) {
              val isDiagnosticCapture = diagnosticSnapCaptureModeActive
              armSnapCapture(
                  scan = scan,
                  targetSeat = targetSeat,
                  correlation = if (isDiagnosticCapture) null else SnapBoardCorrelation(
                      boardNumber = update.state.boardNumber,
                      boardStateAfterSeed = update.state.boardState,
                      targetSeat = targetSeat,
                  ),
              )
          }
      }
  
      private fun setDiagnosticSnapCaptureModeActive(active: Boolean) {
          val wasActive = diagnosticSnapCaptureModeActive
          diagnosticSnapCaptureModeActive = active
          if (wasActive && !active) {
              resumeStreamWithoutResult()
          }
      }
  
      fun selectFeedMode(mode: TdFeedMode) {
          feedMode = mode
          if (mode == TdFeedMode.STREAM) {
              cancelSnapLifecycle()
          }
      }
  
      internal fun armDiagnosticSnapFixtureExport(): Boolean {
          val armed = diagnostics.armSnapFixtureExport(
              hasExplicitOrientation = orientationMode != BarcodeOrientationMode.AUTO,
          )
          if (armed) {
              setDiagnosticSnapCaptureModeActive(true)
          }
          return armed
      }
  
      internal fun cancelDiagnosticSnapFixtureExport() {
          setDiagnosticSnapCaptureModeActive(false)
          diagnostics.cancelSnapFixtureExport()
      }
  
      internal fun handleDiagnosticSnapCapture(outcome: SnapFrameCaptureOutcome): String? {
          if (diagnostics.snapFixtureExportState !is SnapFixtureExportState.Armed) {
              return null
          }
          setDiagnosticSnapCaptureModeActive(false)
          return diagnostics.acceptSnapCapture(outcome)
      }
  
      internal fun handleSnapCapture(outcome: SnapFrameCaptureOutcome) {
          val armed = snapScanState as? SnapScanState.Armed ?: return
          if (outcome.request.correlationId != armed.request.correlationId) return
  
          when (outcome) {
              is SnapFrameCaptureOutcome.Failed -> {
                  lastResultMessage = "Snap capture failed: ${outcome.reason}"
                  resumeStreamWithoutResult()
              }
              is SnapFrameCaptureOutcome.Captured -> beginSnapProcessing(outcome.frame, armed.correlation)
          }
      }
  
      private fun armImpressionCapture(
          scan: AcceptedCardScan,
          targetSeat: Seat,
      ) {
          val request = ImpressionCaptureRequest(
              generation = ImpressionGeneration(nextImpressionGeneration.getAndIncrement()),
              correlationId = ImpressionCorrelationId(nextImpressionCorrelationId.getAndIncrement()),
              seedCardId = scan.cardId,
              seedSignature = scan.rawSignature,
              targetSeat = targetSeat,
              boardNumber = boardEditState.boardNumber,
              orientationMode = orientationMode,
              configurationGeneration = streamConfigurationStore.snapshot().generation,
              sourceFrameSize = scan.sourceFrameSize,
              streamRoi = SnapFrameRegion(
                  x = scan.streamRoi.x,
                  y = scan.streamRoi.y,
                  width = scan.streamRoi.width,
                  height = scan.streamRoi.height,
              ),
          )
          impressionRetinalBridge.arm(request)
      }
  
      private fun armSnapCapture(
          scan: AcceptedCardScan,
          targetSeat: Seat,
          correlation: SnapBoardCorrelation?,
      ) {
          val searchDirection = orientationMode.snapSearchDirection() ?: return
          val candidateRegion = selectSnapSearchRegion(
              frameSize = scan.sourceFrameSize,
              streamRoi = scan.streamRoi,
              direction = searchDirection,
          )
          val request = SnapCaptureRequest(
                  correlationId = SnapCaptureCorrelationId(nextSnapCorrelationId.getAndIncrement()),
                  sourceFrameSize = scan.sourceFrameSize,
                  streamRoi = SnapFrameRegion(
                      x = scan.streamRoi.x,
                      y = scan.streamRoi.y,
                      width = scan.streamRoi.width,
                      height = scan.streamRoi.height,
                  ),
                  candidateRegion = candidateRegion,
                  searchDirection = searchDirection,
                  seed = SnapCaptureSeed(
                      rawSignature = scan.rawSignature,
                      cardId = scan.cardId,
                      confidence = scan.confidence,
                      widthEvidence = scan.seedWidthEvidence,
                      detectionBounds = scan.detectionBounds,
                  ),
                  targetSeat = targetSeat,
              )
          if (snapCaptureGate.arm(request) && correlation != null) {
              snapScanState = SnapScanState.Armed(request, correlation)
          }
      }
  
      private fun beginSnapProcessing(
          frame: SnapFrameCaptured,
          correlation: SnapBoardCorrelation,
      ) {
          val capturedAtMillis = nowMillis()
          val profileSnapshot = deckProfile
          val orientationSnapshot = orientationMode
          val finderSettingsSnapshot = snapFinderSettings
          val processingDeadlineSnapshotMillis = snapProcessingDeadlineMillis
          val runSettingsSnapshot = SnapRunSettingsSnapshot(
              requiredConsensusFrames = requiredConsensusFrames,
              orientationMode = orientationSnapshot,
              finderSettings = finderSettingsSnapshot,
              processingDeadlineMillis = processingDeadlineSnapshotMillis,
          )
          val deadlineAtMillis = capturedAtMillis + processingDeadlineSnapshotMillis
          snapScanState = SnapScanState.Processing(
              frame = frame,
              correlation = correlation,
              capturedAtMillis = capturedAtMillis,
              deadlineAtMillis = deadlineAtMillis,
          )
          snapLifecycleJob?.cancel()
          snapLifecycleJob = snapScope.launch {
              try {
                  val processingContext = currentCoroutineContext()
                  val analysis = withContext(snapProcessingDispatcher) {
                      snapFrameProcessor.process(
                          frame = frame,
                          deckProfile = profileSnapshot,
                          orientationMode = orientationSnapshot,
                          finderSettings = finderSettingsSnapshot,
                          workSignal = SnapCandidateWorkSignal {
                              processingContext.isActive && nowMillis() < deadlineAtMillis
                          },
                      )
                  }
                  ensureActive()
                  completeSnapProcessing(
                      frame = frame,
                      correlation = correlation,
                      capturedAtMillis = capturedAtMillis,
                      settingsSnapshot = runSettingsSnapshot,
                      analysis = analysis,
                  )
              } catch (cancellation: CancellationException) {
                  throw cancellation
              } catch (failure: Throwable) {
                  if (snapScanState.matches(frame.request.correlationId)) {
                      lastResultMessage = "Snap analysis failed: ${failure.message ?: "unknown error"}"
                      resumeStreamWithoutResult()
                  }
              }
          }
      }
  
      private suspend fun completeSnapProcessing(
          frame: SnapFrameCaptured,
          correlation: SnapBoardCorrelation,
          capturedAtMillis: Long,
          settingsSnapshot: SnapRunSettingsSnapshot,
          analysis: SnapFrameAnalysis,
      ) {
          if (!snapScanState.matches(frame.request.correlationId)) return
          if (!boardCorrelationMatches(correlation)) {
              lastResultMessage = "Snap result discarded: board changed during processing."
              resumeStreamWithoutResult()
              return
          }
  
          val knownCandidates = analysis.resolved.candidates
              .filterIsInstance<ResolvedSnapCandidate.Known>()
          val batchUpdate = EditBoardReducer.applySnapCardBatch(
              editState = boardEditState,
              targetSeat = correlation.targetSeat,
              cards = knownCandidates.map { it.cardId },
          )
          if (batchUpdate.state != boardEditState) {
              emitBoardEditState(batchUpdate.state)
          }
  
          val outcomesByCard = batchUpdate.outcomes.associateBy(SnapCardApplyOutcome::card)
          val marks = knownCandidates.mapNotNull { candidate ->
              val outcome = outcomesByCard[candidate.cardId] ?: return@mapNotNull null
              when (outcome) {
                  is SnapCardApplyOutcome.Added,
                  is SnapCardApplyOutcome.AlreadyInTarget,
                  is SnapCardApplyOutcome.InOtherSeat,
                  -> SnapPresentationMark(
                      card = candidate.cardId,
                      bounds = candidate.fullFrameBounds,
                      outcome = outcome,
                  )
                  is SnapCardApplyOutcome.CapacityBlocked -> null
              }
          }
          val presentation = SnapResultPresentation(
              frame = frame,
              marks = marks,
              summary = SnapResultSummary(
                  addedCount = batchUpdate.outcomes.count { it is SnapCardApplyOutcome.Added },
                  alreadyInTargetCount = batchUpdate.outcomes.count {
                      it is SnapCardApplyOutcome.AlreadyInTarget
                  },
                  inOtherSeatCount = batchUpdate.outcomes.count { it is SnapCardApplyOutcome.InOtherSeat },
                  capacityBlockedCount = batchUpdate.outcomes.count {
                      it is SnapCardApplyOutcome.CapacityBlocked
                  },
                  unknownCount = analysis.resolved.candidates.count {
                      it is ResolvedSnapCandidate.Unknown
                  },
                  ambiguousCount = analysis.resolved.candidates.count {
                      it is ResolvedSnapCandidate.Ambiguous
                  },
                  completed = analysis.resolved.completed,
              ),
          )
          val completedAtMillis = nowMillis()
          diagnostics.recordProcessedSnap(
              SnapRunEvidence(
                  boardNumber = correlation.boardNumber,
                  frame = frame,
                  settings = settingsSnapshot,
                  timings = analysis.timings,
                  presentation = presentation,
              ),
          )
          val resumeAtMillis = maxOf(
              capturedAtMillis + SNAP_MIN_FREEZE_MILLIS,
              completedAtMillis + SNAP_RESULT_DWELL_MILLIS,
          )
          snapScanState = SnapScanState.ShowingResult(
              presentation = presentation,
              correlation = correlation,
              resumeAtMillis = resumeAtMillis,
          )
          lastResultMessage = presentation.summary.toStatusMessage()
  
          val remainingMillis = (resumeAtMillis - nowMillis()).coerceAtLeast(0L)
          snapDelay(remainingMillis)
          currentCoroutineContext().ensureActive()
          if (snapScanState.matches(frame.request.correlationId)) {
              resumeStreamWithoutResult()
          }
      }
  
      private fun boardCorrelationMatches(correlation: SnapBoardCorrelation): Boolean =
          boardEditState.boardNumber == correlation.boardNumber &&
              boardEditState.boardState == correlation.boardStateAfterSeed
  
      internal fun cancelSnapLifecycle() {
          snapLifecycleJob?.cancel()
          snapLifecycleJob = null
          if (snapScanState !is SnapScanState.Streaming || !snapCaptureGate.isStreaming()) {
              resumeStreamWithoutResult()
          }
      }
  
      private fun resumeStreamWithoutResult() {
          snapLifecycleJob?.cancel()
          snapLifecycleJob = null
          snapScanState = SnapScanState.Streaming(snapCaptureGate.resumeStream())
      }
  
      private fun emitBoardEditState(state: BoardEditState) {
          boardEditState = state
          streamTelemetryLane.setBoardScanned(
              BoardProgressSummary.from(state.boardState).boardScanned,
          )
          onBoardEditStateChange(state)
      }
  
      fun onSeatClick(seat: Seat) {
          if (seat != boardEditState.selectedSeat) {
              unimpress()
          }
          val nextBoardEditState = boardEditState.copy(selectedSeat = seat)
          val update = EditBoardReducer.tryAutoFillFourthHand(nextBoardEditState)
          emitBoardEditState(update.state)
          if (update.message != null) {
              lastResultMessage = update.message
          }
          updateMindStatus()
      }
  
      fun onClearHand() {
          val selectedHand = boardEditState.boardState.handOf(boardEditState.selectedSeat)
          if (selectedHand.count() > 0) {
              unimpress()
              val update = EditBoardReducer.clearSelectedHand(boardEditState)
              emitBoardEditState(update.state)
              lastResultMessage = update.message
              lastScannedCard = null
          }
      }
  
      fun onClearBoard() {
          unimpress()
          val update = EditBoardReducer.clearBoard(boardEditState)
          emitBoardEditState(update.state)
          lastResultMessage = update.message
          lastScannedCard = null
      }
  
      fun onUndo() {
          unimpress()
          val update = EditBoardReducer.undoAddForSelectedHand(boardEditState)
          emitBoardEditState(update.state)
          lastResultMessage = update.message
      }
  
      fun onRemoveCard(card: CardId) {
          unimpress()
          val update = EditBoardReducer.removeCardFromSelectedHand(boardEditState, card)
          emitBoardEditState(update.state)
          lastResultMessage = update.message
      }
  
      fun onManualAddCard(card: CardId) {
          unimpress()
          val update = EditBoardReducer.addManualCardToSelectedHand(boardEditState, card)
          emitBoardEditState(update.state)
          lastResultMessage = update.message
          if (update.lastScannedCard != null) {
              lastScannedCard = update.lastScannedCard
          }
      }
  
      fun onSwapHands(targetSeat: Seat) {
          unimpress()
          val update = EditBoardReducer.swapSelectedHandWith(boardEditState, targetSeat)
          emitBoardEditState(update.state)
          lastResultMessage = update.message
      }
  
      fun onConfirmDuplicate() {
          unimpress()
          val update = EditBoardReducer.confirmDuplicateOverride(boardEditState)
          emitBoardEditState(update.state)
          lastResultMessage = update.message
      }
  
      fun closeStreamLanes() {
          impressionRetinalBridge.close()
          streamTelemetryLane.close()
          streamBeetleLane.close()
      }
  
      private fun unimpress() {
          impressionRetinalBridge.unimpress()
      }
  }
  
  private fun SnapScanState.correlationOrNull(): SnapBoardCorrelation? = when (this) {
      is SnapScanState.Streaming -> null
      is SnapScanState.Armed -> correlation
      is SnapScanState.Processing -> correlation
      is SnapScanState.ShowingResult -> correlation
  }
  
  private fun SnapScanState.matches(correlationId: SnapCaptureCorrelationId): Boolean = when (this) {
      is SnapScanState.Streaming -> false
      is SnapScanState.Armed -> request.correlationId == correlationId
      is SnapScanState.Processing -> frame.request.correlationId == correlationId
      is SnapScanState.ShowingResult -> presentation.frame.request.correlationId == correlationId
  }
  
  private fun SnapResultSummary.toStatusMessage(): String = buildString {
      append(if (completed) "Snap complete" else "Snap partial")
      append(": $addedCount added, $alreadyInTargetCount already present")
      if (inOtherSeatCount > 0) append(", $inOtherSeatCount in another hand")
      if (capacityBlockedCount > 0) append(", $capacityBlockedCount capacity-blocked")
      if (unknownCount > 0) append(", $unknownCount unknown")
      if (ambiguousCount > 0) append(", $ambiguousCount ambiguous")
      append('.')
  }
  
  internal fun CameraScanOutcome.toBeetleEvidence(
      profile: DeckProfile,
      orientationMode: BarcodeOrientationMode,
      provenance: BeetleEvidenceProvenance,
  ): BeetleEvidence? = when (this) {
      is CameraScanOutcome.Decoded -> when (val result = decodeResult) {
          is BarcodeDecodeResult.Found -> {
              val detectionBounds = result.signature.bounds?.let(SnapDetectionBounds::RoiLocal)
              val seedWidthEvidence = snapSeedWidthEvidence(
                  detectionBounds = detectionBounds,
                  frameSize = SnapFrameSize(
                      width = frameDebugInfo.width,
                      height = frameDebugInfo.height,
                  ),
                  streamRoi = roi,
              )
              val signature = result.signature.viewedAs(orientationMode) ?: return null
              val cardId = profile.lookup(signature)
              if (cardId == null) {
                  BeetleEvidence.Unknown(
                      rawSignature = signature,
                      confidence = result.signature.confidence,
                      provenance = provenance,
                  )
              } else {
                  BeetleEvidence.Known(
                      rawSignature = signature,
                      cardId = cardId,
                      confidence = result.signature.confidence,
                      seedWidthEvidence = seedWidthEvidence,
                      detectionBounds = detectionBounds,
                      sourceFrameSize = SnapFrameSize(
                          width = frameDebugInfo.width,
                          height = frameDebugInfo.height,
                      ),
                      streamRoi = roi,
                      provenance = provenance,
                  )
              }
          }
          is BarcodeDecodeResult.Ambiguous -> BeetleEvidence.Ambiguous(
              candidates = result.candidates.mapNotNull { candidate ->
                  candidate.viewedAs(orientationMode)?.let { signature ->
                      BeetleSignatureCandidate(
                          rawSignature = signature,
                          confidence = candidate.confidence,
                      )
                  }
              },
              provenance = provenance,
          )
          is BarcodeDecodeResult.NotFound -> BeetleEvidence.NotFound(result.reason, provenance = provenance)
      }
      is CameraScanOutcome.ConversionFailed -> BeetleEvidence.ConversionFailure(reason, provenance = provenance)
  }
  
  @Composable
  internal fun rememberEditBoardController(
      boardEditState: BoardEditState,
      deckProfile: DeckProfile,
      orientationMode: BarcodeOrientationMode,
      feedMode: TdFeedMode,
      requiredConsensusFrames: Int,
      snapFinderSettings: HorizontalSnapCandidateFinderSettings,
      snapProcessingDeadlineMillis: Long,
      hasCameraPermission: Boolean,
      mainExecutor: Executor,
      onBoardEditStateChange: (BoardEditState) -> Unit
  ): EditBoardController {
      val snapScope = rememberCoroutineScope()
      val controller = remember {
          EditBoardController(
              onBoardEditStateChange = onBoardEditStateChange,
              snapScope = snapScope,
              mainExecutor = mainExecutor,
              telemetryLaneFactory = ScheduledStreamTelemetryLane.FACTORY,
              beetleLaneFactory = ExecutorStreamBeetleLane.FACTORY,
          )
      }
      controller.selectFeedMode(feedMode)
      controller.update(
          state = boardEditState,
          profile = deckProfile,
          mode = orientationMode,
          requiredConsensusFrames = requiredConsensusFrames,
          snapFinderSettings = snapFinderSettings,
          snapProcessingDeadlineMillis = snapProcessingDeadlineMillis,
          hasCameraPermission = hasCameraPermission,
          onBoardEditStateChange = onBoardEditStateChange,
      )
  
      return controller
  }

  package org.itroboc.app
  
  import java.util.concurrent.Executor
  import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService
  import java.util.concurrent.Executors
  import java.util.concurrent.RejectedExecutionException
  import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean
  
  internal interface StreamBeetleLane : AutoCloseable {
      fun hasFrameCapacity(): Boolean
      fun submitFrame(envelope: StreamFrameEnvelope): Boolean
      fun submitControl(command: StreamBeetleCommand): Boolean
      override fun close()
  }
  
  internal fun interface StreamBeetleLaneFactory {
      fun create(
          nowMillis: () -> Long,
          mainExecutor: Executor,
          mainHandoffGate: StreamMainHandoffGate,
          isFrameCurrent: (StreamEvidenceEpoch) -> Boolean,
          onPublication: (StreamBeetlePublication) -> Unit,
      ): StreamBeetleLane
  }
  
  internal class InlineStreamBeetleLane(
      nowMillis: () -> Long,
      private val isFrameCurrent: (StreamEvidenceEpoch) -> Boolean,
      private val onPublication: (StreamBeetlePublication) -> Unit,
  ) : StreamBeetleLane {
      private val processor = StreamBeetleProcessor(nowMillis)
      private var closed = false
  
      override fun hasFrameCapacity(): Boolean = !closed
  
      override fun submitFrame(envelope: StreamFrameEnvelope): Boolean {
          if (closed || !isFrameCurrent(envelope.streamOutcome.epoch)) return false
          processor.process(StreamBeetleCommand.ObserveFrame(envelope))?.let(onPublication)
          return true
      }
  
      override fun submitControl(command: StreamBeetleCommand): Boolean {
          require(command !is StreamBeetleCommand.ObserveFrame) {
              "Frame evidence must use submitFrame"
          }
          if (closed) return false
          processor.process(command)?.let(onPublication)
          return true
      }
  
      override fun close() {
          closed = true
      }
  
      companion object {
          val FACTORY = StreamBeetleLaneFactory { now, _, _, current, publish ->
              InlineStreamBeetleLane(now, current, publish)
          }
      }
  }
  
  internal class ExecutorStreamBeetleLane(
      nowMillis: () -> Long,
      private val mainExecutor: Executor,
      private val mainHandoffGate: StreamMainHandoffGate,
      private val isFrameCurrent: (StreamEvidenceEpoch) -> Boolean,
      private val onPublication: (StreamBeetlePublication) -> Unit,
      private val executor: ExecutorService = newBeetleExecutor(),
      frameLimit: Int = DEFAULT_FRAME_LIMIT,
  ) : StreamBeetleLane {
      private val processor = StreamBeetleProcessor(nowMillis)
      private val frameGate = BoundedStreamWorkGate(frameLimit, "Stream evidence handoff")
      private val closed = AtomicBoolean(false)
      private var lastEnqueuedThought: EnqueuedThought? = null
  
      override fun hasFrameCapacity(): Boolean =
          !closed.get() && frameGate.hasCapacity()
  
      override fun submitFrame(envelope: StreamFrameEnvelope): Boolean {
          if (closed.get() || !frameGate.tryAcquire()) return false
          val accepted = execute {
              try {
                  if (!closed.get() && isFrameCurrent(envelope.streamOutcome.epoch)) {
                      processor.process(StreamBeetleCommand.ObserveFrame(envelope))
                          ?.let(::publishIfMeaningful)
                  }
              } finally {
                  frameGate.release()
              }
          }
          if (!accepted) frameGate.release()
          return accepted
      }
  
      override fun submitControl(command: StreamBeetleCommand): Boolean {
          require(command !is StreamBeetleCommand.ObserveFrame) {
              "Frame evidence must use submitFrame"
          }
          if (closed.get()) return false
          return execute {
              if (!closed.get()) processor.process(command)?.let(::publishIfMeaningful)
          }
      }
  
      override fun close() {
          if (!closed.compareAndSet(false, true)) return
          executor.shutdownNow()
      }
  
      private fun execute(block: () -> Unit): Boolean = try {
          executor.execute(block)
          true
      } catch (_: RejectedExecutionException) {
          false
      }
  
      private fun publishIfMeaningful(publication: StreamBeetlePublication) {
          val output = publication.mindOutput
          val thoughtKey = output?.let {
              EnqueuedThought(publication.sourceEpoch, it.snapshot)
          }
          val thoughtChanged = thoughtKey != null && thoughtKey != lastEnqueuedThought
          val mustDeliver =
              output?.acceptedCardScan != null ||
                  publication.foodUpdate != null ||
                  publication.impressionUpdate != null
          if (!thoughtChanged && !mustDeliver && publication.roiPreview == null) return
  
          val acquired = if (mustDeliver) {
              mainHandoffGate.acquireRequired()
              true
          } else {
              mainHandoffGate.tryAcquire()
          }
          if (!acquired) return
          try {
              mainExecutor.execute {
                  try {
                      if (!closed.get() && publication.isCurrent(isFrameCurrent)) {
                          onPublication(publication)
                      }
                  } finally {
                      mainHandoffGate.release()
                  }
              }
              if (thoughtKey != null) lastEnqueuedThought = thoughtKey
          } catch (_: RejectedExecutionException) {
              mainHandoffGate.release()
          }
      }
  
      companion object {
          const val DEFAULT_FRAME_LIMIT = 5
  
          val FACTORY = StreamBeetleLaneFactory { now, main, gate, current, publish ->
              ExecutorStreamBeetleLane(now, main, gate, current, publish)
          }
  
          private fun newBeetleExecutor(): ExecutorService =
              Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor { runnable ->
                  Thread(runnable, "ITROBOC-BeetleMind").apply { isDaemon = true }
              }
      }
  
      private data class EnqueuedThought(
          val sourceEpoch: StreamEvidenceEpoch?,
          val snapshot: BeetleMindSnapshot,
      )
  }
  
  private fun StreamBeetlePublication.isCurrent(
      isFrameCurrent: (StreamEvidenceEpoch) -> Boolean,
  ): Boolean = sourceEpoch?.let(isFrameCurrent) ?: true

  package org.itroboc.app
  
  internal sealed interface StreamBeetleCommand {
      data class ObserveFrame(val envelope: StreamFrameEnvelope) : StreamBeetleCommand
      data class ObserveStatus(val status: BeetleOperationalStatus) : StreamBeetleCommand
      data class Dream(val topic: BeetleDream) : StreamBeetleCommand
      data class ObserveFoodConfiguration(
          val orientationMode: BarcodeOrientationMode,
          val generation: StreamConfigurationGeneration,
      ) : StreamBeetleCommand
      data class ReserveImpression(val request: ImpressionCaptureRequest) : StreamBeetleCommand
      data class InstallImpression(val outcome: ImpressionCaptureOutcome) : StreamBeetleCommand
      data object Unimpress : StreamBeetleCommand
  }
  
  internal data class StreamBeetlePublication(
      val mindOutput: BeetleMindOutput?,
      val sourceEpoch: StreamEvidenceEpoch? = null,
      val configurationGeneration: StreamConfigurationGeneration? = null,
      val roiPreview: RoiPreviewSnapshot? = null,
      val impressionUpdate: ImpressionPresentationUpdate? = null,
      val foodUpdate: FoodStateUpdate? = null,
  ) {
      init {
          require(
              mindOutput != null ||
                  roiPreview != null ||
                  impressionUpdate != null ||
                  foodUpdate != null
          ) {
              "A Stream Beetle publication must contain visible or diagnostic output"
          }
      }
  }
  
  /** One serial command handler around BeetleMind; scheduling is supplied later. */
  internal class StreamBeetleProcessor(
      nowMillis: () -> Long,
      settings: BeetleMindSettings = BeetleMindSettings(
          requiredConsensusFrames = TdSessionState.DEFAULT_CONSENSUS_FRAMES,
      ),
  ) {
      private val mind = BeetleMind(nowMillis = nowMillis, settings = settings)
  
      val thought: BeetleThought
          get() = mind.thought
  
      fun process(command: StreamBeetleCommand): StreamBeetlePublication? = when (command) {
          is StreamBeetleCommand.ObserveFrame -> processFrame(command.envelope)
          is StreamBeetleCommand.ObserveStatus -> StreamBeetlePublication(
              mindOutput = mind.observeStatus(command.status),
          )
          is StreamBeetleCommand.Dream -> StreamBeetlePublication(
              mindOutput = mind.dream(command.topic),
          )
          is StreamBeetleCommand.ObserveFoodConfiguration -> {
              if (
                  mind.observeFoodConfiguration(
                      orientationMode = command.orientationMode,
                      generation = command.generation,
                  )
              ) {
                  StreamBeetlePublication(
                      mindOutput = null,
                      foodUpdate = mind.currentFood.toStateUpdate(
                          requireNotNull(mind.currentImpressionGeneration),
                          requireNotNull(mind.currentFoodGeneration),
                      ),
                  )
              } else {
                  null
              }
          }
          is StreamBeetleCommand.ReserveImpression -> {
              mind.reserveImpression(command.request)
              null
          }
          is StreamBeetleCommand.InstallImpression -> {
              val previousFood = mind.currentFood
              mind.installImpression(command.outcome)?.let { update ->
                  val currentFood = mind.currentFood
                  StreamBeetlePublication(
                      mindOutput = null,
                      impressionUpdate = update,
                      foodUpdate = if (currentFood !== previousFood) {
                          currentFood.toStateUpdate(
                              impressionGeneration =
                                  requireNotNull(mind.currentImpressionGeneration),
                              foodGeneration = requireNotNull(mind.currentFoodGeneration),
                          )
                      } else {
                          null
                      },
                  )
              }
          }
          StreamBeetleCommand.Unimpress -> {
              val clearsPresentation = mind.isImpressed
              val clearsFood = mind.currentFood != null
              val clearedGeneration = mind.currentImpressionGeneration
              val clearedFoodGeneration = mind.currentFoodGeneration
              StreamBeetlePublication(
                  mindOutput = mind.unimpress(),
                  impressionUpdate = if (clearsPresentation) {
                      ImpressionPresentationUpdate.Cleared
                  } else {
                      null
                  },
                  foodUpdate = if (clearsFood) {
                      FoodStateUpdate.Cleared(
                          impressionGeneration = requireNotNull(clearedGeneration),
                          foodGeneration = requireNotNull(clearedFoodGeneration),
                      )
                  } else {
                      null
                  },
              )
          }
      }
  
      private fun processFrame(envelope: StreamFrameEnvelope): StreamBeetlePublication? {
          val configuration = envelope.configuration
          val foodChanged = mind.observeFoodConfiguration(
              orientationMode = configuration.orientationMode,
              generation = configuration.generation,
          )
          val outcome = envelope.streamOutcome.outcome
          val evidence = outcome.toBeetleEvidence(
              profile = configuration.deckProfile,
              orientationMode = configuration.orientationMode,
              provenance = BeetleEvidenceProvenance.Live,
          )
          val output = evidence?.let {
              mind.observe(
                  evidence = it,
                  requiredConsensusFrames = configuration.requiredConsensusFrames,
              )
          }
          val roiPreview = outcome.roiPreview
          val foodUpdate = if (foodChanged) {
              mind.currentFood.toStateUpdate(
                  requireNotNull(mind.currentImpressionGeneration),
                  requireNotNull(mind.currentFoodGeneration),
              )
          } else {
              null
          }
          if (output == null && roiPreview == null && foodUpdate == null) return null
          return StreamBeetlePublication(
              mindOutput = output,
              sourceEpoch = envelope.streamOutcome.epoch,
              configurationGeneration = configuration.generation,
              roiPreview = roiPreview,
              foodUpdate = foodUpdate,
          )
      }
  }
  
  private fun BeetleFood?.toStateUpdate(
      impressionGeneration: ImpressionGeneration,
      foodGeneration: FoodGeneration,
  ): FoodStateUpdate =
      this?.let(FoodStateUpdate::Present)
          ?: FoodStateUpdate.Cleared(impressionGeneration, foodGeneration)

  package org.itroboc.app
  
  import org.itroboc.core.CardId
  import org.itroboc.vision.BarcodeRoi
  import org.itroboc.vision.SnapFrameSize
  import org.itroboc.vision.SnapDetectionBounds
  import org.itroboc.vision.SnapSeedWidthEvidence
  
  internal data class BeetleMindSettings(
      val requiredConsensusFrames: Int,
      val debounceWindowMillis: Long = DEFAULT_DEBOUNCE_WINDOW_MILLIS,
  ) {
      init {
          require(requiredConsensusFrames in ALLOWED_CONSENSUS_FRAMES) {
              "requiredConsensusFrames must be within $ALLOWED_CONSENSUS_FRAMES"
          }
          require(debounceWindowMillis >= 0L) {
              "debounceWindowMillis must be non-negative"
          }
      }
  
      companion object {
          val ALLOWED_CONSENSUS_FRAMES = 2..6
          const val DEFAULT_DEBOUNCE_WINDOW_MILLIS = 1_000L
      }
  }
  
  internal enum class BeetleDream(
      val presentation: String,
  ) {
      EYES("Eyes"),
      HANDS("Hands"),
      WIND("Wind"),
      JOKER("Joker"),
  }
  
  internal data class BeetleSignatureCandidate(
      val rawSignature: String,
      val confidence: Double,
  )
  
  internal sealed interface BeetleEvidence {
      val provenance: BeetleEvidenceProvenance
  
      data class Known(
          val rawSignature: String,
          val cardId: CardId,
          val confidence: Double,
          val seedWidthEvidence: SnapSeedWidthEvidence,
          val detectionBounds: SnapDetectionBounds?,
          val sourceFrameSize: SnapFrameSize,
          val streamRoi: BarcodeRoi,
          override val provenance: BeetleEvidenceProvenance,
      ) : BeetleEvidence
  
      data class Unknown(
          val rawSignature: String,
          val confidence: Double,
          override val provenance: BeetleEvidenceProvenance,
      ) : BeetleEvidence
  
      data class Ambiguous(
          val candidates: List<BeetleSignatureCandidate>,
          override val provenance: BeetleEvidenceProvenance,
      ) : BeetleEvidence
  
      data class NotFound(
          val reason: String,
          override val provenance: BeetleEvidenceProvenance,
      ) : BeetleEvidence
  
      data class ConversionFailure(
          val reason: String,
          override val provenance: BeetleEvidenceProvenance,
      ) : BeetleEvidence
  }
  
  internal sealed interface BeetleThought {
      val presentation: String
  
      data object Blank : BeetleThought {
          override val presentation: String = "0"
      }
  
      data class Pondering(
          val subject: String,
          val evidenceCount: Int,
      ) : BeetleThought {
          init {
              require(evidenceCount > 0) { "evidenceCount must be positive" }
          }
  
          override val presentation: String = subject + when (evidenceCount) {
              1 -> "?"
              2 -> "??"
              else -> "???"
          }
      }
  
      data class Certain(
          val subject: String,
      ) : BeetleThought {
          override val presentation: String = "$subject."
      }
  
      data class Uncertain(
          val candidateSignature: String,
      ) : BeetleThought {
          override val presentation: String = "$candidateSignature~"
      }
  
      data class Dreaming(
          val topic: BeetleDream,
      ) : BeetleThought {
          override val presentation: String = topic.presentation
      }
  }
  
  internal data class AcceptedCardScan(
      val rawSignature: String,
      val cardId: CardId,
      val confidence: Double,
      val seedWidthEvidence: SnapSeedWidthEvidence,
      val detectionBounds: SnapDetectionBounds?,
      val sourceFrameSize: SnapFrameSize,
      val streamRoi: BarcodeRoi,
      val provenance: BeetleEvidenceProvenance,
  )
  
  internal data class BeetleMindSnapshot(
      val thought: BeetleThought,
      val isImpressed: Boolean,
  ) {
      val presentation: String
          get() = thought.presentation + if (isImpressed) "🐞" else ""
  }
  
  internal data class BeetleMindOutput(
      val snapshot: BeetleMindSnapshot,
      val acceptedCardScan: AcceptedCardScan? = null,
  ) {
      val thought: BeetleThought
          get() = snapshot.thought
  }
  
  internal data class BeetleOperationalStatus(
      val hasCameraPermission: Boolean,
      val isScissorsOpen: Boolean,
      val isSwapOpen: Boolean,
      val isBoardScanned: Boolean,
  )
  
  /** Pure Kotlin evidence-trust state machine. It does not own camera or board behavior. */
  internal class BeetleMind(
      private val nowMillis: () -> Long,
      private val settings: BeetleMindSettings,
  ) {
      var thought: BeetleThought = BeetleThought.Blank
          private set
  
      private var currentImpression: ImpressionCaptured? = null
      private var reservedImpressionRequest: ImpressionCaptureRequest? = null
      var currentFood: BeetleFood? = null
          private set
      private var lastFoodGeneration: FoodGeneration? = null
      private var foodConfiguration: FoodConfiguration? = null
  
      private var ponderingSignature: String? = null
      private var ponderingCount: Int = 0
      private var lastAcceptedRawSignature: String? = null
      private var lastAcceptedProvenance: BeetleEvidenceProvenance? = null
      private var lastAcceptedAtMillis: Long = 0L
      private var ponderingProvenance: BeetleEvidenceProvenance? = null
  
      fun observe(
          evidence: BeetleEvidence,
          requiredConsensusFrames: Int = settings.requiredConsensusFrames,
      ): BeetleMindOutput {
          require(requiredConsensusFrames in BeetleMindSettings.ALLOWED_CONSENSUS_FRAMES) {
              "requiredConsensusFrames must be within ${BeetleMindSettings.ALLOWED_CONSENSUS_FRAMES}"
          }
  
          return when (evidence) {
              is BeetleEvidence.Known -> observeKnown(
                  evidence = evidence,
                  requiredConsensusFrames = requiredConsensusFrames,
              )
              is BeetleEvidence.Unknown -> {
                  clearPondering()
                  publish(BeetleThought.Pondering(evidence.rawSignature, evidenceCount = 1))
              }
              is BeetleEvidence.Ambiguous -> {
                  clearPondering()
                  val nextThought = evidence.candidates.firstOrNull()
                      ?.rawSignature
                      ?.let(BeetleThought::Uncertain)
                      ?: BeetleThought.Blank
                  publish(nextThought)
              }
              is BeetleEvidence.NotFound,
              is BeetleEvidence.ConversionFailure,
              -> clearAttention()
          }
      }
  
      fun observeStatus(status: BeetleOperationalStatus): BeetleMindOutput {
          val dreamTopic = when {
              !status.hasCameraPermission -> BeetleDream.EYES
              status.isScissorsOpen -> BeetleDream.HANDS
              status.isSwapOpen -> BeetleDream.WIND
              status.isBoardScanned -> BeetleDream.JOKER
              else -> null
          }
  
          return if (dreamTopic != null) {
              dream(dreamTopic)
          } else if (thought is BeetleThought.Dreaming) {
              clearAttention()
          } else {
              BeetleMindOutput(snapshot())
          }
      }
  
      fun dream(topic: BeetleDream): BeetleMindOutput {
          clearPondering()
          return publish(BeetleThought.Dreaming(topic))
      }
  
      fun unimpress(): BeetleMindOutput {
          clearPondering()
          currentImpression = null
          reservedImpressionRequest = null
          currentFood = null
          lastFoodGeneration = null
          return publish(BeetleThought.Blank)
      }
  
      val isImpressed: Boolean
          get() = currentImpression != null
  
      val currentImpressionGeneration: ImpressionGeneration?
          get() = currentImpression?.request?.generation
  
      val currentFoodGeneration: FoodGeneration?
          get() = lastFoodGeneration
  
      fun snapshot(): BeetleMindSnapshot = BeetleMindSnapshot(
          thought = thought,
          isImpressed = isImpressed,
      )
  
      fun observeFoodConfiguration(
          orientationMode: BarcodeOrientationMode,
          generation: StreamConfigurationGeneration,
      ): Boolean {
          val previous = foodConfiguration
          if (previous != null && generation.value <= previous.generation.value) return false
  
          foodConfiguration = FoodConfiguration(orientationMode, generation)
          if (currentImpression == null || previous?.orientationMode == orientationMode) return false
          replaceFood(orientationMode)
          return true
      }
  
      /** Same-scene replacement seam for later exhaustion handling; never requests CameraX. */
      fun reselectFood(): BeetleFood? {
          val impression = currentImpression ?: return null
          val orientationMode = foodConfiguration
              ?.orientationMode
              ?: impression.request.orientationMode
          replaceFood(orientationMode)
          return currentFood
      }
  
      fun reserveImpression(request: ImpressionCaptureRequest): Boolean {
          val latestGeneration = reservedImpressionRequest?.generation
              ?: currentImpression?.request?.generation
          if (latestGeneration != null && request.generation.value <= latestGeneration.value) {
              return false
          }
          reservedImpressionRequest = request
          return true
      }
  
      fun installImpression(outcome: ImpressionCaptureOutcome): ImpressionPresentationUpdate? {
          val reserved = reservedImpressionRequest ?: return null
          if (outcome.request != reserved) return null
          reservedImpressionRequest = null
  
          return when (outcome) {
              is ImpressionCaptureOutcome.Captured -> {
                  currentImpression = outcome.impression
                  lastFoodGeneration = null
                  val requestConfiguration = FoodConfiguration(
                      orientationMode = outcome.request.orientationMode,
                      generation = outcome.request.configurationGeneration,
                  )
                  val activeConfiguration = foodConfiguration
                      ?.takeIf { it.generation.value > requestConfiguration.generation.value }
                      ?: requestConfiguration
                  foodConfiguration = activeConfiguration
                  replaceFood(activeConfiguration.orientationMode)
                  ImpressionPresentationUpdate.Present(outcome.impression.toPresentation())
              }
              is ImpressionCaptureOutcome.Failed -> null
          }
      }
  
      private fun observeKnown(
          evidence: BeetleEvidence.Known,
          requiredConsensusFrames: Int,
      ): BeetleMindOutput {
          if (
              evidence.rawSignature == ponderingSignature &&
              evidence.provenance == ponderingProvenance
          ) {
              ponderingCount++
          } else {
              ponderingSignature = evidence.rawSignature
              ponderingCount = 1
              ponderingProvenance = evidence.provenance
          }
  
          val cardName = "${evidence.cardId.suit.prettySymbol}${evidence.cardId.rank.symbol}"
          if (ponderingCount < requiredConsensusFrames) {
              return publish(BeetleThought.Pondering(cardName, ponderingCount))
          }
  
          val currentTimeMillis = nowMillis()
          val acceptedCardScan = if (
              evidence.rawSignature == lastAcceptedRawSignature &&
              evidence.provenance == lastAcceptedProvenance &&
              currentTimeMillis - lastAcceptedAtMillis < settings.debounceWindowMillis
          ) {
              null
          } else {
              lastAcceptedRawSignature = evidence.rawSignature
              lastAcceptedProvenance = evidence.provenance
              lastAcceptedAtMillis = currentTimeMillis
              AcceptedCardScan(
                  rawSignature = evidence.rawSignature,
                  cardId = evidence.cardId,
                  confidence = evidence.confidence,
                  seedWidthEvidence = evidence.seedWidthEvidence,
                  detectionBounds = evidence.detectionBounds,
                  sourceFrameSize = evidence.sourceFrameSize,
                  streamRoi = evidence.streamRoi,
                  provenance = evidence.provenance,
              )
          }
          return publish(
              nextThought = BeetleThought.Certain(cardName),
              acceptedCardScan = acceptedCardScan,
          )
      }
  
      private fun clearPondering() {
          ponderingSignature = null
          ponderingCount = 0
          ponderingProvenance = null
      }
  
      private fun replaceFood(orientationMode: BarcodeOrientationMode) {
          val impression = currentImpression ?: return
          val generation = lastFoodGeneration?.next() ?: FoodGeneration(1L)
          lastFoodGeneration = generation
          currentFood = when (
              val selection = selectFoodFromImpression(impression, orientationMode)
          ) {
              is FoodSelectionResult.Selected -> BeetleFood(
                  impressionGeneration = impression.request.generation,
                  generation = generation,
                  retained = selection.food,
              )
              FoodSelectionResult.ExplicitOrientationRequired -> null
          }
      }
  
      private fun clearAttention(): BeetleMindOutput {
          clearPondering()
          return publish(BeetleThought.Blank)
      }
  
      private fun publish(
          nextThought: BeetleThought,
          acceptedCardScan: AcceptedCardScan? = null,
      ): BeetleMindOutput {
          thought = nextThought
          return BeetleMindOutput(
              snapshot = snapshot(),
              acceptedCardScan = acceptedCardScan,
          )
      }
  
      private data class FoodConfiguration(
          val orientationMode: BarcodeOrientationMode,
          val generation: StreamConfigurationGeneration,
      )
  }

  package org.itroboc.app
  
  import java.util.concurrent.Executor
  import java.util.concurrent.Executors
  import java.util.concurrent.RejectedExecutionException
  import java.util.concurrent.ScheduledExecutorService
  import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit
  import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean
  import java.util.concurrent.locks.ReentrantLock
  import kotlin.concurrent.withLock
  
  internal interface StreamTelemetryLane : AutoCloseable {
      fun recordScan(observedAtMillis: Long)
      fun setBoardScanned(boardScanned: Boolean)
      fun requestSnapshot()
      override fun close()
  }
  
  internal fun interface StreamTelemetryLaneFactory {
      fun create(
          initialTimestampMillis: Long,
          outstandingMainCallbacks: () -> Int,
          mainExecutor: Executor,
          onSnapshot: (StreamTelemetrySnapshot) -> Unit,
      ): StreamTelemetryLane
  }
  
  internal class InlineStreamTelemetryLane(
      initialTimestampMillis: Long,
      private val outstandingMainCallbacks: () -> Int,
      private val onSnapshot: (StreamTelemetrySnapshot) -> Unit,
  ) : StreamTelemetryLane {
      private val engine = StreamTelemetryEngine(initialTimestampMillis)
      private var boardScanned = false
      private var closed = false
  
      override fun recordScan(observedAtMillis: Long) {
          if (!closed) engine.recordScan(observedAtMillis)
      }
  
      override fun setBoardScanned(boardScanned: Boolean) {
          this.boardScanned = boardScanned
      }
  
      override fun requestSnapshot() {
          if (!closed) {
              onSnapshot(engine.snapshot(boardScanned, outstandingMainCallbacks()))
          }
      }
  
      override fun close() {
          closed = true
      }
  
      companion object {
          val FACTORY = StreamTelemetryLaneFactory { initial, outstanding, _, publish ->
              InlineStreamTelemetryLane(initial, outstanding, publish)
          }
      }
  }
  
  /** Non-blocking, allocation-free ingress from Analyzer to the Telemetry owner. */
  internal class StreamTelemetryMailbox(
      capacity: Int = DEFAULT_CAPACITY,
  ) {
      private val timestamps = LongArray(capacity)
      private val lock = ReentrantLock()
      private var firstIndex = 0
      private var size = 0
  
      init {
          require(capacity > 0) { "Telemetry mailbox capacity must be positive" }
      }
  
      fun offer(observedAtMillis: Long): Boolean {
          if (!lock.tryLock()) return false
          return try {
              if (size == timestamps.size) return false
              timestamps[(firstIndex + size) % timestamps.size] = observedAtMillis
              size++
              true
          } finally {
              lock.unlock()
          }
      }
  
      fun drain(consumer: (Long) -> Unit) {
          lock.withLock {
              repeat(size) { offset ->
                  consumer(timestamps[(firstIndex + offset) % timestamps.size])
              }
              firstIndex = 0
              size = 0
          }
      }
  
      fun clear() {
          lock.withLock {
              firstIndex = 0
              size = 0
          }
      }
  
      private companion object {
          const val DEFAULT_CAPACITY = 128
      }
  }
  
  internal class ScheduledStreamTelemetryLane(
      initialTimestampMillis: Long,
      private val outstandingMainCallbacks: () -> Int,
      private val mainExecutor: Executor,
      private val onSnapshot: (StreamTelemetrySnapshot) -> Unit,
      private val scheduler: ScheduledExecutorService = newTelemetryExecutor(),
      mailboxCapacity: Int = 128,
      cadenceMillis: Long = DEFAULT_CADENCE_MILLIS,
      scheduleAutomatically: Boolean = true,
  ) : StreamTelemetryLane {
      private val engine = StreamTelemetryEngine(initialTimestampMillis)
      private val mailbox = StreamTelemetryMailbox(mailboxCapacity)
      private val boardScanned = AtomicBoolean(false)
      private val closed = AtomicBoolean(false)
  
      init {
          require(cadenceMillis > 0L) { "Telemetry cadence must be positive" }
          if (scheduleAutomatically) {
              scheduler.scheduleWithFixedDelay(
                  ::drainAndPublish,
                  cadenceMillis,
                  cadenceMillis,
                  TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS,
              )
          }
      }
  
      override fun recordScan(observedAtMillis: Long) {
          if (!closed.get()) mailbox.offer(observedAtMillis)
      }
  
      override fun setBoardScanned(boardScanned: Boolean) {
          this.boardScanned.set(boardScanned)
      }
  
      override fun requestSnapshot() {
          if (closed.get()) return
          try {
              scheduler.execute(::drainAndPublish)
          } catch (_: RejectedExecutionException) {
              // Disposal won the race; there is no snapshot left to publish.
          }
      }
  
      override fun close() {
          if (!closed.compareAndSet(false, true)) return
          mailbox.clear()
          scheduler.shutdownNow()
      }
  
      private fun drainAndPublish() {
          if (closed.get()) return
          mailbox.drain(engine::recordScan)
          val snapshot = engine.snapshot(
              boardScanned = boardScanned.get(),
              outstandingMainCallbacks = outstandingMainCallbacks(),
          )
          try {
              mainExecutor.execute {
                  if (!closed.get()) onSnapshot(snapshot)
              }
          } catch (_: RejectedExecutionException) {
              // Main lifecycle disposal won the publication race.
          }
      }
  
      companion object {
          const val DEFAULT_CADENCE_MILLIS = 500L
  
          val FACTORY = StreamTelemetryLaneFactory { initial, outstanding, main, publish ->
              ScheduledStreamTelemetryLane(initial, outstanding, main, publish)
          }
  
          private fun newTelemetryExecutor(): ScheduledExecutorService =
              Executors.newSingleThreadScheduledExecutor { runnable ->
                  Thread(runnable, "ITROBOC-Telemetry").apply { isDaemon = true }
              }
      }
  }
