  # P2-03 — Admin Calibrate resource grounding
  
  Status: resource-determinism design accepted; pure two-slot store landed inert
  
  Phase: P2 — Profiling & Design
  
  Depends on: P2-02 before camera/cognition integration
  
  ## Goal
  
  Use Admin::Calibrate to discover the actual TD camera geometry and prepare
  bounded, reusable Impression luma storage before TD Stream begins.
  
  The quiet-lab SM-T350 baseline did **not** prove that preallocation is required
  for current throughput: warm Impression capture was already small and did not
  produce operator-visible delay. Archy nevertheless accepts P2-03 as a resource
  determinism and future-cognition decision. Do not rewrite that choice as a
  measured speed claim; tournament lighting, handling, thermal state, and future
  cognition may produce a harsher operating field than the lab baseline.
  
  ## Source-grounded constraints
  
  - Camera dimensions are learned from CameraX frames, not at MainMenu startup.
  - Admin calibration is useful only if it binds the same camera-facing
    `ImageAnalysis` shape contract used by TD Stream. A preview surface size is
    not sufficient evidence.
  - One Impression remains retained by BeetleMind while Analyzer may capture its
    replacement. A reusable store therefore needs explicit exclusive ownership
    transfer; two atomic references to mutable arrays are not a safe pool.
  - Main, Analyzer, BeetleMind, and Telemetry already have distinct lane
    responsibilities. The resource owner must outlive the Admin-to-TD navigation
    handoff without becoming mutable Compose state or Beetle cognition.
  - Ordinary live scanning must remain correct when resources are absent,
    exhausted, stale, or incompatible with a new camera geometry.
  
  ## Small gait
  
  1. [`P2-03a`](P2-03a-grounded-frame-shape-contract.md) — completed pure
     frame-shape/capacity contract.
  2. [`P2-03b`](P2-03b-exclusive-impression-scene-slots.md) — completed inert
     bounded exclusive scene-slot owner with no camera or UI dependency.
  3. [`P2-03c`](P2-03c-admin-calibrate-ceremony.md) — add the reachable Admin
     calibration screen and ground resources from an actual matching camera
     analysis frame.
  4. [`P2-03d`](P2-03d-grounded-capture-integration.md) — transfer leased slots
     across Analyzer and BeetleMind, then repeat the pulse measurement.
  
  The two-slot store remains an inert, tested growth point. P2-03c owns the first
  active application owner and P2-03d owns camera/cognition integration.
  
  ## Family acceptance
  
  - [ ] Calibration establishes a versioned contract from an actual matching
    analysis frame and reports `Resources grounded` only after preparation ends.
  - [ ] Application-owned luma arrays larger than 10 KiB are allocated during
    grounding, not during an Impression capture.
  - [ ] No mutable slot can be written by one lane while retained by another.
  - [ ] Recalibration, exhaustion, unimpress, replacement, and disposal have
    explicit tested behavior.
  - [ ] TD live scanning remains available when Impression capture cannot borrow
    a compatible slot.
  - [ ] The same P2-01c scenarios record the measured result after integration.
  
  ## Boundary
  
  This family grounds SAA/SAB retinal luma only. It does not preallocate Food,
  ARGB presentation pixels, Compose bitmaps, framework memory, or a fifth
  presentation lane. Those require their own evidence and ownership design.

  # P2-04 — Love Blinds reimpression admission
  
  Status: accepted design; implement after P2-02 measurement
  
  Depends on: P2-02
  
  ## Goal
  
  After one qualifying live `ADDED` successfully reserves an Impression, prevent
  another reimpression for at least one second so BeetleMind can retain and use
  good Food instead of repeatedly replacing it while densely adjacent physical
  barcodes cross the slit.
  
  The field arrangement places several barcodes close enough to enter one natural
  camera motion. Once Love Blinds clears, cognition may already know neighboring
  cards from the retained Food, making their later live recognition unsurprising.
  
  ## Required behavior
  
  - Start a monotonic one-second blind window only after an Impression reservation
    succeeds.
  - During the window, ordinary Stream recognition and Main's authoritative card
    reducer continue unchanged. A qualifying live card may still be `ADDED`; only
    its replacement Impression reservation is suppressed.
  - Keep the installed Impression and Food. Suppression does not unimpress and
    does not queue a delayed replacement capture.
  - Food dreams never arm live Impression capture and never affect the window.
  - Do not sleep or block Analyzer, BeetleMind, Main, or Telemetry.
  - Make controller disposal and hard-clear behavior explicit in tests. Decide
    whether a seat/board change clears the remaining window before implementation.
  - Keep the duration injected/testable and default it to `1_000 ms`.
  
  ## Acceptance
  
  - [ ] A successful reservation suppresses further reservations for one second.
  - [ ] Rejected reservation does not start the window.
  - [ ] Suppressed live `ADDED` cards still reach the authoritative board state.
  - [ ] No delayed capture fires when the window expires.
  - [ ] Monotonic-clock boundary and lifecycle tests are deterministic.
  - [ ] SM-T350 repeated-card handling is compared before and after the policy.
  
  ## Boundary
  
  Love Blinds is an Impression-admission policy, not frame throttling, consensus
  reset, autofocus control, or proof that an adjacent card was already dreamed.

Response:
  package org.itroboc.app
  
  /**
   * P2-03b inert growth point: two preallocated whole-scene slots with exclusive transfer.
   *
   * No camera or cognition path calls this store yet. P2-03d owns integration. Mutable arrays
   * remain private: Analyzer-facing code may fill a capture lease only through a scoped copy, and
   * retained readers may copy into caller-owned destinations without receiving the pooled arrays.
   */
  internal class GroundedBufferPool : AutoCloseable {
      private val lock = Any()
      private var slots: List<SceneSlot> = emptyList()
      private var groundedShape: GroundedImpressionSceneShape? = null
      private var nextLeaseToken = 1L
      private var closed = false
  
      fun ground(shape: GroundedImpressionSceneShape): GroundingResult = synchronized(lock) {
          if (closed) return@synchronized GroundingResult.CLOSED
          if (groundedShape == shape && slots.size == SLOT_COUNT) {
              return@synchronized GroundingResult.ALREADY_GROUNDED
          }
          if (slots.any { it.state != SlotState.FREE }) {
              return@synchronized GroundingResult.BUSY
          }
  
          slots = List(SLOT_COUNT) { index ->
              SceneSlot(
                  index = index,
                  saaPixels = ByteArray(shape.saaCapacity),
                  sabPixels = ByteArray(shape.sabCapacity),
              )
          }
          groundedShape = shape
          GroundingResult.GROUNDED
      }
  
      fun borrow(shape: GroundedImpressionSceneShape): CaptureLease? = synchronized(lock) {
          if (closed || groundedShape != shape) return@synchronized null
          val slot = slots.firstOrNull { it.state == SlotState.FREE } ?: return@synchronized null
          val token = nextToken()
          slot.state = SlotState.CAPTURING
          slot.leaseToken = token
          CaptureLease(this, slot.index, token, shape)
      }
  
      fun snapshot(): GroundedBufferPoolSnapshot = synchronized(lock) {
          GroundedBufferPoolSnapshot(
              shape = groundedShape,
              freeSlots = slots.count { it.state == SlotState.FREE },
              capturingSlots = slots.count { it.state == SlotState.CAPTURING },
              retainedSlots = slots.count { it.state == SlotState.RETAINED },
              closed = closed,
          )
      }
  
      override fun close() = synchronized(lock) {
          if (closed) return@synchronized
          closed = true
          retireSlotsIfReleased()
      }
  
      private fun write(
          slotIndex: Int,
          token: Long,
          saaPixels: ByteArray,
          sabPixels: ByteArray,
      ) {
          val slot = slotAt(slotIndex)
          synchronized(slot.contentLock) {
              synchronized(lock) {
                  requireCurrent(slot, token, SlotState.CAPTURING)
                  check(!closed) { "Closed grounded store cannot accept captured pixels" }
                  require(saaPixels.size == slot.saaPixels.size) {
                      "SAA source must match the grounded slot capacity"
                  }
                  require(sabPixels.size == slot.sabPixels.size) {
                      "SAB source must match the grounded slot capacity"
                  }
              }
              saaPixels.copyInto(slot.saaPixels)
              sabPixels.copyInto(slot.sabPixels)
          }
      }
  
      private fun retain(
          slotIndex: Int,
          token: Long,
          shape: GroundedImpressionSceneShape,
      ): RetainedScene {
          val slot = slotAt(slotIndex)
          return synchronized(slot.contentLock) {
              synchronized(lock) {
                  requireCurrent(slot, token, SlotState.CAPTURING)
                  check(!closed) { "Closed grounded store cannot retain a capture lease" }
                  slot.state = SlotState.RETAINED
                  RetainedScene(this, slotIndex, token, shape)
              }
          }
      }
  
      private fun releaseCapture(slotIndex: Int, token: Long) {
          val slot = slotAtOrNull(slotIndex) ?: return
          synchronized(slot.contentLock) {
              synchronized(lock) {
                  if (isCurrent(slot, token, SlotState.CAPTURING)) {
                      slot.state = SlotState.FREE
                      retireSlotsIfReleased()
                  }
              }
          }
      }
  
      private fun copyRetained(
          slotIndex: Int,
          token: Long,
          saaDestination: ByteArray,
          sabDestination: ByteArray,
      ) {
          val slot = slotAt(slotIndex)
          synchronized(slot.contentLock) {
              synchronized(lock) {
                  requireCurrent(slot, token, SlotState.RETAINED)
                  check(!closed) { "Closed grounded store cannot expose retained pixels" }
                  require(saaDestination.size == slot.saaPixels.size) {
                      "SAA destination must match the grounded slot capacity"
                  }
                  require(sabDestination.size == slot.sabPixels.size) {
                      "SAB destination must match the grounded slot capacity"
                  }
              }
              slot.saaPixels.copyInto(saaDestination)
              slot.sabPixels.copyInto(sabDestination)
          }
      }
  
      private fun releaseRetained(slotIndex: Int, token: Long) {
          val slot = slotAtOrNull(slotIndex) ?: return
          synchronized(slot.contentLock) {
              synchronized(lock) {
                  if (isCurrent(slot, token, SlotState.RETAINED)) {
                      slot.state = SlotState.FREE
                      retireSlotsIfReleased()
                  }
              }
          }
      }
  
      private fun slotAt(index: Int): SceneSlot =
          slotAtOrNull(index) ?: error("Scene-slot lease belongs to a retired grounding")
  
      private fun slotAtOrNull(index: Int): SceneSlot? = synchronized(lock) {
          slots.getOrNull(index)
      }
  
      private fun requireCurrent(slot: SceneSlot, token: Long, state: SlotState) {
          check(isCurrent(slot, token, state)) { "Scene-slot lease is stale or no longer $state" }
      }
  
      private fun isCurrent(slot: SceneSlot, token: Long, state: SlotState): Boolean =
          slots.getOrNull(slot.index) === slot && slot.leaseToken == token && slot.state == state
  
      private fun retireSlotsIfReleased() {
          if (closed && slots.all { it.state == SlotState.FREE }) {
              slots = emptyList()
              groundedShape = null
          }
      }
  
      private fun nextToken(): Long {
          val token = nextLeaseToken
          nextLeaseToken = if (token == Long.MAX_VALUE) 1L else token + 1L
          return token
      }
  
      internal class CaptureLease internal constructor(
          private val owner: GroundedBufferPool,
          private val slotIndex: Int,
          private val token: Long,
          val shape: GroundedImpressionSceneShape,
      ) : AutoCloseable {
          private var transferred = false
  
          fun writeFrom(saaPixels: ByteArray, sabPixels: ByteArray) {
              check(!transferred) { "Transferred capture lease cannot be written" }
              owner.write(slotIndex, token, saaPixels, sabPixels)
          }
  
          fun retain(): RetainedScene {
              check(!transferred) { "Capture lease was already transferred" }
              return owner.retain(slotIndex, token, shape).also { transferred = true }
          }
  
          override fun close() {
              if (!transferred) owner.releaseCapture(slotIndex, token)
          }
      }
  
      internal class RetainedScene internal constructor(
          private val owner: GroundedBufferPool,
          private val slotIndex: Int,
          private val token: Long,
          val shape: GroundedImpressionSceneShape,
      ) : AutoCloseable {
          private var released = false
  
          fun copyInto(saaDestination: ByteArray, sabDestination: ByteArray) {
              check(!released) { "Released retained scene cannot be read" }
              owner.copyRetained(slotIndex, token, saaDestination, sabDestination)
          }
  
          override fun close() {
              if (released) return
              released = true
              owner.releaseRetained(slotIndex, token)
          }
      }
  
      private class SceneSlot(
          val index: Int,
          val saaPixels: ByteArray,
          val sabPixels: ByteArray,
          val contentLock: Any = Any(),
          var state: SlotState = SlotState.FREE,
          var leaseToken: Long = 0L,
      )
  
      private enum class SlotState {
          FREE,
          CAPTURING,
          RETAINED,
      }
  
      private companion object {
          const val SLOT_COUNT = 2
      }
  }

  package org.itroboc.app
  
  import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong
  
  internal class ImpressionPulseLogRecord(
      val visitId: Long,
      val generation: ImpressionGeneration,
      val correlationId: ImpressionCorrelationId,
      val openMind: Boolean,
      val compactLine: String,
      val begunAtNanos: Long,
      val analyzerTotalNanos: Long?,
      val streamDecodeNanos: Long?,
      val captureNanos: Long?,
      val frameReleaseNanos: Long?,
      val retinalToBeetleWaitNanos: Long?,
      val beetleWorkNanos: Long?,
      val beetleToMainWaitNanos: Long?,
      val mainScenePreparationNanos: Long?,
      val mainFoodPreparationNanos: Long?,
      val firstBitmapPreparationNanos: Long?,
      val preImpressionSps: ImpressionSpsSample?,
      recoverySps: List<ImpressionSpsSample>,
      val handling: String = "",
      val previewContinuity: String = "",
      val apparentFocus: String = "",
      val nextCardDelay: String = "",
      val notes: String = "",
  ) {
      val recoverySps: List<ImpressionSpsSample> = recoverySps.toList()
  
      init {
          require(visitId > 0L) { "Impression pulse log visit ID must be positive" }
          require(compactLine.startsWith(IMPRESSION_PULSE_DIAGNOSTIC_PREFIX)) {
              "Impression pulse log requires a compact diagnostic line"
          }
          require(recoverySps.size == ImpressionPulseRecorder.RECOVERY_SAMPLE_CAPACITY) {
              "Impression pulse log requires a completed recovery window"
          }
          require(preImpressionSps?.scansPerSecond?.isFinite() != false) {
              "Pre-Impression SPS must be finite"
          }
          require(recoverySps.all { it.scansPerSecond.isFinite() }) {
              "Recovery SPS must be finite"
          }
      }
  
      fun toJsonLine(): String = buildString {
          append('{')
          appendJsonLong("visitId", visitId)
          appendJsonLong("generation", generation.value)
          appendJsonLong("correlationId", correlationId.value)
          appendJsonBoolean("openMind", openMind)
          appendJsonString("imp", compactLine)
          appendJsonLong("begunAtNanos", begunAtNanos)
          appendJsonNullableLong("analyzerTotalNanos", analyzerTotalNanos)
          appendJsonNullableLong("streamDecodeNanos", streamDecodeNanos)
          appendJsonNullableLong("captureNanos", captureNanos)
          appendJsonNullableLong("frameReleaseNanos", frameReleaseNanos)
          appendJsonNullableLong("retinalToBeetleWaitNanos", retinalToBeetleWaitNanos)
          appendJsonNullableLong("beetleWorkNanos", beetleWorkNanos)
          appendJsonNullableLong("beetleToMainWaitNanos", beetleToMainWaitNanos)
          appendJsonNullableLong("mainScenePreparationNanos", mainScenePreparationNanos)
          appendJsonNullableLong("mainFoodPreparationNanos", mainFoodPreparationNanos)
          appendJsonNullableLong("firstBitmapPreparationNanos", firstBitmapPreparationNanos)
          appendJsonNullableDouble("preSps", preImpressionSps?.scansPerSecond)
          appendJsonNullableLong("preSpsObservedAtNanos", preImpressionSps?.observedAtNanos)
          appendJsonRecoverySamples(recoverySps)
          appendJsonString("handling", handling)
          appendJsonString("previewContinuity", previewContinuity)
          appendJsonString("apparentFocus", apparentFocus)
          appendJsonString("nextCardDelay", nextCardDelay)
          appendJsonString("notes", notes)
          append('}')
      }
  
      companion object {
          fun from(
              visitId: Long,
              snapshot: ImpressionPulseSnapshot,
              compactLine: String,
          ): ImpressionPulseLogRecord = ImpressionPulseLogRecord(
              visitId = visitId,
              generation = snapshot.generation,
              correlationId = snapshot.correlationId,
              openMind = requireNotNull(snapshot.openMindAtBegin) {
                  "Impression pulse log requires Open Mind posture captured at pulse begin"
              },
              compactLine = compactLine,
              begunAtNanos = snapshot.begunAtNanos,
              analyzerTotalNanos = snapshot.analyzerTotalNanos,
              streamDecodeNanos = snapshot.streamDecodeNanos,
              captureNanos = snapshot.captureNanos,
              frameReleaseNanos = snapshot.frameReleaseNanos,
              retinalToBeetleWaitNanos = snapshot.retinalToBeetleWaitNanos,
              beetleWorkNanos = snapshot.beetleWorkNanos,
              beetleToMainWaitNanos = snapshot.beetleToMainWaitNanos,
              mainScenePreparationNanos = snapshot.mainScenePreparationNanos,
              mainFoodPreparationNanos = snapshot.mainFoodPreparationNanos,
              firstBitmapPreparationNanos = snapshot.firstBitmapPreparationNanos,
              preImpressionSps = snapshot.preImpressionSps,
              recoverySps = snapshot.recoverySps,
          )
      }
  }
  
  internal class ImpressionPulseLogLedger(
      capacity: Int = DEFAULT_CAPACITY,
  ) {
      private val lock = Any()
      private val records = arrayOfNulls<ImpressionPulseLogRecord>(capacity)
      private var firstIndex = 0
      private var size = 0
  
      init {
          require(capacity > 0) { "Impression pulse log capacity must be positive" }
      }
  
      fun record(record: ImpressionPulseLogRecord): Boolean = synchronized(lock) {
          if (contains(record.visitId, record.generation, record.correlationId)) {
              return@synchronized false
          }
          if (size < records.size) {
              records[(firstIndex + size) % records.size] = record
              size++
          } else {
              records[firstIndex] = record
              firstIndex = (firstIndex + 1) % records.size
          }
          true
      }
  
      fun snapshot(): List<ImpressionPulseLogRecord> = synchronized(lock) {
          List(size) { offset -> requireNotNull(records[(firstIndex + offset) % records.size]) }
      }
  
      fun hasRecords(): Boolean = synchronized(lock) { size > 0 }
  
      /** Removes only the exported batch; records completed during sharing remain retained. */
      fun remove(exported: List<ImpressionPulseLogRecord>) = synchronized(lock) {
          if (exported.isEmpty() || size == 0) return@synchronized
          val exportedRecords = exported.toSet()
          val retained = (0 until size).mapNotNull { offset ->
              records[(firstIndex + offset) % records.size]?.takeUnless(exportedRecords::contains)
          }
          records.fill(null)
          firstIndex = 0
          size = retained.size
          retained.forEachIndexed { index, record -> records[index] = record }
      }
  
      fun clear() = synchronized(lock) {
          records.fill(null)
          firstIndex = 0
          size = 0
      }
  
      private fun contains(
          visitId: Long,
          generation: ImpressionGeneration,
          correlationId: ImpressionCorrelationId,
      ): Boolean = (0 until size).any { offset ->
          val existing = records[(firstIndex + offset) % records.size]
          existing != null && existing.visitId == visitId &&
              existing.generation == generation &&
              existing.correlationId == correlationId
      }
  
      companion object {
          internal const val DEFAULT_CAPACITY = 64
      }
  }
  
  internal object ImpressionPulseLogProcessSession {
      val ledger = ImpressionPulseLogLedger()
      private val nextVisitId = AtomicLong(1L)
  
      fun newVisitId(): Long = nextVisitId.getAndIncrement()
  }
  
  internal fun impressionPulseJsonLines(records: List<ImpressionPulseLogRecord>): String =
      records.joinToString(separator = "\n", postfix = if (records.isEmpty()) "" else "\n") {
          it.toJsonLine()
      }
  
  private fun StringBuilder.appendJsonLong(name: String, value: Long) {
      appendJsonName(name)
      append(value)
  }
  
  private fun StringBuilder.appendJsonNullableLong(name: String, value: Long?) {
      appendJsonName(name)
      append(value ?: "null")
  }
  
  private fun StringBuilder.appendJsonBoolean(name: String, value: Boolean) {
      appendJsonName(name)
      append(value)
  }
  
  private fun StringBuilder.appendJsonNullableDouble(name: String, value: Double?) {
      appendJsonName(name)
      append(value?.takeIf { it.isFinite() }?.toString() ?: "null")
  }
  
  private fun StringBuilder.appendJsonString(
      name: String,
      value: String,
  ) {
      appendJsonName(name)
      append('"').append(value.escapeJson()).append('"')
  }
  
  private fun StringBuilder.appendJsonRecoverySamples(samples: List<ImpressionSpsSample>) {
      appendJsonName("recoverySps")
      append('[')
      samples.forEachIndexed { index, sample ->
          if (index > 0) append(',')
          append('{')
          append("\"observedAtNanos\":").append(sample.observedAtNanos)
          append(",\"scansPerSecond\":")
          append(sample.scansPerSecond)
          append('}')
      }
      append(']')
  }
  
  private fun StringBuilder.appendJsonName(name: String) {
      if (isNotEmpty() && last() != '{' && last() != ',') append(',')
      append('"').append(name).append("\":")
  }
  
  private fun String.escapeJson(): String = buildString(length) {
      this@escapeJson.forEach { char ->
          when (char) {
              '\\' -> append("\\\\")
              '"' -> append("\\\"")
              '\b' -> append("\\b")
              '\u000C' -> append("\\f")
              '\n' -> append("\\n")
              '\r' -> append("\\r")
              '\t' -> append("\\t")
              else -> if (char.code < 0x20) {
                  append("\\u").append(char.code.toString(16).padStart(4, '0'))
              } else {
                  append(char)
              }
          }
      }
  }

  package org.itroboc.app
  
  internal enum class ImpressionPulseEvent {
      ANALYZER_TAP_STARTED,
      STREAM_DECODE_STARTED,
      STREAM_DECODE_FINISHED,
      CAPTURE_STARTED,
      CAPTURE_FINISHED,
      RETINAL_SUBMITTED,
      ANALYZER_FRAME_RELEASE_STARTED,
      ANALYZER_FRAME_RELEASED,
      BEETLE_STARTED,
      BEETLE_FINISHED,
      BEETLE_PUBLICATION_SUBMITTED,
      MAIN_RECEIVED,
      MAIN_SCENE_PREPARATION_STARTED,
      MAIN_SCENE_PREPARATION_FINISHED,
      MAIN_FOOD_PREPARATION_STARTED,
      MAIN_FOOD_PREPARATION_FINISHED,
      FIRST_BITMAP_PREPARATION_STARTED,
      FIRST_BITMAP_PREPARATION_FINISHED,
  }
  
  internal data class ImpressionSpsSample(
      val observedAtNanos: Long,
      val scansPerSecond: Double,
  )
  
  /** Immutable, on-demand view of one correlated pulse's primitive recorder state. */
  internal class ImpressionPulseSnapshot internal constructor(
      val generation: ImpressionGeneration,
      val correlationId: ImpressionCorrelationId,
      val begunAtNanos: Long,
      val openMindAtBegin: Boolean? = null,
      private val eventTimesNanos: LongArray,
      val preImpressionSps: ImpressionSpsSample?,
      val recoverySps: List<ImpressionSpsSample>,
  ) {
      val isComplete: Boolean
          get() = recoverySps.size == ImpressionPulseRecorder.RECOVERY_SAMPLE_CAPACITY
  
      fun timestampNanos(event: ImpressionPulseEvent): Long? =
          eventTimesNanos[event.ordinal].takeUnless { it == Long.MIN_VALUE }
  
      fun durationNanos(
          started: ImpressionPulseEvent,
          finished: ImpressionPulseEvent,
      ): Long? {
          val start = timestampNanos(started) ?: return null
          val finish = timestampNanos(finished) ?: return null
          return (finish - start).takeIf { it >= 0L }
      }
  
      val analyzerTotalNanos: Long?
          get() = durationNanos(
              ImpressionPulseEvent.ANALYZER_TAP_STARTED,
              ImpressionPulseEvent.ANALYZER_FRAME_RELEASED,
          )
  
      val streamDecodeNanos: Long?
          get() = durationNanos(
              ImpressionPulseEvent.STREAM_DECODE_STARTED,
              ImpressionPulseEvent.STREAM_DECODE_FINISHED,
          )
  
      val captureNanos: Long?
          get() = durationNanos(
              ImpressionPulseEvent.CAPTURE_STARTED,
              ImpressionPulseEvent.CAPTURE_FINISHED,
          )
  
      val frameReleaseNanos: Long?
          get() = durationNanos(
              ImpressionPulseEvent.ANALYZER_FRAME_RELEASE_STARTED,
              ImpressionPulseEvent.ANALYZER_FRAME_RELEASED,
          )
  
      val retinalToBeetleWaitNanos: Long?
          get() = durationNanos(
              ImpressionPulseEvent.RETINAL_SUBMITTED,
              ImpressionPulseEvent.BEETLE_STARTED,
          )
  
      val beetleWorkNanos: Long?
          get() = durationNanos(
              ImpressionPulseEvent.BEETLE_STARTED,
              ImpressionPulseEvent.BEETLE_FINISHED,
          )
  
      val beetleToMainWaitNanos: Long?
          get() = durationNanos(
              ImpressionPulseEvent.BEETLE_PUBLICATION_SUBMITTED,
              ImpressionPulseEvent.MAIN_RECEIVED,
          )
  
      val mainScenePreparationNanos: Long?
          get() = durationNanos(
              ImpressionPulseEvent.MAIN_SCENE_PREPARATION_STARTED,
              ImpressionPulseEvent.MAIN_SCENE_PREPARATION_FINISHED,
          )
  
      val mainFoodPreparationNanos: Long?
          get() = durationNanos(
              ImpressionPulseEvent.MAIN_FOOD_PREPARATION_STARTED,
              ImpressionPulseEvent.MAIN_FOOD_PREPARATION_FINISHED,
          )
  
      val firstBitmapPreparationNanos: Long?
          get() = durationNanos(
              ImpressionPulseEvent.FIRST_BITMAP_PREPARATION_STARTED,
              ImpressionPulseEvent.FIRST_BITMAP_PREPARATION_FINISHED,
          )
  }

  @Composable
  fun AdminActionsScreen(
      uiState: AdminProfileUiState,
      onSelectProfile: (String) -> Unit,
      onAddProfile: (String) -> Unit,
      onDeleteActiveProfile: () -> Unit,
      onExportActiveProfile: () -> DeckProfile,
      onImportProfile: (DeckProfile) -> Unit,
      onEdit: () -> Unit,
      onBack: () -> Unit
  ) {
      var showAddDialog by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
      var showDeleteDialog by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
      var messageToDisplay by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
  
      val context = LocalContext.current
      val exportLauncher = rememberLauncherForActivityResult(
          contract = ActivityResultContracts.CreateDocument("application/json")
      ) { uri ->
          uri?.let {
              try {
                  context.contentResolver.openOutputStream(it)?.use { stream ->
                      stream.write(onExportActiveProfile().toJson().toByteArray())
                      messageToDisplay = "Profile exported successfully."
                  }
              } catch (e: Exception) {
                  messageToDisplay = "Failed to export profile: ${e.message}"
              }
          }
      }
  
      val importLauncher = rememberLauncherForActivityResult(
          contract = ActivityResultContracts.OpenDocument()
      ) { uri ->
          uri?.let {
              try {
                  context.contentResolver.openInputStream(it)?.use { stream ->
                      val json = stream.bufferedReader().use { it.readText() }
                      val profile = DeckProfile.fromJson(json)
                      onImportProfile(profile)
                      messageToDisplay = "Profile \"${profile.metadata.displayName}\" imported."
                  }
              } catch (e: Exception) {
                  messageToDisplay = "Failed to import profile: ${e.message}"
              }
          }
      }
  
      Scaffold(
          topBar = {
              ItrobocTopBar(
                  title = { Text("Admin actions", style = ItrobocTextStyles.MainMenuAction) },
                  actions = {
                      Button(onClick = onBack, modifier = Modifier.aspectRatio(3f)) {
                          Text("Back", style = ItrobocTextStyles.BigVisible)
                      }
                  }
              )
          },
          bottomBar = {
              AdminBottomBar(
                  onExport = {
                      val active = uiState.activeProfile
                      if (active != null) {
                          exportLauncher.launch("${active.displayName.replace(" ", "_")}.json")
                      } else {
                          messageToDisplay = "No profile selected for export."
                      }
                  },
                  onImport = {
                      importLauncher.launch(arrayOf("application/json", "text/plain", "*/*"))
                  },
                  onEdit = onEdit,
                  onDelete = {
                      val active = uiState.activeProfile
                      if (active?.isBuiltIn == true) {
                          messageToDisplay = "Built-in profiles cannot be deleted yet."
                      } else {
                          showDeleteDialog = true
                      }
                  },
                  onSettings = { messageToDisplay = "Settings: Not implemented yet." },
                  onCalibrate = { messageToDisplay = "Calibrate: One-time pulse not implemented yet." }
              )
          }
      ) { padding ->
          Column(
              modifier = Modifier
                  .padding(padding)
                  .fillMaxSize()
          ) {
              LazyColumn(
                  modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
                  contentPadding = PaddingValues(16.dp),
                  verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)
              ) {
                  items(uiState.profiles) { profile ->
                      ProfileRow(
                          profile = profile,
                          isActive = profile.id == uiState.activeProfileId,
                          onClick = { onSelectProfile(profile.id) }
                      )
                  }
  
                  item {
                      TextButton(
                          onClick = { showAddDialog = true },
                          modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                      ) {
                          Icon(Icons.Default.Add, contentDescription = null)
                          Spacer(Modifier.width(8.dp))
                          Text("Add new")
                      }
                  }
              }
          }
      }
  
      if (showAddDialog) {
          AddProfileDialog(
              existingNames = uiState.profiles.map { it.displayName },
              onConfirm = { name ->
                  val trimmed = name.trim()
                  if (trimmed.isNotEmpty() && !uiState.hasProfileNamed(trimmed)) {
                      onAddProfile(trimmed)
                      showAddDialog = false
                  }
              },
              onDismiss = { showAddDialog = false }
          )
      }
  
      if (showDeleteDialog) {
          val activeName = uiState.activeProfile?.displayName ?: ""
          AlertDialog(
              onDismissRequest = { showDeleteDialog = false },
              title = { Text("Delete Profile") },
              text = { Text("Are you sure you want to delete the active profile \"$activeName\"?") },
              confirmButton = {
                  TextButton(onClick = {
                      onDeleteActiveProfile()
                      showDeleteDialog = false
                  }) {
                      Text("OK")
                  }
              },
              dismissButton = {
                  TextButton(onClick = { showDeleteDialog = false }) {
                      Text("Cancel")
                  }
              }
          )
      }
  
      messageToDisplay?.let { msg ->
          AlertDialog(
              onDismissRequest = { messageToDisplay = null },
              text = { Text(msg) },
              confirmButton = {
                  TextButton(onClick = { messageToDisplay = null }) {
                      Text("OK")
                  }
              }
          )
      }
  }

  @Composable
  fun AddProfileDialog(
      existingNames: List<String>,
      onConfirm: (String) -> Unit,
      onDismiss: () -> Unit
  ) {
      var name by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
      val trimmedName = name.trim()
      val nameAlreadyExists = existingNames.any { it.trim().equals(trimmedName, ignoreCase = true) }
      val nameError = when {
          trimmedName.isEmpty() -> "Profile name is required."
          nameAlreadyExists -> "A profile with this name already exists."
          else -> null
      }
  
      AlertDialog(
          onDismissRequest = onDismiss,
          title = { Text("Add new profile") },
          text = {
              OutlinedTextField(
                  value = name,
                  onValueChange = { name = it },
                  label = { Text("Profile Name") },
                  singleLine = true,
                  modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                  isError = nameError != null,
                  supportingText = {
                      if (nameError != null) {
                          Text(nameError)
                      }
                  },
              )
          },
          confirmButton = {
              TextButton(
                  onClick = { onConfirm(name) },
                  enabled = nameError == null,
              ) {
                  Text("OK")
              }
          },
          dismissButton = {
              TextButton(onClick = onDismiss) {
                  Text("Cancel")
              }
          }
      )
  }

      Surface(

                  }
                  Button(onClick = onSettings, modifier = buttonModifier, contentPadding = PaddingValues(0.dp)) {

  import org.itroboc.vision.*
  import kotlinx.coroutines.*
  import java.util.concurrent.Executor
  import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong
  
  internal class EditBoardController(
      private var onBoardEditStateChange: (BoardEditState) -> Unit,
      private val nowMillis: () -> Long = System::currentTimeMillis,
      private val snapScope: CoroutineScope = CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Dispatchers.Default),
      private val snapProcessingDispatcher: CoroutineDispatcher = Dispatchers.Default,
      private val snapDelay: suspend (Long) -> Unit = { delay(it) },
      private val snapFrameProcessor: SnapFrameAnalyzer = SnapFrameProcessor(),
      private val mainExecutor: Executor = Executor(Runnable::run),
      internal val impressionPulseRecorder: ImpressionPulseRecorder = ImpressionPulseRecorder(),
      private val impressionPulseLogLedger: ImpressionPulseLogLedger =
          ImpressionPulseLogProcessSession.ledger,
      private val impressionPulseVisitId: Long = ImpressionPulseLogProcessSession.newVisitId(),
      telemetryLaneFactory: StreamTelemetryLaneFactory = InlineStreamTelemetryLane.FACTORY,
      beetleLaneFactory: StreamBeetleLaneFactory = InlineStreamBeetleLane.FACTORY,
  ) {
      val diagnostics = EditBoardDiagnosticState()
      val snapCaptureGate = SnapCaptureGate()
  
      private val nextSnapCorrelationId = AtomicLong(1L)
      private val nextImpressionGeneration = AtomicLong(1L)
      private val nextImpressionCorrelationId = AtomicLong(1L)
  
      private var diagnosticSnapCaptureModeActive = false
      private var snapLifecycleJob: Job? = null
  
      private val streamConfigurationStore = StreamBeetleConfigurationStore()
  
      val streamMainHandoffGate = StreamMainHandoffGate()
  
      var streamTelemetrySnapshot by mutableStateOf(
          StreamTelemetrySnapshot(scansPerSecond = 0.0, outstandingMainCallbacks = 0),
      )
          private set
  
      var impressionPulseLine by mutableStateOf<String?>(null)
          private set
      var impressionPulseLogAvailable by mutableStateOf(impressionPulseLogLedger.hasRecords())
          private set
      private var publishedPulseGeneration: ImpressionGeneration? = null
      private var publishedPulseCorrelationId: ImpressionCorrelationId? = null
  
      private val streamTelemetryLane = telemetryLaneFactory.create(
          initialTimestampMillis = nowMillis(),
          outstandingMainCallbacks = streamMainHandoffGate::outstandingCallbacks,
          mainExecutor = mainExecutor,
          onSnapshot = {
              streamTelemetrySnapshot = it
              impressionPulseRecorder.observeSps(it.scansPerSecond)
              publishCompletedImpressionPulse()
          },
      )
  
      private val streamBeetleLane = beetleLaneFactory.create(
          nowMillis = nowMillis,
          mainExecutor = mainExecutor,
          mainHandoffGate = streamMainHandoffGate,
          isFrameCurrent = snapCaptureGate::accepts,
          pulseRecorder = impressionPulseRecorder,
          onPublication = ::publishBeetlePublication,
      )
  
      val impressionRetinalBridge = ImpressionRetinalBridge(
          submitToBeetle = streamBeetleLane::submitControl,
          pulseRecorder = impressionPulseRecorder,
      )
  
      private var lastSubmittedMindStatus: BeetleOperationalStatus? = null
      private var lastSubmittedFoodConfiguration: StreamConfigurationGeneration? = null
  
      // --- Inputs updated every recomposition ---
      var boardEditState by mutableStateOf(BoardEditState(0))
      var deckProfile by mutableStateOf(BuiltInDeckProfiles.defaultProfile())
      var orientationMode by mutableStateOf(BarcodeOrientationMode.BRM)
      var requiredConsensusFrames by mutableIntStateOf(TdSessionState.DEFAULT_CONSENSUS_FRAMES)
      var feedMode by mutableStateOf(TdFeedMode.STREAM)
          private set
      var snapFinderSettings by mutableStateOf(HorizontalSnapCandidateFinderSettings())
          private set
      var snapProcessingDeadlineMillis by mutableLongStateOf(
          DEFAULT_SNAP_PROCESSING_DEADLINE_MILLIS,
      )
          private set
      var snapScanState by mutableStateOf<SnapScanState>(
          SnapScanState.Streaming(snapCaptureGate.currentEpoch()),
      )
          private set
  
      // --- UI Visibility / Operational Status ---
      var hasCameraPermission by mutableStateOf(true)
          private set
      var showScissorsScreen by mutableStateOf(false)
          private set
      var showSwapScreen by mutableStateOf(false)
          private set
      private var liveCentralAreaVisible = true
  
      fun updateScissorsVisible(show: Boolean) {
          showScissorsScreen = show
          updateMindStatus()
      }
  
      fun updateSwapVisible(show: Boolean) {
          showSwapScreen = show
          updateMindStatus()
      }
  
      /** A hidden live CentralArea cannot retain cognition from its former scene. */
      fun updateLiveCentralAreaVisibility(visible: Boolean) {
          if (liveCentralAreaVisible && !visible) unimpress()
          liveCentralAreaVisible = visible
      }
  
      // --- Performance State ---
  
      // --- Scan State ---
      var lastResultMessage by mutableStateOf<String?>(null)
      var lastScannedCard by mutableStateOf<CardId?>(null)
      var thoughts by mutableStateOf(BeetleThought.Blank.presentation)
      private val impressionDisplayState = ImpressionDisplayState()
      private val foodDisplayState = FoodDisplayState()
      var impressionPresentation by mutableStateOf<ImpressionDisplaySnapshot?>(null)
          private set
      var foodPresentation by mutableStateOf<FoodDisplaySnapshot?>(null)
          private set
  
      fun update(
          state: BoardEditState,
          profile: DeckProfile,
          mode: BarcodeOrientationMode,
          requiredConsensusFrames: Int,
          snapFinderSettings: HorizontalSnapCandidateFinderSettings = this.snapFinderSettings,
          snapProcessingDeadlineMillis: Long = this.snapProcessingDeadlineMillis,
          hasCameraPermission: Boolean,
          onBoardEditStateChange: (BoardEditState) -> Unit,
      ) {
          require(snapProcessingDeadlineMillis % 1_000L == 0L)
          require(
              snapProcessingDeadlineMillis / 1_000L in
                  SnapTuningSettings.DEADLINE_SECONDS_VALUES.map(Int::toLong),
          ) { "Snap processing deadline is outside the exposed range" }
          val activeCorrelation = snapScanState.correlationOrNull()
          if (activeCorrelation != null && state.boardNumber != activeCorrelation.boardNumber) {
              cancelSnapLifecycle()
          }
          if (
              state.boardNumber != boardEditState.boardNumber ||
              state.boardState != boardEditState.boardState ||
              state.selectedSeat != boardEditState.selectedSeat ||
              profile != deckProfile
          ) {
              unimpress()
          }
          boardEditState = state
          deckProfile = profile
          orientationMode = mode
          this.requiredConsensusFrames = requiredConsensusFrames
          val streamConfiguration = streamConfigurationStore.update(
              deckProfile = profile,
              orientationMode = mode,
              requiredConsensusFrames = requiredConsensusFrames,
          )
          if (streamConfiguration.generation != lastSubmittedFoodConfiguration) {
              if (
                  streamBeetleLane.submitControl(
                      StreamBeetleCommand.ObserveFoodConfiguration(
                          orientationMode = streamConfiguration.orientationMode,
                          generation = streamConfiguration.generation,
                      ),
                  )
              ) {
                  lastSubmittedFoodConfiguration = streamConfiguration.generation
              }
          }
          this.snapFinderSettings = snapFinderSettings
          this.snapProcessingDeadlineMillis = snapProcessingDeadlineMillis
          this.hasCameraPermission = hasCameraPermission
          this.onBoardEditStateChange = onBoardEditStateChange
          streamTelemetryLane.setBoardScanned(
              BoardProgressSummary.from(state.boardState).boardScanned,
          )
          updateMindStatus()
      }
  
      private fun updateMindStatus() {
          val status = BeetleOperationalStatus(
              hasCameraPermission = hasCameraPermission,
              isScissorsOpen = showScissorsScreen,
              isSwapOpen = showSwapScreen,
              isBoardScanned = BoardProgressSummary.from(boardEditState.boardState).boardScanned
          )
          if (status == lastSubmittedMindStatus) return
          lastSubmittedMindStatus = status
          streamBeetleLane.submitControl(StreamBeetleCommand.ObserveStatus(status))
      }
  
      fun dream(topic: BeetleDream) {
          streamBeetleLane.submitControl(StreamBeetleCommand.Dream(topic))
      }
  
      fun canAcceptStreamFrame(): Boolean = streamBeetleLane.hasFrameCapacity()
  
      fun handleCameraScan(streamOutcome: StreamCameraScanOutcome) {
          if (!snapCaptureGate.accepts(streamOutcome.epoch)) return
          handleAdmittedCameraScan(streamOutcome)
      }
  
      internal fun handleCameraScan(scanOutcome: CameraScanOutcome) {
          handleCameraScan(
              StreamCameraScanOutcome(
                  epoch = snapCaptureGate.currentEpoch(),
                  outcome = scanOutcome,
              ),
          )
      }
  
      private fun handleAdmittedCameraScan(streamOutcome: StreamCameraScanOutcome) {
          val envelope = StreamFrameEnvelope(
              streamOutcome = streamOutcome,
              configuration = streamConfigurationStore.snapshot(),
              observedAtMillis = nowMillis(),
          )
          streamTelemetryLane.recordScan(envelope.observedAtMillis)
          streamBeetleLane.submitFrame(envelope)
      }
  
      private fun publishBeetlePublication(publication: StreamBeetlePublication) {
          diagnostics.observeRoiPreview(publication.roiPreview)
          publication.mindOutput?.let { output ->
              thoughts = output.snapshot.presentation
              output.acceptedCardScan?.let(::applyAcceptedCardScan)
          }
          val updatesRetainedScene =
              publication.impressionUpdate != null || publication.foodUpdate != null
          val presented = (publication.impressionUpdate as? ImpressionPresentationUpdate.Present)
              ?.snapshot
          publication.impressionUpdate?.let { update ->
              presented?.let { snapshot ->
                  impressionPulseRecorder.mainScenePreparationStarted(
                      snapshot.generation,
                      snapshot.correlationId,
                  )
              }
              try {
                  applyImpressionPresentationUpdate(update)
              } finally {
                  presented?.let { snapshot ->
                      impressionPulseRecorder.mainScenePreparationFinished(
                          snapshot.generation,
                          snapshot.correlationId,
                      )
                  }
              }
          }
          if (updatesRetainedScene) {
              presented?.let { snapshot ->
                  impressionPulseRecorder.mainFoodPreparationStarted(
                      snapshot.generation,
                      snapshot.correlationId,
                  )
              }
              try {
                  foodPresentation = foodDisplayState.apply(
                      sceneSnapshot = impressionPresentation,
                      update = publication.foodUpdate,
                  )
              } finally {
                  presented?.let { snapshot ->
                      impressionPulseRecorder.mainFoodPreparationFinished(
                          snapshot.generation,
                          snapshot.correlationId,
                      )
                  }
              }
          }
      }
  
      private fun publishCompletedImpressionPulse() {
          val snapshot = impressionPulseRecorder.completedSnapshotAfter(
              generation = publishedPulseGeneration,
              correlationId = publishedPulseCorrelationId,
          ) ?: return
          val formatted = formatImpressionPulse(snapshot) ?: return
          impressionPulseLogLedger.record(
              ImpressionPulseLogRecord.from(
                  visitId = impressionPulseVisitId,
                  snapshot = snapshot,
                  compactLine = formatted,
              ),
          )
          publishedPulseGeneration = snapshot.generation
          publishedPulseCorrelationId = snapshot.correlationId
          impressionPulseLine = formatted
          impressionPulseLogAvailable = true
      }
  
      internal fun impressionPulseLogRecords(): List<ImpressionPulseLogRecord> =
          impressionPulseLogLedger.snapshot()
  
      internal fun removeSharedImpressionPulseLogRecords(
          shared: List<ImpressionPulseLogRecord>,
      ) {
          impressionPulseLogLedger.remove(shared)
          impressionPulseLogAvailable = impressionPulseLogLedger.hasRecords()
      }
  
      private fun applyImpressionPresentationUpdate(update: ImpressionPresentationUpdate) {
          impressionPresentation = impressionDisplayState.apply(update)
      }
  
      private fun applyAcceptedCardScan(scan: AcceptedCardScan) {
          val isBoardScanned = BoardProgressSummary.from(boardEditState.boardState).boardScanned
          if (isBoardScanned) return
  
          val targetSeat = boardEditState.selectedSeat
  
          val update = EditBoardReducer.applyScannedCard(
              editState = boardEditState,
              card = scan.cardId,
              signature = scan.rawSignature,
          )
  
          emitBoardEditState(update.state)
          lastResultMessage = update.message
          if (update.lastScannedCard != null) {
              lastScannedCard = update.lastScannedCard
          }
  
          val targetHandComplete = update.state.boardState.handOf(targetSeat).isComplete()
  
          // A complete target hand makes every retained follow-up inference stale.
          if (targetHandComplete) {
              unimpress()
          } else if (
              qualifiesForImpressionCapture(
                  disposition = update.disposition,
                  provenance = scan.provenance,
                  targetHandComplete = targetHandComplete,
              )
          ) {
              armImpressionCapture(scan, targetSeat)
          }
  
          if (
              (feedMode == TdFeedMode.SNAP || diagnosticSnapCaptureModeActive) &&
              update.disposition == ScannedCardDisposition.ADDED &&
              !targetHandComplete
          ) {
              val isDiagnosticCapture = diagnosticSnapCaptureModeActive
              armSnapCapture(
                  scan = scan,
                  targetSeat = targetSeat,
                  correlation = if (isDiagnosticCapture) null else SnapBoardCorrelation(
                      boardNumber = update.state.boardNumber,
                      boardStateAfterSeed = update.state.boardState,
                      targetSeat = targetSeat,
                  ),
              )
          }
      }
  
      private fun setDiagnosticSnapCaptureModeActive(active: Boolean) {
          val wasActive = diagnosticSnapCaptureModeActive
          diagnosticSnapCaptureModeActive = active
          if (wasActive && !active) {
              resumeStreamWithoutResult()
          }
      }
  
      fun selectFeedMode(mode: TdFeedMode) {
          feedMode = mode
          if (mode == TdFeedMode.STREAM) {
              cancelSnapLifecycle()
          }
      }
  
      internal fun armDiagnosticSnapFixtureExport(): Boolean {
          val armed = diagnostics.armSnapFixtureExport(
              hasExplicitOrientation = orientationMode != BarcodeOrientationMode.AUTO,
          )
          if (armed) {
              setDiagnosticSnapCaptureModeActive(true)
          }
          return armed
      }
  
      internal fun cancelDiagnosticSnapFixtureExport() {
          setDiagnosticSnapCaptureModeActive(false)
          diagnostics.cancelSnapFixtureExport()
      }
  
      internal fun handleDiagnosticSnapCapture(outcome: SnapFrameCaptureOutcome): String? {
          if (diagnostics.snapFixtureExportState !is SnapFixtureExportState.Armed) {
              return null
          }
          setDiagnosticSnapCaptureModeActive(false)
          return diagnostics.acceptSnapCapture(outcome)
      }
  
      internal fun handleSnapCapture(outcome: SnapFrameCaptureOutcome) {
          val armed = snapScanState as? SnapScanState.Armed ?: return
          if (outcome.request.correlationId != armed.request.correlationId) return
  
          when (outcome) {
              is SnapFrameCaptureOutcome.Failed -> {
                  lastResultMessage = "Snap capture failed: ${outcome.reason}"
                  resumeStreamWithoutResult()
              }
              is SnapFrameCaptureOutcome.Captured -> beginSnapProcessing(outcome.frame, armed.correlation)
          }
      }
  
      private fun armImpressionCapture(
          scan: AcceptedCardScan,
          targetSeat: Seat,
      ) {
          val request = ImpressionCaptureRequest(
              generation = ImpressionGeneration(nextImpressionGeneration.getAndIncrement()),
              correlationId = ImpressionCorrelationId(nextImpressionCorrelationId.getAndIncrement()),
              seedCardId = scan.cardId,
              seedSignature = scan.rawSignature,
              targetSeat = targetSeat,
              boardNumber = boardEditState.boardNumber,
              boardView = ActiveBoardView.from(boardEditState, targetSeat),
              orientationMode = orientationMode,
              configurationGeneration = streamConfigurationStore.snapshot().generation,
              sourceFrameSize = scan.sourceFrameSize,
              streamRoi = SnapFrameRegion(
                  x = scan.streamRoi.x,
                  y = scan.streamRoi.y,
                  width = scan.streamRoi.width,
                  height = scan.streamRoi.height,
              ),
          )
          impressionRetinalBridge.arm(
              request = request,
              openMindAtBegin = diagnostics.isMindOpen,
          )
      }
  
      private fun armSnapCapture(
          scan: AcceptedCardScan,
          targetSeat: Seat,
          correlation: SnapBoardCorrelation?,
      ) {
          val searchDirection = orientationMode.snapSearchDirection() ?: return
          val candidateRegion = selectSnapSearchRegion(
              frameSize = scan.sourceFrameSize,
              streamRoi = scan.streamRoi,
              direction = searchDirection,
          )
          val request = SnapCaptureRequest(
                  correlationId = SnapCaptureCorrelationId(nextSnapCorrelationId.getAndIncrement()),
                  sourceFrameSize = scan.sourceFrameSize,
                  streamRoi = SnapFrameRegion(
                      x = scan.streamRoi.x,
                      y = scan.streamRoi.y,
                      width = scan.streamRoi.width,
                      height = scan.streamRoi.height,
                  ),
                  candidateRegion = candidateRegion,
                  searchDirection = searchDirection,
                  seed = SnapCaptureSeed(
                      rawSignature = scan.rawSignature,
                      cardId = scan.cardId,
                      confidence = scan.confidence,
                      widthEvidence = scan.seedWidthEvidence,
                      detectionBounds = scan.detectionBounds,
                  ),
                  targetSeat = targetSeat,
              )
          if (snapCaptureGate.arm(request) && correlation != null) {
              snapScanState = SnapScanState.Armed(request, correlation)
          }
      }
  
      private fun beginSnapProcessing(
          frame: SnapFrameCaptured,
          correlation: SnapBoardCorrelation,
      ) {
          val capturedAtMillis = nowMillis()
          val profileSnapshot = deckProfile
          val orientationSnapshot = orientationMode
          val finderSettingsSnapshot = snapFinderSettings
          val processingDeadlineSnapshotMillis = snapProcessingDeadlineMillis
          val runSettingsSnapshot = SnapRunSettingsSnapshot(
              requiredConsensusFrames = requiredConsensusFrames,
              orientationMode = orientationSnapshot,
              finderSettings = finderSettingsSnapshot,
              processingDeadlineMillis = processingDeadlineSnapshotMillis,
          )
          val deadlineAtMillis = capturedAtMillis + processingDeadlineSnapshotMillis
          snapScanState = SnapScanState.Processing(
              frame = frame,
              correlation = correlation,
              capturedAtMillis = capturedAtMillis,
              deadlineAtMillis = deadlineAtMillis,
          )
          snapLifecycleJob?.cancel()
          snapLifecycleJob = snapScope.launch {
              try {
                  val processingContext = currentCoroutineContext()
                  val analysis = withContext(snapProcessingDispatcher) {
                      snapFrameProcessor.process(
                          frame = frame,
                          deckProfile = profileSnapshot,
                          orientationMode = orientationSnapshot,
                          finderSettings = finderSettingsSnapshot,
                          workSignal = SnapCandidateWorkSignal {
                              processingContext.isActive && nowMillis() < deadlineAtMillis
                          },
                      )
                  }
                  ensureActive()
                  completeSnapProcessing(
                      frame = frame,
                      correlation = correlation,
                      capturedAtMillis = capturedAtMillis,
                      settingsSnapshot = runSettingsSnapshot,
                      analysis = analysis,
                  )
              } catch (cancellation: CancellationException) {
                  throw cancellation
              } catch (failure: Throwable) {
                  if (snapScanState.matches(frame.request.correlationId)) {
                      lastResultMessage = "Snap analysis failed: ${failure.message ?: "unknown error"}"
                      resumeStreamWithoutResult()
                  }
              }
          }
      }
  
      private suspend fun completeSnapProcessing(
          frame: SnapFrameCaptured,
          correlation: SnapBoardCorrelation,
          capturedAtMillis: Long,
          settingsSnapshot: SnapRunSettingsSnapshot,
          analysis: SnapFrameAnalysis,
      ) {
          if (!snapScanState.matches(frame.request.correlationId)) return
          if (!boardCorrelationMatches(correlation)) {
              lastResultMessage = "Snap result discarded: board changed during processing."
              resumeStreamWithoutResult()
              return
          }
  
          val knownCandidates = analysis.resolved.candidates
              .filterIsInstance<ResolvedSnapCandidate.Known>()
          val batchUpdate = EditBoardReducer.applySnapCardBatch(
              editState = boardEditState,
              targetSeat = correlation.targetSeat,
              cards = knownCandidates.map { it.cardId },
          )
          if (batchUpdate.state != boardEditState) {
              emitBoardEditState(batchUpdate.state)
          }
  
          val outcomesByCard = batchUpdate.outcomes.associateBy(SnapCardApplyOutcome::card)
          val marks = knownCandidates.mapNotNull { candidate ->
              val outcome = outcomesByCard[candidate.cardId] ?: return@mapNotNull null
              when (outcome) {
                  is SnapCardApplyOutcome.Added,
                  is SnapCardApplyOutcome.AlreadyInTarget,
                  is SnapCardApplyOutcome.InOtherSeat,
                  -> SnapPresentationMark(
                      card = candidate.cardId,
                      bounds = candidate.fullFrameBounds,
                      outcome = outcome,
                  )
                  is SnapCardApplyOutcome.CapacityBlocked -> null
              }
          }
          val presentation = SnapResultPresentation(
              frame = frame,
              marks = marks,
              summary = SnapResultSummary(
                  addedCount = batchUpdate.outcomes.count { it is SnapCardApplyOutcome.Added },
                  alreadyInTargetCount = batchUpdate.outcomes.count {
                      it is SnapCardApplyOutcome.AlreadyInTarget
                  },
                  inOtherSeatCount = batchUpdate.outcomes.count { it is SnapCardApplyOutcome.InOtherSeat },
                  capacityBlockedCount = batchUpdate.outcomes.count {
                      it is SnapCardApplyOutcome.CapacityBlocked
                  },
                  unknownCount = analysis.resolved.candidates.count {
                      it is ResolvedSnapCandidate.Unknown
                  },
                  ambiguousCount = analysis.resolved.candidates.count {
                      it is ResolvedSnapCandidate.Ambiguous
                  },
                  completed = analysis.resolved.completed,
              ),
          )
          val completedAtMillis = nowMillis()
          diagnostics.recordProcessedSnap(
              SnapRunEvidence(
                  boardNumber = correlation.boardNumber,
                  frame = frame,
                  settings = settingsSnapshot,
                  timings = analysis.timings,
                  presentation = presentation,
              ),
          )
          val resumeAtMillis = maxOf(
              capturedAtMillis + SNAP_MIN_FREEZE_MILLIS,
              completedAtMillis + SNAP_RESULT_DWELL_MILLIS,
          )
          snapScanState = SnapScanState.ShowingResult(
              presentation = presentation,
              correlation = correlation,
              resumeAtMillis = resumeAtMillis,
          )
          lastResultMessage = presentation.summary.toStatusMessage()
  
          val remainingMillis = (resumeAtMillis - nowMillis()).coerceAtLeast(0L)
          snapDelay(remainingMillis)
          currentCoroutineContext().ensureActive()
          if (snapScanState.matches(frame.request.correlationId)) {
              resumeStreamWithoutResult()
          }
      }
  
      private fun boardCorrelationMatches(correlation: SnapBoardCorrelation): Boolean =
          boardEditState.boardNumber == correlation.boardNumber &&
              boardEditState.boardState == correlation.boardStateAfterSeed
  
      internal fun cancelSnapLifecycle() {
          snapLifecycleJob?.cancel()
          snapLifecycleJob = null
          if (snapScanState !is SnapScanState.Streaming || !snapCaptureGate.isStreaming()) {
              resumeStreamWithoutResult()
          }
      }
  
      private fun resumeStreamWithoutResult() {
          snapLifecycleJob?.cancel()
          snapLifecycleJob = null
          snapScanState = SnapScanState.Streaming(snapCaptureGate.resumeStream())
      }
  
      private fun emitBoardEditState(state: BoardEditState) {
          boardEditState = state
          streamTelemetryLane.setBoardScanned(
              BoardProgressSummary.from(state.boardState).boardScanned,
          )
          onBoardEditStateChange(state)
      }
  
      fun onSeatClick(seat: Seat) {
          if (seat != boardEditState.selectedSeat) {
              unimpress()
          }
          val nextBoardEditState = boardEditState.copy(selectedSeat = seat)
          val update = EditBoardReducer.tryAutoFillFourthHand(nextBoardEditState)
          emitBoardEditState(update.state)
          if (update.message != null) {
              lastResultMessage = update.message
          }
          updateMindStatus()
      }
  
      fun onClearHand() {
          val selectedHand = boardEditState.boardState.handOf(boardEditState.selectedSeat)
          if (selectedHand.count() > 0) {
              unimpress()
              val update = EditBoardReducer.clearSelectedHand(boardEditState)
              emitBoardEditState(update.state)
              lastResultMessage = update.message
              lastScannedCard = null
          }
      }
  
      fun onClearBoard() {
          unimpress()
          val update = EditBoardReducer.clearBoard(boardEditState)
          emitBoardEditState(update.state)
          lastResultMessage = update.message
          lastScannedCard = null
      }
  
      fun onUndo() {
          unimpress()
          val update = EditBoardReducer.undoAddForSelectedHand(boardEditState)
          emitBoardEditState(update.state)
          lastResultMessage = update.message
      }
  
      fun onRemoveCard(card: CardId) {
          unimpress()
          val update = EditBoardReducer.removeCardFromSelectedHand(boardEditState, card)
          emitBoardEditState(update.state)
          lastResultMessage = update.message
      }
  
      fun onManualAddCard(card: CardId) {
          unimpress()
          val update = EditBoardReducer.addManualCardToSelectedHand(boardEditState, card)
          emitBoardEditState(update.state)
          lastResultMessage = update.message
          if (update.lastScannedCard != null) {
              lastScannedCard = update.lastScannedCard
          }
      }
  
      fun onSwapHands(targetSeat: Seat) {
          unimpress()
          val update = EditBoardReducer.swapSelectedHandWith(boardEditState, targetSeat)
          emitBoardEditState(update.state)
          lastResultMessage = update.message
      }
  
      fun onConfirmDuplicate() {
          unimpress()
          val update = EditBoardReducer.confirmDuplicateOverride(boardEditState)
          emitBoardEditState(update.state)
          lastResultMessage = update.message
      }
  
      fun closeStreamLanes() {
          impressionRetinalBridge.close()
          streamTelemetryLane.close()
          streamBeetleLane.close()
      }
  
      private fun unimpress() {
          impressionRetinalBridge.unimpress()
      }
  }
  
  private fun SnapScanState.correlationOrNull(): SnapBoardCorrelation? = when (this) {
      is SnapScanState.Streaming -> null
      is SnapScanState.Armed -> correlation
      is SnapScanState.Processing -> correlation
      is SnapScanState.ShowingResult -> correlation
  }
  
  private fun SnapScanState.matches(correlationId: SnapCaptureCorrelationId): Boolean = when (this) {
      is SnapScanState.Streaming -> false
      is SnapScanState.Armed -> request.correlationId == correlationId
      is SnapScanState.Processing -> frame.request.correlationId == correlationId
      is SnapScanState.ShowingResult -> presentation.frame.request.correlationId == correlationId
  }
  
  private fun SnapResultSummary.toStatusMessage(): String = buildString {
      append(if (completed) "Snap complete" else "Snap partial")
      append(": $addedCount added, $alreadyInTargetCount already present")
      if (inOtherSeatCount > 0) append(", $inOtherSeatCount in another hand")
      if (capacityBlockedCount > 0) append(", $capacityBlockedCount capacity-blocked")
      if (unknownCount > 0) append(", $unknownCount unknown")
      if (ambiguousCount > 0) append(", $ambiguousCount ambiguous")
      append('.')
  }
  
  internal fun CameraScanOutcome.toBeetleEvidence(
      profile: DeckProfile,
      orientationMode: BarcodeOrientationMode,
      provenance: BeetleEvidenceProvenance,
  ): BeetleEvidence? = when (this) {
      is CameraScanOutcome.Decoded -> when (val result = decodeResult) {
          is BarcodeDecodeResult.Found -> {
              val detectionBounds = result.signature.bounds?.let(SnapDetectionBounds::RoiLocal)
              val seedWidthEvidence = snapSeedWidthEvidence(
                  detectionBounds = detectionBounds,
                  frameSize = SnapFrameSize(
                      width = frameDebugInfo.width,
                      height = frameDebugInfo.height,
                  ),
                  streamRoi = roi,
              )
              val signature = result.signature.viewedAs(orientationMode) ?: return null
              val cardId = profile.lookup(signature)
              if (cardId == null) {
                  BeetleEvidence.Unknown(
                      rawSignature = signature,
                      confidence = result.signature.confidence,
                      provenance = provenance,
                  )
              } else {
                  BeetleEvidence.Known(
                      rawSignature = signature,
                      cardId = cardId,
                      confidence = result.signature.confidence,
                      seedWidthEvidence = seedWidthEvidence,
                      detectionBounds = detectionBounds,
                      sourceFrameSize = SnapFrameSize(
                          width = frameDebugInfo.width,
                          height = frameDebugInfo.height,
                      ),
                      streamRoi = roi,
                      provenance = provenance,
                  )
              }
          }
          is BarcodeDecodeResult.Ambiguous -> BeetleEvidence.Ambiguous(
              candidates = result.candidates.mapNotNull { candidate ->
                  candidate.viewedAs(orientationMode)?.let { signature ->
                      BeetleSignatureCandidate(
                          rawSignature = signature,
                          confidence = candidate.confidence,
                      )
                  }
              },
              provenance = provenance,
          )
          is BarcodeDecodeResult.NotFound -> BeetleEvidence.NotFound(result.reason, provenance = provenance)
      }
      is CameraScanOutcome.ConversionFailed -> BeetleEvidence.ConversionFailure(reason, provenance = provenance)
  }
  
  @Composable
  internal fun rememberEditBoardController(
      boardEditState: BoardEditState,
      deckProfile: DeckProfile,
      orientationMode: BarcodeOrientationMode,
      feedMode: TdFeedMode,
      requiredConsensusFrames: Int,
      snapFinderSettings: HorizontalSnapCandidateFinderSettings,
      snapProcessingDeadlineMillis: Long,
      hasCameraPermission: Boolean,
      mainExecutor: Executor,
      onBoardEditStateChange: (BoardEditState) -> Unit
  ): EditBoardController {
      val snapScope = rememberCoroutineScope()
      val controller = remember {
          EditBoardController(
              onBoardEditStateChange = onBoardEditStateChange,
              snapScope = snapScope,
              mainExecutor = mainExecutor,
              telemetryLaneFactory = ScheduledStreamTelemetryLane.FACTORY,
              beetleLaneFactory = ExecutorStreamBeetleLane.FACTORY,
          )
      }
      controller.selectFeedMode(feedMode)
      controller.update(
          state = boardEditState,
          profile = deckProfile,
          mode = orientationMode,
          requiredConsensusFrames = requiredConsensusFrames,
          snapFinderSettings = snapFinderSettings,
          snapProcessingDeadlineMillis = snapProcessingDeadlineMillis,
          hasCameraPermission = hasCameraPermission,
          onBoardEditStateChange = onBoardEditStateChange,
      )
  
      return controller
  }

## Goal
Implement the **Admin Calibration Ceremony** (P2-03c) to discover actual camera resolution and ground the pre-allocated luma buffers, fulfilling the "Aerospace Standard" of zero-allocation during flight.

## Proposed Changes

### [Phase 2: Navigation and UI (:app)] — P2-03c

#### [MODIFY] [AdminActionsScreen.kt](file:///C:/home/ITROBOC/app/src/main/java/org/itroboc/app/AdminActionsScreen.kt)

#### [MODIFY] [MainActivity.kt](file:///C:/home/ITROBOC/app/src/main/java/org/itroboc/app/MainActivity.kt)

### [Phase 3: Integration (:app)] — P2-03d

#### [MODIFY] [ImpressionFrameCapture.kt](file:///C:/home/ITROBOC/app/src/main/java/org/itroboc/app/ImpressionFrameCapture.kt)
- Update capture logic to request buffers from the `GroundedBufferPool` instead of allocating new `ByteArray`s.

  package org.itroboc.app
  
  import androidx.activity.compose.rememberLauncherForActivityResult
  import androidx.activity.result.contract.ActivityResultContracts
  import androidx.compose.foundation.clickable
  import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.*
  import androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.LazyColumn
  import androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.items
  import androidx.compose.material.icons.Icons
  import androidx.compose.material.icons.filled.Add
  import androidx.compose.material.icons.filled.Check
  import androidx.compose.material3.*
  import androidx.compose.runtime.*
  import androidx.compose.ui.Alignment
  import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
  import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color
  import androidx.compose.ui.platform.LocalContext
  import androidx.compose.ui.text.font.FontWeight
  import androidx.compose.ui.tooling.preview.Devices
  import androidx.compose.ui.tooling.preview.Preview as ComposePreview
  import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
  import org.itroboc.core.DeckProfile
  
  @Composable
  fun AdminActionsScreen(
      uiState: AdminProfileUiState,
      onSelectProfile: (String) -> Unit,
      onAddProfile: (String) -> Unit,
      onDeleteActiveProfile: () -> Unit,
      onExportActiveProfile: () -> DeckProfile,
      onImportProfile: (DeckProfile) -> Unit,
      onEdit: () -> Unit,
      onBack: () -> Unit
  ) {
      var showAddDialog by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
      var showDeleteDialog by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
      var messageToDisplay by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
  
      val context = LocalContext.current
      val exportLauncher = rememberLauncherForActivityResult(
          contract = ActivityResultContracts.CreateDocument("application/json")
      ) { uri ->
          uri?.let {
              try {
                  context.contentResolver.openOutputStream(it)?.use { stream ->
                      stream.write(onExportActiveProfile().toJson().toByteArray())
                      messageToDisplay = "Profile exported successfully."
                  }
              } catch (e: Exception) {
                  messageToDisplay = "Failed to export profile: ${e.message}"
              }
          }
      }
  
      val importLauncher = rememberLauncherForActivityResult(
          contract = ActivityResultContracts.OpenDocument()
      ) { uri ->
          uri?.let {
              try {
                  context.contentResolver.openInputStream(it)?.use { stream ->
                      val json = stream.bufferedReader().use { it.readText() }
                      val profile = DeckProfile.fromJson(json)
                      onImportProfile(profile)
                      messageToDisplay = "Profile \"${profile.metadata.displayName}\" imported."
                  }
              } catch (e: Exception) {
                  messageToDisplay = "Failed to import profile: ${e.message}"
              }
          }
      }
  
      Scaffold(
          topBar = {
              ItrobocTopBar(
                  title = { Text("Admin actions", style = ItrobocTextStyles.MainMenuAction) },
                  actions = {
                      Button(onClick = onBack, modifier = Modifier.aspectRatio(3f)) {
                          Text("Back", style = ItrobocTextStyles.BigVisible)
                      }
                  }
              )
          },
          bottomBar = {
              AdminBottomBar(
                  onExport = {
                      val active = uiState.activeProfile
                      if (active != null) {
                          exportLauncher.launch("${active.displayName.replace(" ", "_")}.json")
                      } else {
                          messageToDisplay = "No profile selected for export."
                      }
                  },
                  onImport = {
                      importLauncher.launch(arrayOf("application/json", "text/plain", "*/*"))
                  },
                  onEdit = onEdit,
                  onDelete = {
                      val active = uiState.activeProfile
                      if (active?.isBuiltIn == true) {
                          messageToDisplay = "Built-in profiles cannot be deleted yet."
                      } else {
                          showDeleteDialog = true
                      }
                  },
                  onSettings = { messageToDisplay = "Settings: Not implemented yet." },
                  onCalibrate = { messageToDisplay = "Calibrate: One-time pulse not implemented yet." }
              )
          }
      ) { padding ->
          Column(
              modifier = Modifier
                  .padding(padding)
                  .fillMaxSize()
          ) {
              LazyColumn(
                  modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
                  contentPadding = PaddingValues(16.dp),
                  verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)
              ) {
                  items(uiState.profiles) { profile ->
                      ProfileRow(
                          profile = profile,
                          isActive = profile.id == uiState.activeProfileId,
                          onClick = { onSelectProfile(profile.id) }
                      )
                  }
  
                  item {
                      TextButton(
                          onClick = { showAddDialog = true },
                          modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                      ) {
                          Icon(Icons.Default.Add, contentDescription = null)
                          Spacer(Modifier.width(8.dp))
                          Text("Add new")
                      }
                  }
              }
          }
      }
  
      if (showAddDialog) {
          AddProfileDialog(
              existingNames = uiState.profiles.map { it.displayName },
              onConfirm = { name ->
                  val trimmed = name.trim()
                  if (trimmed.isNotEmpty() && !uiState.hasProfileNamed(trimmed)) {
                      onAddProfile(trimmed)
                      showAddDialog = false
                  }
              },
              onDismiss = { showAddDialog = false }
          )
      }
  
      if (showDeleteDialog) {
          val activeName = uiState.activeProfile?.displayName ?: ""
          AlertDialog(
              onDismissRequest = { showDeleteDialog = false },
              title = { Text("Delete Profile") },
              text = { Text("Are you sure you want to delete the active profile \"$activeName\"?") },
              confirmButton = {
                  TextButton(onClick = {
                      onDeleteActiveProfile()
                      showDeleteDialog = false
                  }) {
                      Text("OK")
                  }
              },
              dismissButton = {
                  TextButton(onClick = { showDeleteDialog = false }) {
                      Text("Cancel")
                  }
              }
          )
      }
  
      messageToDisplay?.let { msg ->
          AlertDialog(
              onDismissRequest = { messageToDisplay = null },
              text = { Text(msg) },
              confirmButton = {
                  TextButton(onClick = { messageToDisplay = null }) {
                      Text("OK")
                  }
              }
          )
      }
  }
