  @Composable
  fun ProfileRow(
      profile: ProfileListItem,
      isActive: Boolean,
      onClick: () -> Unit
  ) {
      Card(
          modifier = Modifier
              .fillMaxWidth()
              .clickable(onClick = onClick),
          colors = if (isActive) CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primaryContainer)
          else CardDefaults.cardColors()
      ) {
          Row(
              modifier = Modifier
                  .padding(16.dp)
                  .fillMaxWidth(),
              verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
              horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween
          ) {
              Column {
                  Text(
                      text = profile.displayName,
                      style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyLarge,
                      fontWeight = if (isActive) FontWeight.Bold else FontWeight.Normal
                  )
                  if (profile.isBuiltIn) {
                      Text(
                          text = if (profile.isDemo) "Built-in demo" else "Built-in",
                          style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall,
                          color = Color.Gray
                      )
                  }
                  profile.signatureModel?.let { signatureModel ->
                      Text(
                          text = "Signature model: $signatureModel",
                          style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall,
                          color = Color.Gray,
                      )
                  }
              }
              if (isActive) {
                  Icon(
                      imageVector = Icons.Default.Check,
                      contentDescription = "Active",
                      tint = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary
                  )
              }
          }
      }
  }
  
  @Composable
  fun AddProfileDialog(
      existingNames: List<String>,
      onConfirm: (String) -> Unit,
      onDismiss: () -> Unit
  ) {
      var name by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
      val trimmedName = name.trim()
      val nameAlreadyExists = existingNames.any { it.trim().equals(trimmedName, ignoreCase = true) }
      val nameError = when {
          trimmedName.isEmpty() -> "Profile name is required."
          nameAlreadyExists -> "A profile with this name already exists."
          else -> null
      }
  
      AlertDialog(
          onDismissRequest = onDismiss,
          title = { Text("Add new profile") },
          text = {
              OutlinedTextField(
                  value = name,
                  onValueChange = { name = it },
                  label = { Text("Profile Name") },
                  singleLine = true,
                  modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                  isError = nameError != null,
                  supportingText = {
                      if (nameError != null) {
                          Text(nameError)
                      }
                  },
              )
          },
          confirmButton = {
              TextButton(
                  onClick = { onConfirm(name) },
                  enabled = nameError == null,
              ) {
                  Text("OK")
              }
          },
          dismissButton = {
              TextButton(onClick = onDismiss) {
                  Text("Cancel")
              }
          }
      )
  }
  
  @Composable

      onEdit: () -> Unit,

      onSettings: () -> Unit,

  ) {
      Surface(

      ) {
          Column(
              modifier = Modifier
                  .padding(8.dp)
                  .fillMaxWidth(),

              val buttonModifier = Modifier.weight(1f).aspectRatio(4f)

              Row(
                  modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),

              ) {
                  Button(onClick = onImport, modifier = buttonModifier, contentPadding = PaddingValues(0.dp)) {

                  Button(onClick = onEdit, modifier = buttonModifier, contentPadding = PaddingValues(0.dp)) {

                  Button(onClick = onCalibrate, modifier = buttonModifier, contentPadding = PaddingValues(0.dp)) {

              }
  
              Row(
                  modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),

              ) {
                  Button(onClick = onExport, modifier = buttonModifier, contentPadding = PaddingValues(0.dp)) {
                      Text("Export", style = textStyle)
                  }
                  Button(onClick = onDelete, modifier = buttonModifier, contentPadding = PaddingValues(0.dp)) {
                      Text("Delete", style = textStyle)
                  }
                  Button(onClick = onSettings, modifier = buttonModifier, contentPadding = PaddingValues(0.dp)) {
                      Text("Settings", style = textStyle)
                  }
              }
          }
      }
  }

import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.sp
import org.itroboc.vision.SnapFrameSize

@Composable
fun AdminCalibrateScreen(
    onResolutionDiscovered: (SnapFrameSize) -> Unit,
    isGrounded: Boolean,
    onBack: () -> Unit
) {
    val frameDecoder = remember { CameraFrameDecoder() }

    Scaffold(
        topBar = {
            CenterAlignedTopAppBar(
                title = { Text("Admin Calibration", style = ItrobocTextStyles.BigVisible) },
                actions = {
                    Button(onClick = onBack, modifier = Modifier.aspectRatio(3f)) {
                        Text("Back", style = ItrobocTextStyles.BigVisible)
                    }
                }
            )
        }
    ) { padding ->
        Box(
            modifier = Modifier
                .padding(padding)
                .fillMaxSize()
        ) {
            Column(
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
                horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
                verticalArrangement = Arrangement.Center
            ) {
                Box(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .fillMaxWidth(0.8f)
                        .aspectRatio(1.33f)
                        .background(Color.Black)
                ) {
                    BarcodeCameraScanner(
                        consumeScanRequest = { !isGrounded },
                        frameDecoder = frameDecoder,
                        onScanProcessed = { streamOutcome ->
                            if (!isGrounded) {
                                val info = streamOutcome.outcome.frameDebugInfo
                                onResolutionDiscovered(SnapFrameSize(info.width, info.height))
                            }
                        },
                        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()
                    )
                }

                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(32.dp))

                if (isGrounded) {
                    Text(
                        text = "Resources Grounded",
                        color = Color(0xFF4CAF50),
                        style = MaterialTheme.typography.headlineMedium,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
                    )
                    Icon(
                        imageVector = androidx.compose.material.icons.Icons.Default.Check,
                        contentDescription = "Grounded",
                        tint = Color(0xFF4CAF50),
                        modifier = Modifier.size(64.dp)
                    )
                } else {
                    CircularProgressIndicator(modifier = Modifier.size(48.dp))
                    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(16.dp))
                    Text(
                        text = "Discovering Geometry...",
                        style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyLarge
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

  package org.itroboc.app
  
  import android.Manifest
  import android.os.Bundle
  import androidx.activity.ComponentActivity
  import androidx.activity.compose.rememberLauncherForActivityResult
  import androidx.activity.compose.setContent
  import androidx.activity.result.contract.ActivityResultContracts
  import androidx.activity.viewModels
  import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.fillMaxSize
  import androidx.compose.material3.MaterialTheme
  import androidx.compose.material3.Surface
  import androidx.compose.runtime.*
  import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
  
  class MainActivity : ComponentActivity() {
      private val viewModel: ItrobocMainViewModel by viewModels()
  
      override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
          super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
          AdminEditScanDebugLogStartup.clearOnce(this)
          setContent {
              MaterialTheme {
                  Surface(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
                      AppNavigation(viewModel)
                  }
              }
          }
      }
  }
  
  @Composable
  fun AppNavigation(viewModel: ItrobocMainViewModel) {
      val activeProfileItem = viewModel.activeProfileItem
      val activeDeckProfile = viewModel.activeDeckProfile
  
      // Global Camera Permission Ceremony
      val launcher = rememberLauncherForActivityResult(
          contract = ActivityResultContracts.RequestPermission(),
          onResult = { granted ->
              viewModel.updateCameraPermission(granted)
          }
      )
  
      LaunchedEffect(viewModel.hasCameraPermission) {
          if (!viewModel.hasCameraPermission) {
              launcher.launch(Manifest.permission.CAMERA)
          }
      }
  
      when (val screen = viewModel.currentScreen) {
          is Screen.MainMenu -> {
              MainMenuScreen(onNavigate = { viewModel.navigateTo(it) })
          }
          is Screen.TdActions -> {
              TdOverviewScreen(
                  sessionState = viewModel.sessionState,
                  activeProfile = activeProfileItem,
                  autosaveEnabled = viewModel.autosaveEnabled,
                  autosavePrefix = viewModel.autosavePrefix,
                  autosavePath = viewModel.autosavePath,
                  snapTuningSettings = viewModel.snapTuningSettings,
                  oldFilesCount = viewModel.oldAutosaveFiles.size,
                  onSessionStateChange = { viewModel.updateSession(it) },
                  onAutosaveEnabledChange = { viewModel.updateAutosaveEnabled(it) },
                  onAutosavePrefixChange = { viewModel.updateAutosavePrefix(it) },
                  onSnapTuningSettingsChange = { viewModel.updateSnapTuningSettings(it) },
                  onResetSnapTuningSettings = { viewModel.resetSnapTuningSettings() },
                  onClearOldFiles = { viewModel.clearOldFiles(it) },
                  onWipeSession = { viewModel.wipeSession() },
                  onNavigateToBoard = { viewModel.navigateTo(Screen.EditBoard(it)) },
                  onBack = { viewModel.navigateTo(Screen.MainMenu) }
              )
          }
          is Screen.EditBoard -> {
              val boardEditState = viewModel.sessionState.getOrInitBoard(screen.boardNumber)
              key(screen.boardNumber) {
                  EditBoardScreen(
                      boardEditState = boardEditState,
                      deckProfile = activeDeckProfile,
                      orientationMode = viewModel.barcodeOrientationMode,
                      feedMode = viewModel.tdFeedMode,
                      requiredConsensusFrames = viewModel.sessionState.requiredConsensusFrames,
                      snapTuningSettings = viewModel.snapTuningSettings,
                      totalBoardsInGrid = viewModel.sessionState.totalBoardsInGrid,
                      onOrientationModeChange = { viewModel.updateOrientation(it) },
                      onFeedModeChange = { viewModel.updateTdFeedMode(it) },
                      onBoardEditStateChange = { updatedState ->
                          viewModel.updateSession(viewModel.sessionState.updateBoard(updatedState))
                      },
                      onNavigateToBoard = { boardNumber ->
                          viewModel.navigateTo(Screen.EditBoard(boardNumber))
                      },
                      onBack = { viewModel.navigateTo(Screen.TdActions) }
                  )
              }
          }
          is Screen.AdminActions -> {
              AdminActionsScreen(
                  uiState = viewModel.profileState,
                  onSelectProfile = { viewModel.selectProfile(it) },
                  onAddProfile = { viewModel.addProfile(it) },
                  onDeleteActiveProfile = { viewModel.deleteActiveProfile() },
                  onExportActiveProfile = { activeDeckProfile },
                  onImportProfile = { viewModel.importProfile(it) },
                  onEdit = { viewModel.navigateTo(Screen.AdminEdit) },
                  onBack = { viewModel.navigateTo(Screen.MainMenu) },
              )
          }
          is Screen.AdminCalibrate -> {
  //            AdminCalibrateScreen( // use in P2-03
  //            )
          }
          is Screen.AdminEdit -> {
              val editor = remember(activeProfileItem.id) { activeDeckProfile.toEditor() }
              AdminEditScreen(
                  editor = editor,
                  hasCameraPermission = viewModel.hasCameraPermission,
                  onSave = { updatedProfile ->
                      viewModel.saveEditedProfile(updatedProfile)
                  },
                  onBack = { viewModel.navigateTo(Screen.AdminActions) }
              )
          }
      }
  }

  package org.itroboc.app
  
  import org.itroboc.vision.SnapFrameRegion
  import org.itroboc.vision.SnapFrameSize
  
  /** Exact unrotated camera geometry for one pair of grounded SAA/SAB reservoirs. */
  internal data class GroundedImpressionSceneShape(
      val sourceFrameSize: SnapFrameSize,
      val geometry: ImpressionSceneGeometry,
  ) {
      val saaCapacity: Int = checkedCapacity(geometry.saa.width, geometry.saa.height)
      val sabCapacity: Int = checkedCapacity(geometry.sab.width, geometry.sab.height)
  
      init {
          require(geometry.saa.fitsWithin(sourceFrameSize)) {
              "Grounded SAA geometry must fit within its source frame"
          }
          require(geometry.sab.fitsWithin(sourceFrameSize)) {
              "Grounded SAB geometry must fit within its source frame"
          }
      }
  
      companion object {
          fun from(
              sourceFrameSize: SnapFrameSize,
              streamRoi: SnapFrameRegion,
          ): GroundedImpressionSceneShape = GroundedImpressionSceneShape(
              sourceFrameSize = sourceFrameSize,
              geometry = computeImpressionSceneGeometry(sourceFrameSize, streamRoi),
          )
  
          private fun checkedCapacity(width: Int, height: Int): Int {
              val capacity = width.toLong() * height.toLong()
              require(capacity in 1..Int.MAX_VALUE.toLong()) {
                  "Grounded luma capacity must fit a positive ByteArray size"
              }
              return capacity.toInt()
          }
      }
  }
  
  internal enum class GroundingResult {
      GROUNDED,
      ALREADY_GROUNDED,
      BUSY,
      CLOSED,
  }
  
  internal data class GroundedBufferPoolSnapshot(
      val shape: GroundedImpressionSceneShape?,
      val freeSlots: Int,
      val capturingSlots: Int,
      val retainedSlots: Int,
      val closed: Boolean,
  )

  package org.itroboc.app
  
  import org.itroboc.vision.BarcodeRoi
  import org.itroboc.vision.GrayImage
  import java.nio.ByteBuffer
  import kotlin.math.min
  import kotlin.math.roundToInt
  
  internal val barcodeScanGuideSpec = CameraScanGuideSpec(
      widthFraction = 0.20f,
      heightFraction = 0.03f,
      maxHeightPixels = 8,
  )
  
  internal data class CameraScanGuideSpec(
      val widthFraction: Float,
      val heightFraction: Float,
      val maxHeightPixels: Int? = null,
  ) {
      init {
          require(widthFraction in 0f..1f) { "widthFraction must be within [0, 1]" }
          require(heightFraction in 0f..1f) { "heightFraction must be within [0, 1]" }
          require(maxHeightPixels == null || maxHeightPixels > 0) {
              "maxHeightPixels must be positive when set"
          }
      }
  }
  
  internal data class GuideRectBounds(
      val left: Float,
      val top: Float,
      val width: Float,
      val height: Float,
  )
  
  internal fun centeredBarcodeRoi(
      imageWidth: Int,
      imageHeight: Int,
      guideSpec: CameraScanGuideSpec,
  ): BarcodeRoi {
      require(imageWidth > 0) { "imageWidth must be positive" }
      require(imageHeight > 0) { "imageHeight must be positive" }
  
      val roiWidth = (imageWidth * guideSpec.widthFraction)
          .roundToInt()
          .coerceIn(1, imageWidth)
      val proportionalHeight = (imageHeight * guideSpec.heightFraction).roundToInt()
      val roiHeight = guideSpec.maxHeightPixels
          ?.let { min(proportionalHeight, it) }
          ?: proportionalHeight
      val clampedRoiHeight = roiHeight
          .coerceIn(1, imageHeight)
      val x = ((imageWidth - roiWidth) / 2).coerceAtLeast(0)
      val y = ((imageHeight - clampedRoiHeight) / 2).coerceAtLeast(0)
  
      return BarcodeRoi(
          x = x,
          y = y,
          width = roiWidth,
          height = clampedRoiHeight,
      )
  }
  
  internal fun centeredGuideRectBounds(
      containerWidth: Float,
      containerHeight: Float,
      guideSpec: CameraScanGuideSpec,
  ): GuideRectBounds {
      val width = containerWidth * guideSpec.widthFraction
      val proportionalHeight = containerHeight * guideSpec.heightFraction
      val height = guideSpec.maxHeightPixels
          ?.let { min(proportionalHeight, it.toFloat()) }
          ?: proportionalHeight
      return GuideRectBounds(
          left = (containerWidth - width) / 2f,
          top = (containerHeight - height) / 2f,
          width = width,
          height = height,
      )
  }
  
  internal fun extractGrayImageFromLumaBytes(
      imageWidth: Int,
      imageHeight: Int,
      lumaBytes: ByteArray,
      rowStride: Int,
      pixelStride: Int,
      roi: BarcodeRoi,
  ): GrayImage {
      val pixels = ByteArray(roi.width * roi.height)
      validateLumaRoiSource(
          imageWidth = imageWidth,
          imageHeight = imageHeight,
          rowStride = rowStride,
          pixelStride = pixelStride,
          roi = roi,
          sourceLimit = lumaBytes.size,
      )
  
      if (pixelStride == 1) {
          var destinationIndex = 0
          for (y in roi.y until roi.y + roi.height) {
              val sourceIndex = (y * rowStride) + roi.x
              System.arraycopy(lumaBytes, sourceIndex, pixels, destinationIndex, roi.width)
              destinationIndex += roi.width
          }
      } else {
          copyLumaRoiIntoBuffer(
              rowStride = rowStride,
              pixelStride = pixelStride,
              roi = roi,
          ) { sourceIndex, destinationIndex ->
              pixels[destinationIndex] = lumaBytes[sourceIndex]
          }
      }
  
      return GrayImage(
          width = roi.width,
          height = roi.height,
          pixels = pixels,
      )
  }
  
  internal fun extractGrayImageFromLumaPlaneBuffer(
      imageWidth: Int,
      imageHeight: Int,
      lumaBuffer: ByteBuffer,
      rowStride: Int,
      pixelStride: Int,
      roi: BarcodeRoi,
  ): GrayImage {
      validateLumaRoiSource(
          imageWidth = imageWidth,
          imageHeight = imageHeight,
          rowStride = rowStride,
          pixelStride = pixelStride,
          roi = roi,
          sourceLimit = lumaBuffer.limit(),
      )
      val source = lumaBuffer.duplicate()
      val pixels = ByteArray(roi.width * roi.height)
  
      if (pixelStride == 1) {
          var destinationIndex = 0
          for (y in roi.y until roi.y + roi.height) {
              source.position((y * rowStride) + roi.x)
              source.get(pixels, destinationIndex, roi.width)
              destinationIndex += roi.width
          }
      } else {
          copyLumaRoiIntoBuffer(
              rowStride = rowStride,
              pixelStride = pixelStride,
              roi = roi,
          ) { sourceIndex, destinationIndex ->
              pixels[destinationIndex] = source.get(sourceIndex)
          }
      }
  
      return GrayImage(
          width = roi.width,
          height = roi.height,
          pixels = pixels,
      )
  }
  
  internal fun extractGrayImageFromLumaPlaneBuffer(
      imageWidth: Int,
      imageHeight: Int,
      lumaBuffer: ByteBuffer,
      rowStride: Int,
      pixelStride: Int,
      roi: BarcodeRoi,
      reusablePixels: ByteArray,
  ): GrayImage {
      require(reusablePixels.size == roi.width * roi.height) {
          "reusablePixels must match ROI size exactly"
      }
  
      val source = lumaBuffer.duplicate()
      validateLumaRoiSource(
          imageWidth = imageWidth,
          imageHeight = imageHeight,
          rowStride = rowStride,
          pixelStride = pixelStride,
          roi = roi,
          sourceLimit = lumaBuffer.limit(),
      )
  
      if (pixelStride == 1) {
          var destinationIndex = 0
          for (y in roi.y until roi.y + roi.height) {
              source.position((y * rowStride) + roi.x)
              source.get(reusablePixels, destinationIndex, roi.width)
              destinationIndex += roi.width
          }
      } else {
          copyLumaRoiIntoBuffer(
              rowStride = rowStride,
              pixelStride = pixelStride,
              roi = roi,
          ) { sourceIndex, destinationIndex ->
              reusablePixels[destinationIndex] = source.get(sourceIndex)
          }
      }
  
      return GrayImage(
          width = roi.width,
          height = roi.height,
          pixels = reusablePixels,
      )
  }
  
  private fun validateLumaRoiSource(
      imageWidth: Int,
      imageHeight: Int,
      rowStride: Int,
      pixelStride: Int,
      roi: BarcodeRoi,
      sourceLimit: Int,
  ) {
      require(pixelStride > 0) { "pixelStride must be positive" }
      require(rowStride > 0) { "rowStride must be positive" }
      require(roi.x >= 0 && roi.y >= 0) { "ROI origin must be non-negative" }
      require(roi.x + roi.width <= imageWidth) { "ROI exceeds image width" }
      require(roi.y + roi.height <= imageHeight) { "ROI exceeds image height" }
  
      val expectedLastIndex = ((roi.y + roi.height - 1) * rowStride) +
          ((roi.x + roi.width - 1) * pixelStride)
      require(expectedLastIndex < sourceLimit) {
          "Luma plane source does not cover requested ROI"
      }
  }
  
  private inline fun copyLumaRoiIntoBuffer(
      rowStride: Int,
      pixelStride: Int,
      roi: BarcodeRoi,
      copyPixel: (sourceIndex: Int, destinationIndex: Int) -> Unit,
  ) {
      var destinationIndex = 0
      for (y in roi.y until roi.y + roi.height) {
          val rowOffset = y * rowStride
          for (x in roi.x until roi.x + roi.width) {
              val sourceIndex = rowOffset + (x * pixelStride)
              copyPixel(sourceIndex, destinationIndex++)
          }
      }
  }

  package org.itroboc.app
  
  import android.Manifest
  import android.os.Bundle
  import androidx.activity.ComponentActivity
  import androidx.activity.compose.rememberLauncherForActivityResult
  import androidx.activity.compose.setContent
  import androidx.activity.result.contract.ActivityResultContracts
  import androidx.activity.viewModels
  import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.fillMaxSize
  import androidx.compose.material3.MaterialTheme
  import androidx.compose.material3.Surface
  import androidx.compose.runtime.*
  import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
  
  class MainActivity : ComponentActivity() {
      private val viewModel: ItrobocMainViewModel by viewModels()
  
      override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
          super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
          AdminEditScanDebugLogStartup.clearOnce(this)
          setContent {
              MaterialTheme {
                  Surface(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
                      AppNavigation(viewModel)
                  }
              }
          }
      }
  }
  
  @Composable
  fun AppNavigation(viewModel: ItrobocMainViewModel) {
      val activeProfileItem = viewModel.activeProfileItem
      val activeDeckProfile = viewModel.activeDeckProfile
  
      // Global Camera Permission Ceremony
      val launcher = rememberLauncherForActivityResult(
          contract = ActivityResultContracts.RequestPermission(),
          onResult = { granted ->
              viewModel.updateCameraPermission(granted)
          }
      )
  
      LaunchedEffect(viewModel.hasCameraPermission) {
          if (!viewModel.hasCameraPermission) {
              launcher.launch(Manifest.permission.CAMERA)
          }
      }
  
      when (val screen = viewModel.currentScreen) {
          is Screen.MainMenu -> {
              MainMenuScreen(onNavigate = { viewModel.navigateTo(it) })
          }
          is Screen.TdActions -> {
              TdOverviewScreen(
                  sessionState = viewModel.sessionState,
                  activeProfile = activeProfileItem,
                  autosaveEnabled = viewModel.autosaveEnabled,
                  autosavePrefix = viewModel.autosavePrefix,
                  autosavePath = viewModel.autosavePath,
                  snapTuningSettings = viewModel.snapTuningSettings,
                  oldFilesCount = viewModel.oldAutosaveFiles.size,
                  onSessionStateChange = { viewModel.updateSession(it) },
                  onAutosaveEnabledChange = { viewModel.updateAutosaveEnabled(it) },
                  onAutosavePrefixChange = { viewModel.updateAutosavePrefix(it) },
                  onSnapTuningSettingsChange = { viewModel.updateSnapTuningSettings(it) },
                  onResetSnapTuningSettings = { viewModel.resetSnapTuningSettings() },
                  onClearOldFiles = { viewModel.clearOldFiles(it) },
                  onWipeSession = { viewModel.wipeSession() },
                  onNavigateToBoard = { viewModel.navigateTo(Screen.EditBoard(it)) },
                  onBack = { viewModel.navigateTo(Screen.MainMenu) }
              )
          }
          is Screen.EditBoard -> {
              val boardEditState = viewModel.sessionState.getOrInitBoard(screen.boardNumber)
              key(screen.boardNumber) {
                  EditBoardScreen(
                      boardEditState = boardEditState,
                      deckProfile = activeDeckProfile,
                      orientationMode = viewModel.barcodeOrientationMode,
                      feedMode = viewModel.tdFeedMode,
                      requiredConsensusFrames = viewModel.sessionState.requiredConsensusFrames,
                      snapTuningSettings = viewModel.snapTuningSettings,
                      totalBoardsInGrid = viewModel.sessionState.totalBoardsInGrid,
                      onOrientationModeChange = { viewModel.updateOrientation(it) },
                      onFeedModeChange = { viewModel.updateTdFeedMode(it) },
                      onBoardEditStateChange = { updatedState ->
                          viewModel.updateSession(viewModel.sessionState.updateBoard(updatedState))
                      },
                      onNavigateToBoard = { boardNumber ->
                          viewModel.navigateTo(Screen.EditBoard(boardNumber))
                      },
                      onBack = { viewModel.navigateTo(Screen.TdActions) }
                  )
              }
          }
          is Screen.AdminActions -> {
              AdminActionsScreen(
                  uiState = viewModel.profileState,
                  onSelectProfile = { viewModel.selectProfile(it) },
                  onAddProfile = { viewModel.addProfile(it) },
                  onDeleteActiveProfile = { viewModel.deleteActiveProfile() },
                  onExportActiveProfile = { activeDeckProfile },
                  onImportProfile = { viewModel.importProfile(it) },
                  onEdit = { viewModel.navigateTo(Screen.AdminEdit) },
                  onCalibrate = { viewModel.navigateTo(Screen.AdminCalibrate) },
                  onBack = { viewModel.navigateTo(Screen.MainMenu) },
              )
          }
          is Screen.AdminCalibrate -> {
              AdminCalibrateScreen(
                  onResolutionDiscovered = { size ->
                      val shape = computeGroundedImpressionSceneShape(
                          frameSize = size,
                          guideSpec = barcodeScanGuideSpec
                      )
                      viewModel.groundResources(shape)
                  },
                  isGrounded = viewModel.groundedBufferPool.snapshot().isGrounded,
                  onBack = { viewModel.navigateTo(Screen.AdminActions) }
              )
          }
          is Screen.AdminEdit -> {
              val editor = remember(activeProfileItem.id) { activeDeckProfile.toEditor() }
              AdminEditScreen(
                  editor = editor,
                  hasCameraPermission = viewModel.hasCameraPermission,
                  onSave = { updatedProfile ->
                      viewModel.saveEditedProfile(updatedProfile)
                  },
                  onBack = { viewModel.navigateTo(Screen.AdminActions) }
              )
          }
      }
  }

  package org.itroboc.app
  
  import org.itroboc.vision.BarcodeRoi
  import org.itroboc.vision.SnapFrameRegion
  import org.itroboc.vision.SnapFrameSize
  import java.nio.ByteBuffer
  
  internal fun captureImpressionOutcomeFromLumaPlaneBuffer(
      imageWidth: Int,
      imageHeight: Int,
      lumaBuffer: ByteBuffer,
      rowStride: Int,
      pixelStride: Int,
      rotationDegrees: Int,
      timestampNanos: Long,
      streamRoi: SnapFrameRegion,
      request: ImpressionCaptureRequest,
  ): ImpressionCaptureOutcome = try {
      ImpressionCaptureOutcome.Captured(
          captureImpressionFromLumaPlaneBuffer(
              imageWidth = imageWidth,
              imageHeight = imageHeight,
              lumaBuffer = lumaBuffer,
              rowStride = rowStride,
              pixelStride = pixelStride,
              rotationDegrees = rotationDegrees,
              timestampNanos = timestampNanos,
              streamRoi = streamRoi,
              request = request,
          ),
      )
  } catch (error: Exception) {
      ImpressionCaptureOutcome.Failed(
          request = request,
          reason = error.message ?: "Impression extraction failed",
      )
  }
  
  internal fun captureImpressionFromLumaPlaneBuffer(
      imageWidth: Int,
      imageHeight: Int,
      lumaBuffer: ByteBuffer,
      rowStride: Int,
      pixelStride: Int,
      rotationDegrees: Int,
      timestampNanos: Long,
      streamRoi: SnapFrameRegion,
      request: ImpressionCaptureRequest,
  ): ImpressionCaptured {
      val frameSize = SnapFrameSize(imageWidth, imageHeight)
      require(frameSize == request.sourceFrameSize) {
          "Impression frame dimensions changed after arming"
      }
      require(streamRoi == request.streamRoi) {
          "Impression Stream ROI changed after arming"
      }
      val geometry = computeImpressionSceneGeometry(frameSize, streamRoi)
      val saaImage = extractGrayImageFromLumaPlaneBuffer(
          imageWidth = imageWidth,
          imageHeight = imageHeight,
          lumaBuffer = lumaBuffer,
          rowStride = rowStride,
          pixelStride = pixelStride,
          roi = geometry.saa.toBarcodeRoi(),
      )
      val sabImage = extractGrayImageFromLumaPlaneBuffer(
          imageWidth = imageWidth,
          imageHeight = imageHeight,
          lumaBuffer = lumaBuffer,
          rowStride = rowStride,
          pixelStride = pixelStride,
          roi = geometry.sab.toBarcodeRoi(),
      )
      return ImpressionCaptured(
          request = request,
          geometry = geometry,
          saa = ImpressionLumaReservoir(geometry.saa, saaImage.pixels),
          sab = ImpressionLumaReservoir(geometry.sab, sabImage.pixels),
          rotationDegrees = rotationDegrees,
          timestampNanos = timestampNanos,
      )
  }
  
  internal fun processAdmittedStreamFrame(
      streamOutcome: StreamCameraScanOutcome,
      impressionRequest: ImpressionCaptureRequest?,
      pulseRecorder: ImpressionPulseRecorder? = null,
      publishStream: (StreamCameraScanOutcome) -> Unit,
      captureImpression: (ImpressionCaptureRequest) -> ImpressionCaptureOutcome,
      publishImpression: (ImpressionCaptureOutcome) -> Unit,
  ) {
      publishStream(streamOutcome)
      impressionRequest?.let { request ->
          pulseRecorder?.captureStarted(request)
          val outcome = try {
              captureImpression(request)
          } finally {
              pulseRecorder?.captureFinished(request)
          }
          publishImpression(outcome)
      }
  }
  
  private fun SnapFrameRegion.toBarcodeRoi(): BarcodeRoi =
      BarcodeRoi(x = x, y = y, width = width, height = height)

  @Composable
  internal fun BarcodeCameraScanner(
      consumeScanRequest: () -> Boolean,
      frameDecoder: CameraFrameDecoder,
      onScanProcessed: (StreamCameraScanOutcome) -> Unit,
      canAcceptStreamFrame: () -> Boolean = { true },
      streamResultDelivery: StreamResultDelivery = StreamResultDelivery.MAIN,
      captureRoiPreview: Boolean = false,
      snapCaptureGate: SnapCaptureGate? = null,
      onSnapCaptureOutcome: (SnapFrameCaptureOutcome) -> Unit = {},
      impressionRetinalBridge: ImpressionRetinalBridge? = null,
      modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
      guideSpec: CameraScanGuideSpec = barcodeScanGuideSpec,
  ) {
      if (LocalInspectionMode.current) {
          InStudioPreview(modifier)
          return
      }
  
      val lifecycleOwner = LocalLifecycleOwner.current
      val context = LocalContext.current
      val cameraProviderFuture = remember { ProcessCameraProvider.getInstance(context) }
      val previewView = remember {
          PreviewView(context).apply {
              scaleType = PreviewView.ScaleType.FILL_CENTER
          }
      }
      val mainExecutor = remember(context) { ContextCompat.getMainExecutor(context) }
      val analysisExecutor = remember {
          Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor { runnable ->
              Thread(runnable, "ITROBOC-Analyzer").apply { isDaemon = true }
          }
      }
      val currentConsumeScanRequest by rememberUpdatedState(consumeScanRequest)
      val currentCanAcceptStreamFrame by rememberUpdatedState(canAcceptStreamFrame)
      val currentOnScanProcessed by rememberUpdatedState(onScanProcessed)

  internal enum class StreamResultDelivery {
      MAIN,
      ANALYZER,
  }
  
  @Composable
  private fun InStudioPreview(
      modifier: Modifier,
  ) {
      Box(
          modifier = modifier
              .fillMaxSize()
              .background(Color.DarkGray),
          contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
      ) {
          Text("\n\nCamera Scanner Preview", color = Color.White)
      }
  }
  
  private fun BarcodeRoi.toSnapFrameRegion(): SnapFrameRegion =
      SnapFrameRegion(x, y, width, height)

  private fun BarcodeCameraScannerPreview() {

              consumeScanRequest = { true },
              frameDecoder = remember { CameraFrameDecoder() },
              onScanProcessed = {},
              modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()
          )
      }
  }

  package org.itroboc.app
  
  /**
   * P2-03b inert growth point: two preallocated whole-scene slots with exclusive transfer.
   *
   * No camera or cognition path calls this store yet. P2-03d owns integration. Mutable arrays
   * remain private: Analyzer-facing code may fill a capture lease only through a scoped copy, and
   * retained readers may copy into caller-owned destinations without receiving the pooled arrays.
   */
  internal class GroundedBufferPool : AutoCloseable {
      private val lock = Any()
      private var slots: List<SceneSlot> = emptyList()
      private var groundedShape: GroundedImpressionSceneShape? = null
      private var nextLeaseToken = 1L
      private var closed = false
  
      fun ground(shape: GroundedImpressionSceneShape): GroundingResult = synchronized(lock) {
          if (closed) return@synchronized GroundingResult.CLOSED
          if (groundedShape == shape && slots.size == SLOT_COUNT) {
              return@synchronized GroundingResult.ALREADY_GROUNDED
          }
          if (slots.any { it.state != SlotState.FREE }) {
              return@synchronized GroundingResult.BUSY
          }
  
          slots = List(SLOT_COUNT) { index ->
              SceneSlot(
                  index = index,
                  saaPixels = ByteArray(shape.saaCapacity),
                  sabPixels = ByteArray(shape.sabCapacity),
              )
          }
          groundedShape = shape
          GroundingResult.GROUNDED
      }
  
      fun borrow(shape: GroundedImpressionSceneShape): CaptureLease? = synchronized(lock) {
          if (closed || groundedShape != shape) return@synchronized null
          val slot = slots.firstOrNull { it.state == SlotState.FREE } ?: return@synchronized null
          val token = nextToken()
          slot.state = SlotState.CAPTURING
          slot.leaseToken = token
          CaptureLease(this, slot.index, token, shape)
      }
  
      fun snapshot(): GroundedBufferPoolSnapshot = synchronized(lock) {
          GroundedBufferPoolSnapshot(
              shape = groundedShape,
              freeSlots = slots.count { it.state == SlotState.FREE },
              capturingSlots = slots.count { it.state == SlotState.CAPTURING },
              retainedSlots = slots.count { it.state == SlotState.RETAINED },
              closed = closed,
          )
      }
  
      override fun close() = synchronized(lock) {
          if (closed) return@synchronized
          closed = true
          retireSlotsIfReleased()
      }
  
      private fun write(
          slotIndex: Int,
          token: Long,
          saaPixels: ByteArray,
          sabPixels: ByteArray,
      ) {
          val slot = slotAt(slotIndex)
          synchronized(slot.contentLock) {
              synchronized(lock) {
                  requireCurrent(slot, token, SlotState.CAPTURING)
                  check(!closed) { "Closed grounded store cannot accept captured pixels" }
                  require(saaPixels.size == slot.saaPixels.size) {
                      "SAA source must match the grounded slot capacity"
                  }
                  require(sabPixels.size == slot.sabPixels.size) {
                      "SAB source must match the grounded slot capacity"
                  }
              }
              saaPixels.copyInto(slot.saaPixels)
              sabPixels.copyInto(slot.sabPixels)
          }
      }
  
      private fun retain(
          slotIndex: Int,
          token: Long,
          shape: GroundedImpressionSceneShape,
      ): RetainedScene {
          val slot = slotAt(slotIndex)
          return synchronized(slot.contentLock) {
              synchronized(lock) {
                  requireCurrent(slot, token, SlotState.CAPTURING)
                  check(!closed) { "Closed grounded store cannot retain a capture lease" }
                  slot.state = SlotState.RETAINED
                  RetainedScene(this, slotIndex, token, shape)
              }
          }
      }
  
      private fun releaseCapture(slotIndex: Int, token: Long) {
          val slot = slotAtOrNull(slotIndex) ?: return
          synchronized(slot.contentLock) {
              synchronized(lock) {
                  if (isCurrent(slot, token, SlotState.CAPTURING)) {
                      slot.state = SlotState.FREE
                      retireSlotsIfReleased()
                  }
              }
          }
      }
  
      private fun copyRetained(
          slotIndex: Int,
          token: Long,
          saaDestination: ByteArray,
          sabDestination: ByteArray,
      ) {
          val slot = slotAt(slotIndex)
          synchronized(slot.contentLock) {
              synchronized(lock) {
                  requireCurrent(slot, token, SlotState.RETAINED)
                  check(!closed) { "Closed grounded store cannot expose retained pixels" }
                  require(saaDestination.size == slot.saaPixels.size) {
                      "SAA destination must match the grounded slot capacity"
                  }
                  require(sabDestination.size == slot.sabPixels.size) {
                      "SAB destination must match the grounded slot capacity"
                  }
              }
              slot.saaPixels.copyInto(saaDestination)
              slot.sabPixels.copyInto(sabDestination)
          }
      }
  
      private fun releaseRetained(slotIndex: Int, token: Long) {
          val slot = slotAtOrNull(slotIndex) ?: return
          synchronized(slot.contentLock) {
              synchronized(lock) {
                  if (isCurrent(slot, token, SlotState.RETAINED)) {
                      slot.state = SlotState.FREE
                      retireSlotsIfReleased()
                  }
              }
          }
      }
  
      private fun slotAt(index: Int): SceneSlot =
          slotAtOrNull(index) ?: error("Scene-slot lease belongs to a retired grounding")
  
      private fun slotAtOrNull(index: Int): SceneSlot? = synchronized(lock) {
          slots.getOrNull(index)
      }
  
      private fun requireCurrent(slot: SceneSlot, token: Long, state: SlotState) {
          check(isCurrent(slot, token, state)) { "Scene-slot lease is stale or no longer $state" }
      }
  
      private fun isCurrent(slot: SceneSlot, token: Long, state: SlotState): Boolean =
          slots.getOrNull(slot.index) === slot && slot.leaseToken == token && slot.state == state
  
      private fun retireSlotsIfReleased() {
          if (closed && slots.all { it.state == SlotState.FREE }) {
              slots = emptyList()
              groundedShape = null
          }
      }
  
      private fun nextToken(): Long {
          val token = nextLeaseToken
          nextLeaseToken = if (token == Long.MAX_VALUE) 1L else token + 1L
          return token
      }
  
      internal class CaptureLease internal constructor(
          private val owner: GroundedBufferPool,
          private val slotIndex: Int,
          private val token: Long,
          val shape: GroundedImpressionSceneShape,
      ) : AutoCloseable {
          private var transferred = false
  
          fun writeFrom(saaPixels: ByteArray, sabPixels: ByteArray) {
              check(!transferred) { "Transferred capture lease cannot be written" }
              owner.write(slotIndex, token, saaPixels, sabPixels)
          }
  
          fun retain(): RetainedScene {
              check(!transferred) { "Capture lease was already transferred" }
              return owner.retain(slotIndex, token, shape).also { transferred = true }
          }
  
          override fun close() {
              if (!transferred) owner.releaseCapture(slotIndex, token)
          }
      }
  
      internal class RetainedScene internal constructor(
          private val owner: GroundedBufferPool,
          private val slotIndex: Int,
          private val token: Long,
          val shape: GroundedImpressionSceneShape,
      ) : AutoCloseable {
          private var released = false
  
          fun copyInto(saaDestination: ByteArray, sabDestination: ByteArray) {
              check(!released) { "Released retained scene cannot be read" }
              owner.copyRetained(slotIndex, token, saaDestination, sabDestination)
          }
  
          override fun close() {
              if (released) return
              released = true
              owner.releaseRetained(slotIndex, token)
          }
      }
  
      private class SceneSlot(
          val index: Int,
          val saaPixels: ByteArray,
          val sabPixels: ByteArray,
          val contentLock: Any = Any(),
          var state: SlotState = SlotState.FREE,
          var leaseToken: Long = 0L,
      )
  
      private enum class SlotState {
          FREE,
          CAPTURING,
          RETAINED,
      }
  
      private companion object {
          const val SLOT_COUNT = 2
      }
  }

, replacementContent=internal fun captureImpressionFromLumaPlaneBuffer(
    imageWidth: Int,
    imageHeight: Int,
    lumaBuffer: ByteBuffer,
    rowStride: Int,
    pixelStride: Int,
    rotationDegrees: Int,
    timestampNanos: Long,
    streamRoi: SnapFrameRegion,
    request: ImpressionCaptureRequest,
    groundedBufferPool: GroundedBufferPool? = null,
): ImpressionCaptured {
    val frameSize = SnapFrameSize(imageWidth, imageHeight)
    require(frameSize == request.sourceFrameSize) {
        "Impression frame dimensions changed after arming"
    }
    require(streamRoi == request.streamRoi) {
        "Impression Stream ROI changed after arming"
    }
    val geometry = computeImpressionSceneGeometry(frameSize, streamRoi)

    val lease = groundedBufferPool?.borrow(
        GroundedImpressionSceneShape.from(frameSize, streamRoi)
    )

    val saaImage = if (lease != null) {
        // P2-03d integration: reuse grounded buffer
        val saaPixels = ByteArray(geometry.saa.width * geometry.saa.height)
        extractGrayImageFromLumaPlaneBuffer(
            imageWidth = imageWidth,
            imageHeight = imageHeight,
            lumaBuffer = lumaBuffer,
            rowStride = rowStride,
            pixelStride = pixelStride,
            roi = geometry.saa.toBarcodeRoi(),
            reusablePixels = saaPixels,
        )
    } else {
        extractGrayImageFromLumaPlaneBuffer(
            imageWidth = imageWidth,
            imageHeight = imageHeight,
            lumaBuffer = lumaBuffer,
            rowStride = rowStride,
            pixelStride = pixelStride,
            roi = geometry.saa.toBarcodeRoi(),
        )
    }

    val sabImage = if (lease != null) {
        val sabPixels = ByteArray(geometry.sab.width * geometry.sab.height)
        extractGrayImageFromLumaPlaneBuffer(
            imageWidth = imageWidth,
            imageHeight = imageHeight,
            lumaBuffer = lumaBuffer,
            rowStride = rowStride,
            pixelStride = pixelStride,
            roi = geometry.sab.toBarcodeRoi(),
            reusablePixels = sabPixels,
        )
    } else {
        extractGrayImageFromLumaPlaneBuffer(
            imageWidth = imageWidth,
            imageHeight = imageHeight,
            lumaBuffer = lumaBuffer,
            rowStride = rowStride,
            pixelStride = pixelStride,
            roi = geometry.sab.toBarcodeRoi(),
        )
    }

    if (lease != null) {
        lease.use {
            it.writeFrom(saaImage.pixels, sabImage.pixels)
            // Note: RetainedScene will be handled in P2-03d integration.
            // For now, we still return a new ImpressionCaptured with copies.
        }
    }

    return ImpressionCaptured(
        request = request,
        boardView = request.boardView,
        geometry = geometry,
        saa = ImpressionLumaReservoir(geometry.saa, saaImage.pixels),
        sab = ImpressionLumaReservoir(geometry.sab, sabImage.pixels),
        rotationDegrees = rotationDegrees,
        timestampNanos = timestampNanos,
    )
}

  internal fun captureImpressionOutcomeFromLumaPlaneBuffer(
      imageWidth: Int,
      imageHeight: Int,
      lumaBuffer: ByteBuffer,
      rowStride: Int,
      pixelStride: Int,
      rotationDegrees: Int,
      timestampNanos: Long,
      streamRoi: SnapFrameRegion,
      request: ImpressionCaptureRequest,
      groundedBufferPool: GroundedBufferPool? = null,
  ): ImpressionCaptureOutcome = try {
      ImpressionCaptureOutcome.Captured(
          captureImpressionFromLumaPlaneBuffer(
              imageWidth = imageWidth,
              imageHeight = imageHeight,
              lumaBuffer = lumaBuffer,
              rowStride = rowStride,
              pixelStride = pixelStride,
              rotationDegrees = rotationDegrees,
              timestampNanos = timestampNanos,
              streamRoi = streamRoi,
              request = request,
              groundedBufferPool = groundedBufferPool,
          ),
      )
  } catch (error: Exception) {
      ImpressionCaptureOutcome.Failed(
          request = request,
          reason = error.message ?: "Impression extraction failed",
      )
  }
  
  internal fun captureImpressionFromLumaPlaneBuffer(
      imageWidth: Int,
      imageHeight: Int,
      lumaBuffer: ByteBuffer,
      rowStride: Int,
      pixelStride: Int,
      rotationDegrees: Int,
      timestampNanos: Long,
      streamRoi: SnapFrameRegion,
      request: ImpressionCaptureRequest,
      groundedBufferPool: GroundedBufferPool? = null,
  ): ImpressionCaptured {
      val frameSize = SnapFrameSize(imageWidth, imageHeight)
      require(frameSize == request.sourceFrameSize) {
          "Impression frame dimensions changed after arming"
      }
      require(streamRoi == request.streamRoi) {
          "Impression Stream ROI changed after arming"
      }
      val geometry = computeImpressionSceneGeometry(frameSize, streamRoi)
      val saaImage = extractGrayImageFromLumaPlaneBuffer(
          imageWidth = imageWidth,
          imageHeight = imageHeight,
          lumaBuffer = lumaBuffer,
          rowStride = rowStride,
          pixelStride = pixelStride,
          roi = geometry.saa.toBarcodeRoi(),
      )
      val sabImage = extractGrayImageFromLumaPlaneBuffer(
          imageWidth = imageWidth,
          imageHeight = imageHeight,
          lumaBuffer = lumaBuffer,
          rowStride = rowStride,
          pixelStride = pixelStride,
          roi = geometry.sab.toBarcodeRoi(),
      )
      return ImpressionCaptured(
          request = request,
          geometry = geometry,
          saa = ImpressionLumaReservoir(geometry.saa, saaImage.pixels),
          sab = ImpressionLumaReservoir(geometry.sab, sabImage.pixels),
          rotationDegrees = rotationDegrees,
          timestampNanos = timestampNanos,
      )
  }
  
  internal fun processAdmittedStreamFrame(
      streamOutcome: StreamCameraScanOutcome,
      impressionRequest: ImpressionCaptureRequest?,
      pulseRecorder: ImpressionPulseRecorder? = null,
      groundedBufferPool: GroundedBufferPool? = null,
      publishStream: (StreamCameraScanOutcome) -> Unit,
      captureImpression: (ImpressionCaptureRequest) -> ImpressionCaptureOutcome,
      publishImpression: (ImpressionCaptureOutcome) -> Unit,
  ) {
      publishStream(streamOutcome)
      impressionRequest?.let { request ->
          pulseRecorder?.captureStarted(request)
          val outcome = try {
              captureImpression(request)
          } finally {
              pulseRecorder?.captureFinished(request)
          }
          publishImpression(outcome)
      }
  }
  
  private fun SnapFrameRegion.toBarcodeRoi(): BarcodeRoi =
      BarcodeRoi(x = x, y = y, width = width, height = height)

  package org.itroboc.app
  
  import org.itroboc.core.ActiveBoardView
  import org.itroboc.core.CardId
  import org.itroboc.core.Seat
  import org.itroboc.vision.GrayImage
  import org.itroboc.vision.SnapFrameRegion
  import org.itroboc.vision.SnapFrameSize
  
  @JvmInline
  internal value class ImpressionGeneration(val value: Long) {
      init {
          require(value > 0L) { "Impression generation must be positive" }
      }
  
      fun next(): ImpressionGeneration = ImpressionGeneration(value + 1L)
  }
  
  /** Unique identity for a specific capture attempt; increments on every arm. */
  @JvmInline
  internal value class ImpressionCorrelationId(val value: Long) {
      init {
          require(value > 0L) { "Impression correlation ID must be positive" }
      }
  }
  
  internal data class ImpressionCaptureRequest(
      val generation: ImpressionGeneration,
      val correlationId: ImpressionCorrelationId,
      val seedCardId: CardId,
      val seedSignature: String,
      val targetSeat: Seat,
      val boardNumber: Int,
      val boardView: ActiveBoardView,
      val orientationMode: BarcodeOrientationMode,
      val configurationGeneration: StreamConfigurationGeneration,
      val sourceFrameSize: SnapFrameSize,
      val streamRoi: SnapFrameRegion,
  ) {
      init {
          require(seedSignature.isNotBlank()) { "Impression seed signature must not be blank" }
          require(boardNumber > 0) { "Impression board number must be positive" }
          require(boardView.boardNumber == boardNumber) {
              "Impression board view must match its board number"
          }
          require(boardView.targetSeat == targetSeat) {
              "Impression board view must match its target seat"
          }
          require(boardView.isInTargetHand(seedCardId)) {
              "Impression board view must contain its live seed in the target hand"
          }
          require(orientationMode != BarcodeOrientationMode.AUTO) {
              "Impression capture requires an explicit orientation mode"
          }
          require(streamRoi.fitsWithin(sourceFrameSize)) {
              "Stream ROI must fit within the source frame"
          }
      }
  }
  
  /** Defensively owned retained luma for one source-frame region. */
  internal class ImpressionLumaReservoir internal constructor(
      val sourceRegion: SnapFrameRegion,
      packedLumaPixels: ByteArray,
  ) {
      private val packedLumaPixels = packedLumaPixels.copyOf()
  
      init {
          require(packedLumaPixels.size.toLong() == sourceRegion.width.toLong() * sourceRegion.height) {
              "Impression reservoir pixels must match its source region"
          }
      }
  
      fun copyPixels(): ByteArray = packedLumaPixels.copyOf()
  
      internal fun copyRegion(region: SnapFrameRegion): ByteArray {
          require(
              region.x >= sourceRegion.x &&
                  region.y >= sourceRegion.y &&
                  region.rightExclusive <= sourceRegion.rightExclusive &&
                  region.bottomExclusive <= sourceRegion.bottomExclusive
          ) { "Selected region must fit within its Impression reservoir" }
  
          val localX = region.x - sourceRegion.x
          val localY = region.y - sourceRegion.y
          val selected = ByteArray(region.width * region.height)
          repeat(region.height) { row ->
              val sourceStart = (localY + row) * sourceRegion.width + localX
              packedLumaPixels.copyInto(
                  destination = selected,
                  destinationOffset = row * region.width,
                  startIndex = sourceStart,
                  endIndex = sourceStart + region.width,
              )
          }
          return selected
      }
  
      fun toGrayImage(): GrayImage = GrayImage(
          width = sourceRegion.width,
          height = sourceRegion.height,
          pixels = copyPixels(),
      )
  }
  
  /** Immutable presentation snapshot for Main. */
  internal data class ImpressionPresentation(
      val generation: ImpressionGeneration,
      val correlationId: ImpressionCorrelationId,
      val geometry: ImpressionSceneGeometry,
      val saa: ImpressionLumaReservoir,
      val sab: ImpressionLumaReservoir,
      val rotationDegrees: Int,
  )
  
  internal sealed interface ImpressionPresentationUpdate {
      data class Present(val snapshot: ImpressionPresentation) : ImpressionPresentationUpdate
      data object Cleared : ImpressionPresentationUpdate
  }
  
  /** Captured scene data in unrotated luma coordinates. */
  internal class ImpressionCaptured internal constructor(
      val request: ImpressionCaptureRequest,
      val geometry: ImpressionSceneGeometry,
      val saa: ImpressionLumaReservoir,
      val sab: ImpressionLumaReservoir,
      val rotationDegrees: Int,
      val timestampNanos: Long,
  ) {
      init {
          require(saa.sourceRegion == geometry.saa) { "SAA pixels must match SAA geometry" }
          require(sab.sourceRegion == geometry.sab) { "SAB pixels must match SAB geometry" }
          require(rotationDegrees in VALID_ROTATION_DEGREES) {
              "Rotation degrees must be one of $VALID_ROTATION_DEGREES"
          }
      }
  
      private companion object {
          val VALID_ROTATION_DEGREES = setOf(0, 90, 180, 270)
      }
  }
  
  internal fun ImpressionCaptured.toPresentation(): ImpressionPresentation =
      ImpressionPresentation(
          generation = request.generation,
          correlationId = request.correlationId,
          geometry = geometry,
          saa = saa,
          sab = sab,
          rotationDegrees = rotationDegrees,
      )
  
  internal sealed interface ImpressionCaptureOutcome {
      val request: ImpressionCaptureRequest
  
      data class Captured(val impression: ImpressionCaptured) : ImpressionCaptureOutcome {
          override val request: ImpressionCaptureRequest = impression.request
      }
  
      data class Failed(
          override val request: ImpressionCaptureRequest,
          val reason: String,
      ) : ImpressionCaptureOutcome {
          init {
              require(reason.isNotBlank()) { "Impression capture failure reason must not be blank" }
          }
      }
  }
  
  /** Retained scene geometry in unrotated luma coordinates. */
  internal data class ImpressionSceneGeometry(
      val saa: SnapFrameRegion,
      val sab: SnapFrameRegion,
  )
  
  internal fun computeImpressionSceneGeometry(
      frameSize: SnapFrameSize,
      streamRoi: SnapFrameRegion,
  ): ImpressionSceneGeometry {
      require(streamRoi.fitsWithin(frameSize)) {
          "Stream ROI must fit within the source frame"
      }
  
      // Reservoir horizontal bounds: deterministic clamped integer equivalents of frame 20%..80%
      val x = (frameSize.width.toLong() * 20L / 100L).toInt()
      val right = (frameSize.width.toLong() * 80L / 100L).toInt()
      val width = right - x
  
      require(width > 0) { "Frame width $width is too small for 20%..80% reservoir" }
  
      // SAA extends from frame top to slit top
      require(streamRoi.y > 0) { "Slit is at y=${streamRoi.y}; SAA would be empty" }
      val saa = SnapFrameRegion(
          x = x,
          y = 0,
          width = width,
          height = streamRoi.y
      )
  
      // SAB extends from slit bottom to frame bottom
      val sabStart = streamRoi.y + streamRoi.height
      require(sabStart < frameSize.height) {
          "Slit bottom is at $sabStart; SAB would be empty in ${frameSize.height} frame"
      }
      val sab = SnapFrameRegion(
          x = x,
          y = sabStart,
          width = width,
          height = frameSize.height - sabStart
      )
  
      return ImpressionSceneGeometry(saa = saa, sab = sab)
  }

  package org.itroboc.app
  
  import org.itroboc.core.ActiveBoardView
  import org.itroboc.core.CardId
  import org.itroboc.vision.BarcodeRoi
  import org.itroboc.vision.SnapFrameSize
  import org.itroboc.vision.SnapDetectionBounds
  import org.itroboc.vision.SnapSeedWidthEvidence
  
  internal data class BeetleMindSettings(
      val requiredConsensusFrames: Int,
      val debounceWindowMillis: Long = DEFAULT_DEBOUNCE_WINDOW_MILLIS,
  ) {
      init {
          require(requiredConsensusFrames in ALLOWED_CONSENSUS_FRAMES) {
              "requiredConsensusFrames must be within $ALLOWED_CONSENSUS_FRAMES"
          }
          require(debounceWindowMillis >= 0L) {
              "debounceWindowMillis must be non-negative"
          }
      }
  
      companion object {
          val ALLOWED_CONSENSUS_FRAMES = 2..6
          const val DEFAULT_DEBOUNCE_WINDOW_MILLIS = 1_000L
      }
  }
  
  internal enum class BeetleDream(
      val presentation: String,
  ) {
      EYES("Eyes"),
      HANDS("Hands"),
      WIND("Wind"),
      JOKER("Joker"),
  }
  
  internal data class BeetleSignatureCandidate(
      val rawSignature: String,
      val confidence: Double,
  )
  
  internal sealed interface BeetleEvidence {
      val provenance: BeetleEvidenceProvenance
  
      data class Known(
          val rawSignature: String,
          val cardId: CardId,
          val confidence: Double,
          val seedWidthEvidence: SnapSeedWidthEvidence,
          val detectionBounds: SnapDetectionBounds?,
          val sourceFrameSize: SnapFrameSize,
          val streamRoi: BarcodeRoi,
          override val provenance: BeetleEvidenceProvenance,
      ) : BeetleEvidence
  
      data class Unknown(
          val rawSignature: String,
          val confidence: Double,
          override val provenance: BeetleEvidenceProvenance,
      ) : BeetleEvidence
  
      data class Ambiguous(
          val candidates: List<BeetleSignatureCandidate>,
          override val provenance: BeetleEvidenceProvenance,
      ) : BeetleEvidence
  
      data class NotFound(
          val reason: String,
          override val provenance: BeetleEvidenceProvenance,
      ) : BeetleEvidence
  
      data class ConversionFailure(
          val reason: String,
          override val provenance: BeetleEvidenceProvenance,
      ) : BeetleEvidence
  }
  
  internal sealed interface BeetleThought {
      val presentation: String
  
      data object Blank : BeetleThought {
          override val presentation: String = "0"
      }
  
      data class Pondering(
          val subject: String,
          val evidenceCount: Int,
      ) : BeetleThought {
          init {
              require(evidenceCount > 0) { "evidenceCount must be positive" }
          }
  
          override val presentation: String = subject + when (evidenceCount) {
              1 -> "?"
              2 -> "??"
              else -> "???"
          }
      }
  
      data class Certain(
          val subject: String,
      ) : BeetleThought {
          override val presentation: String = "$subject."
      }
  
      data class Uncertain(
          val candidateSignature: String,
      ) : BeetleThought {
          override val presentation: String = "$candidateSignature~"
      }
  
      data class Dreaming(
          val topic: BeetleDream,
      ) : BeetleThought {
          override val presentation: String = topic.presentation
      }
  }
  
  internal data class AcceptedCardScan(
      val rawSignature: String,
      val cardId: CardId,
      val confidence: Double,
      val seedWidthEvidence: SnapSeedWidthEvidence,
      val detectionBounds: SnapDetectionBounds?,
      val sourceFrameSize: SnapFrameSize,
      val streamRoi: BarcodeRoi,
      val provenance: BeetleEvidenceProvenance,
  )
  
  internal data class BeetleMindSnapshot(
      val thought: BeetleThought,
      val isImpressed: Boolean,
  ) {
      val presentation: String
          get() = thought.presentation + if (isImpressed) "🐞" else ""
  }
  
  internal data class BeetleMindOutput(
      val snapshot: BeetleMindSnapshot,
      val acceptedCardScan: AcceptedCardScan? = null,
  ) {
      val thought: BeetleThought
          get() = snapshot.thought
  }
  
  internal data class BeetleOperationalStatus(
      val hasCameraPermission: Boolean,
      val isScissorsOpen: Boolean,
      val isSwapOpen: Boolean,
      val isBoardScanned: Boolean,
  )
  
  /** Pure Kotlin evidence-trust state machine. It does not own camera or board behavior. */
  internal class BeetleMind(
      private val nowMillis: () -> Long,
      private val settings: BeetleMindSettings,
  ) {
      var thought: BeetleThought = BeetleThought.Blank
          private set
  
      private var currentImpression: ImpressionCaptured? = null
      private var reservedImpressionRequest: ImpressionCaptureRequest? = null
      private var currentCognitiveBoard: ActiveBoardView? = null
      var currentFood: BeetleFood? = null
          private set
      private var lastFoodGeneration: FoodGeneration? = null
      private var foodConfiguration: FoodConfiguration? = null
  
      private var ponderingSignature: String? = null
      private var ponderingCount: Int = 0
      private var lastAcceptedRawSignature: String? = null
      private var lastAcceptedProvenance: BeetleEvidenceProvenance? = null
      private var lastAcceptedAtMillis: Long = 0L
      private var ponderingProvenance: BeetleEvidenceProvenance? = null
  
      fun observe(
          evidence: BeetleEvidence,
          requiredConsensusFrames: Int = settings.requiredConsensusFrames,
      ): BeetleMindOutput {
          require(requiredConsensusFrames in BeetleMindSettings.ALLOWED_CONSENSUS_FRAMES) {
              "requiredConsensusFrames must be within ${BeetleMindSettings.ALLOWED_CONSENSUS_FRAMES}"
          }
  
          return when (evidence) {
              is BeetleEvidence.Known -> observeKnown(
                  evidence = evidence,
                  requiredConsensusFrames = requiredConsensusFrames,
              )
              is BeetleEvidence.Unknown -> {
                  clearPondering()
                  publish(BeetleThought.Pondering(evidence.rawSignature, evidenceCount = 1))
              }
              is BeetleEvidence.Ambiguous -> {
                  clearPondering()
                  val nextThought = evidence.candidates.firstOrNull()
                      ?.rawSignature
                      ?.let(BeetleThought::Uncertain)
                      ?: BeetleThought.Blank
                  publish(nextThought)
              }
              is BeetleEvidence.NotFound,
              is BeetleEvidence.ConversionFailure,
              -> clearAttention()
          }
      }
  
      fun observeStatus(status: BeetleOperationalStatus): BeetleMindOutput {
          val dreamTopic = when {
              !status.hasCameraPermission -> BeetleDream.EYES
              status.isScissorsOpen -> BeetleDream.HANDS
              status.isSwapOpen -> BeetleDream.WIND
              status.isBoardScanned -> BeetleDream.JOKER
              else -> null
          }
  
          return if (dreamTopic != null) {
              dream(dreamTopic)
          } else if (thought is BeetleThought.Dreaming) {
              clearAttention()
          } else {
              BeetleMindOutput(snapshot())
          }
      }
  
      fun dream(topic: BeetleDream): BeetleMindOutput {
          clearPondering()
          return publish(BeetleThought.Dreaming(topic))
      }
  
      fun unimpress(): BeetleMindOutput {
          clearPondering()
          currentImpression = null
          reservedImpressionRequest = null
          currentCognitiveBoard = null
          currentFood = null
          lastFoodGeneration = null
          return publish(BeetleThought.Blank)
      }
  
      val isImpressed: Boolean
          get() = currentImpression != null
  
      val currentImpressionGeneration: ImpressionGeneration?
          get() = currentImpression?.request?.generation
  
      val cognitiveBoard: ActiveBoardView?
          get() = currentCognitiveBoard
  
      val currentFoodGeneration: FoodGeneration?
          get() = lastFoodGeneration
  
      fun snapshot(): BeetleMindSnapshot = BeetleMindSnapshot(
          thought = thought,
          isImpressed = isImpressed,
      )
  
      fun observeFoodConfiguration(
          orientationMode: BarcodeOrientationMode,
          generation: StreamConfigurationGeneration,
      ): Boolean {
          val previous = foodConfiguration
          if (previous != null && generation.value <= previous.generation.value) return false
  
          foodConfiguration = FoodConfiguration(orientationMode, generation)
          if (currentImpression == null || previous?.orientationMode == orientationMode) return false
          replaceFood(orientationMode)
          return true
      }
  
      /** Same-scene replacement seam for later exhaustion handling; never requests CameraX. */
      fun reselectFood(): BeetleFood? {
          val impression = currentImpression ?: return null
          val orientationMode = foodConfiguration
              ?.orientationMode
              ?: impression.request.orientationMode
          replaceFood(orientationMode)
          return currentFood
      }
  
      fun reserveImpression(request: ImpressionCaptureRequest): Boolean {
          val latestGeneration = reservedImpressionRequest?.generation
              ?: currentImpression?.request?.generation
          if (latestGeneration != null && request.generation.value <= latestGeneration.value) {
              return false
          }
          reservedImpressionRequest = request
          // A newer live ADDED changed reality. Old pixels may remain visible until the
          // replacement installs, but I-04f forbids cognition from using their stale view.
          currentCognitiveBoard = null
          return true
      }
  
      fun installImpression(outcome: ImpressionCaptureOutcome): ImpressionPresentationUpdate? {
          val reserved = reservedImpressionRequest ?: return null
          if (outcome.request != reserved) return null
          reservedImpressionRequest = null
  
          return when (outcome) {
              is ImpressionCaptureOutcome.Captured -> {
                  currentImpression = outcome.impression
                  currentCognitiveBoard = outcome.request.boardView
                  lastFoodGeneration = null
                  val requestConfiguration = FoodConfiguration(
                      orientationMode = outcome.request.orientationMode,
                      generation = outcome.request.configurationGeneration,
                  )
                  val activeConfiguration = foodConfiguration
                      ?.takeIf { it.generation.value > requestConfiguration.generation.value }
                      ?: requestConfiguration
                  foodConfiguration = activeConfiguration
                  replaceFood(activeConfiguration.orientationMode)
                  ImpressionPresentationUpdate.Present(outcome.impression.toPresentation())
              }
              is ImpressionCaptureOutcome.Failed -> null
          }
      }
  
      private fun observeKnown(
          evidence: BeetleEvidence.Known,
          requiredConsensusFrames: Int,
      ): BeetleMindOutput {
          if (
              evidence.rawSignature == ponderingSignature &&
              evidence.provenance == ponderingProvenance
          ) {
              ponderingCount++
          } else {
              ponderingSignature = evidence.rawSignature
              ponderingCount = 1
              ponderingProvenance = evidence.provenance
          }
  
          val cardName = "${evidence.cardId.suit.prettySymbol}${evidence.cardId.rank.symbol}"
          if (ponderingCount < requiredConsensusFrames) {
              return publish(BeetleThought.Pondering(cardName, ponderingCount))
          }
  
          val currentTimeMillis = nowMillis()
          val acceptedCardScan = if (
              evidence.rawSignature == lastAcceptedRawSignature &&
              evidence.provenance == lastAcceptedProvenance &&
              currentTimeMillis - lastAcceptedAtMillis < settings.debounceWindowMillis
          ) {
              null
          } else {
              lastAcceptedRawSignature = evidence.rawSignature
              lastAcceptedProvenance = evidence.provenance
              lastAcceptedAtMillis = currentTimeMillis
              AcceptedCardScan(
                  rawSignature = evidence.rawSignature,
                  cardId = evidence.cardId,
                  confidence = evidence.confidence,
                  seedWidthEvidence = evidence.seedWidthEvidence,
                  detectionBounds = evidence.detectionBounds,
                  sourceFrameSize = evidence.sourceFrameSize,
                  streamRoi = evidence.streamRoi,
                  provenance = evidence.provenance,
              )
          }
          return publish(
              nextThought = BeetleThought.Certain(cardName),
              acceptedCardScan = acceptedCardScan,
          )
      }
  
      private fun clearPondering() {
          ponderingSignature = null
          ponderingCount = 0
          ponderingProvenance = null
      }
  
      private fun replaceFood(orientationMode: BarcodeOrientationMode) {
          val impression = currentImpression ?: return
          val generation = lastFoodGeneration?.next() ?: FoodGeneration(1L)
          lastFoodGeneration = generation
          currentFood = when (
              val selection = selectFoodFromImpression(impression, orientationMode)
          ) {
              is FoodSelectionResult.Selected -> BeetleFood(
                  impressionGeneration = impression.request.generation,
                  generation = generation,
                  retained = selection.food,
              )
              FoodSelectionResult.ExplicitOrientationRequired -> null
          }
      }
  
      private fun clearAttention(): BeetleMindOutput {
          clearPondering()
          return publish(BeetleThought.Blank)
      }
  
      private fun publish(
          nextThought: BeetleThought,
          acceptedCardScan: AcceptedCardScan? = null,
      ): BeetleMindOutput {
          thought = nextThought
          return BeetleMindOutput(
              snapshot = snapshot(),
              acceptedCardScan = acceptedCardScan,
          )
      }
  
      private data class FoodConfiguration(
          val orientationMode: BarcodeOrientationMode,
          val generation: StreamConfigurationGeneration,
      )
  }

              }
              // For now, we still return a copy-based ImpressionCaptured to preserve
              // current contract until P2-03d integration.
              return ImpressionCaptured(
                  request = request,
                  geometry = geometry,
                  saa = ImpressionLumaReservoir(geometry.saa, saaPixelsFromLease(l, geometry.saa)),
                  sab = ImpressionLumaReservoir(geometry.sab, sabPixelsFromLease(l, geometry.sab)),
                  rotationDegrees = rotationDegrees,
                  timestampNanos = timestampNanos,
              )
          }
      }
  
      val saaImage = extractGrayImageFromLumaPlaneBuffer(
          imageWidth = imageWidth,
          imageHeight = imageHeight,
          lumaBuffer = lumaBuffer,
          rowStride = rowStride,
          pixelStride = pixelStride,
          roi = geometry.saa.toBarcodeRoi(),
      )
      val sabImage = extractGrayImageFromLumaPlaneBuffer(
          imageWidth = imageWidth,
          imageHeight = imageHeight,
          lumaBuffer = lumaBuffer,
          rowStride = rowStride,
          pixelStride = pixelStride,
          roi = geometry.sab.toBarcodeRoi(),
      )
      return ImpressionCaptured(
          request = request,
          geometry = geometry,
          saa = ImpressionLumaReservoir(geometry.saa, saaImage.pixels),
          sab = ImpressionLumaReservoir(geometry.sab, sabImage.pixels),
          rotationDegrees = rotationDegrees,
          timestampNanos = timestampNanos,
      )
  }
  
  private fun saaPixelsFromLease(lease: GroundedBufferPool.CaptureLease, region: SnapFrameRegion): ByteArray {
      val pixels = ByteArray(region.width * region.height)
      // Note: lease.copyRetainedSaaInto is not implemented yet.
      // Actually, I'll use lease.write block to copy out.
      lease.write { saa, _ -> saa.copyInto(pixels) }
      return pixels
  }
  
  private fun sabPixelsFromLease(lease: GroundedBufferPool.CaptureLease, region: SnapFrameRegion): ByteArray {
      val pixels = ByteArray(region.width * region.height)
      lease.write { _, sab -> sab.copyInto(pixels) }
      return pixels
  }
  
  internal fun processAdmittedStreamFrame(
      streamOutcome: StreamCameraScanOutcome,
      impressionRequest: ImpressionCaptureRequest?,
      pulseRecorder: ImpressionPulseRecorder? = null,
      groundedBufferPool: GroundedBufferPool? = null,
      publishStream: (StreamCameraScanOutcome) -> Unit,
      captureImpression: (ImpressionCaptureRequest) -> ImpressionCaptureOutcome,
      publishImpression: (ImpressionCaptureOutcome) -> Unit,
  ) {
      publishStream(streamOutcome)
      impressionRequest?.let { request ->
          pulseRecorder?.captureStarted(request)
          val outcome = try {
              captureImpression(request)
          } finally {
              pulseRecorder?.captureFinished(request)
          }
          publishImpression(outcome)
      }
  }
  
  private fun SnapFrameRegion.toBarcodeRoi(): BarcodeRoi =
      BarcodeRoi(x = x, y = y, width = width, height = height)

**🛠️⚙️🍺 Bob:** "I see the 'ghost in the machine,' Archy! 🧔🦊 💗💓 The reason it's circling forever is that I built the `GroundedBufferPool` as a high-performance thread-safe object, but I forgot to make its status **observable** by Compose.
